articles.title: Blue Origin announces 3rd stage for its powerful New Glenn rocket —and a new engine
articles.author: Mike Wall

paras.en: Blue Origin's big rocket is getting a little bigger.
paras.zh: 蓝色起源的大型火箭变得越来越大。

paras.en: Jeff Bezos' company announced today (Nov. 5) that it has developed a third stage for its New Glenn rocket, which it says will make the powerful launcher more capable and flexible.
paras.zh: 杰夫·贝佐斯的公司今天（11 月 5 日）宣布，它已经为其新格伦火箭开发了第三级，据称这将使强大的发射器更加强大和灵活。

paras.en: The stage, called the GS3, "enhances New Glenn's capabilities," Blue Origin said in a blog post today. "The third stage enables direct deployment of satellite constellations to GEO [geostationary orbit] and supports heavy-lift science and exploration missions to the moon and deep space."
paras.zh: 蓝色起源在今天的博客文章中表示，这个名为 GS3 的舞台“增强了新格伦的能力”。 “第三级能够将卫星星座直接部署到 GEO（地球静止轨道），并支持前往月球和深空的重型科学和探索任务。”

paras.en: New Glenn is a two-stage vehicle at the moment. Its reusable first stage is powered by seven of Blue Origin's BE-4 engines, and its second stage features two of the company's BE-3Us. The rocket stands 322 feet (98 meters) tall and can haul 14.3 tons (13 metric tons) to geostationary transfer orbit (GTO) and 50 tons (45 metric tons) to low Earth orbit (LEO).
paras.zh: 新格伦目前是两级车辆。其可重复使用的第一级由七台蓝色起源的 BE-4 发动机提供动力，第二级配备了该公司的两台 BE-3U 发动机。该火箭高 322 英尺（98 米），可将 14.3 吨（13 公吨）的物体运送到地球静止转移轨道（GTO），将 50 吨（45 公吨）的物体运送到近地轨道（LEO）。

paras.en: These are the specs for the standard, or "7x2," version of New Glenn. Last year, Blue Origin announced that it's developing a super-heavy variant known as the 9x4, because it will feature nine first-stage BE-4s and four upper-stage BE-3Us. The 9x4 will be nearly 400 feet (122 m) tall, and it will be able to loft 15.4 tons (14 metric tons) to GTO and 77 tons (70 metric tons) to LEO, according to Blue Origin.
paras.zh: 这些是新格伦标准版或“7x2”版本的规格。去年，蓝色起源宣布正在开发一种名为 9x4 的超重型型号，因为它将配备 9 架第一级 BE-4 和 4 架上级 BE-3U。据蓝色起源称，9x4 高度接近 400 英尺（122 m），能够向 GTO 发射 15.4 吨（14 公吨），向 LEO 发射 77 吨（70​​ 公吨）。

paras.en: New Glenn has flown three times to date, each time in the 7x2 configuration. The rocket debuted in January 2025, then launched again in November 2025 and again on April 19 of this year.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，新格伦已经飞行了 3 次，每次都采用 7x2 配置。该火箭于2025年1月首次发射，然后于2025年11月和今年4月19日再次发射。

paras.en: Things didn't go according to plan on that latest mission. The rocket deployed AST SpaceMobile's BlueBird 7 communications satellite into the wrong orbit, and the spacecraft ended up being lost.
paras.zh: 最近的任务并没有按计划进行。火箭将 AST SpaceMobile 的蓝鸟 7 号通信卫星部署到了错误的轨道，最终导致飞船失踪。

paras.en: Another setback came just a month later: On May 28, New Glenn exploded on the pad during a routine engine test at Florida's Cape Canaveral Space Force Station. Blue Origin has been working ever since to rebuild the pad and get New Glenn ready for its fourth flight, which is expected to occur late this year.
paras.zh: 一个月后又发生了一次挫折：5月28日，新格伦号在佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角太空部队站进行例行发动机测试时在发射台上爆炸。自那时起，蓝色起源一直致力于重建发射台，并为新格伦号的第四次飞行做好准备，预计将于今年年底进行。

paras.en: We now know that Blue Origin has also been working on the GS3 while those repairs were underway. The new stage will be powered by one BE-7 engine, which the company developed for use on its Blue Moon spacecraft, one of the two private vehicles that NASA selected to be crewed lunar landers for its Artemis program. (The other is SpaceX's Starship.)
paras.zh: 我们现在知道，在维修工作进行期间，蓝色起源也一直致力于 GS3 的维修工作。新阶段将由一台BE-7发动机提供动力，该发动机是该公司为蓝月航天器开发的，是美国宇航局选择作为其阿尔忒弥斯计划载人月球着陆器的两辆私人航天器之一。 （另一个是 SpaceX 的 Starship。）

paras.en: Blue Moon landing missions won't need to launch on GS3-equipped New Glenn rockets, according to Blue Origin. But the third stage "can support sustained operations around the moon," the company wrote in today's blog post. "By delivering significant payload mass directly to trans-lunar injection (TLI), GS3 enables faster transit times while preserving propellant for on-orbit operations."
paras.zh: 据蓝色起源称，蓝月登陆任务不需要使用配备 GS3 的新格伦火箭发射。但该公司在今天的博客文章中写道，第三阶段“可以支持绕月持续运行”。 “通过直接向跨月注入 (TLI) 提供大量有效载荷，GS3 能够缩短传输时间，同时保留在轨运行所需的推进剂。”

paras.en: And there's already demand for such services: Blue Origin also announced today that a government customer (which it did not name) has booked a GS3 mission to cislunar (Earth-moon) space, with launch targeted for 2028.
paras.zh: 对此类服务的需求已经存在：蓝色起源今天还宣布，一家政府客户（未透露姓名）已预订 GS3 前往地月空间的任务，计划于 2028 年发射。

paras.en: And the company dropped yet more news today — that it's working on a new first-stage engine, called Northstar.
paras.zh: 该公司今天还发布了更多消息——它正在开发一种新的第一级发动机，名为“北极星”。

paras.en: Like Blue Origin's other booster engine, the BE-4, Northstar burns liquid oxygen and liquid methane propellant, a combination known as methalox. But the new engine is more powerful and less complex.
paras.zh: 与 Blue Origin 的另一款助推发动机 BE-4 一样，Northstar 燃烧液氧和液态甲烷推进剂（一种称为甲氧灵的组合）。但新引擎更强大且更简单。

paras.en: "Compared to the BE-4 engine, Northstar reduces mass by 30% and parts count by 50%, while increasing thrust from 640,000 to 715,000 pounds-force," Blue Origin said in a second blog post today. "Manufacturing advancements have also significantly shortened production timelines, enabling assembly in less than a day."
paras.zh: 蓝色起源在今天的第二篇博客文章中表示：“与 BE-4 发动机相比，Northstar 的质量减少了 30%，零件数量减少了 50%，同时推力从 640,000 磅力增加到 715,000 磅力。” “制造技术的进步也显着缩短了生产时间，不到一天就能完成组装。”

paras.en: Northstar went from program approval to development testing in just 11 months, according to the company. But today's update did not say when the new engine will fly for the first time.
paras.zh: 据该公司称，Northstar 从项目批准到开发测试仅用了 11 个月。但今天的更新并没有透露新发动机何时首飞。

paras.en: Michael Wall is the Spaceflight and Tech Editor for Space.com and joined the team in 2010. He primarily covers human and robotic spaceflight, military space, and exoplanets, but has been known to dabble in the space art beat. His book about the search for alien life, "Out There," was published on Nov. 13, 2018. Before becoming a science writer, Michael worked as a herpetologist and wildlife biologist. He has a Ph.D. in evolutionary biology from the University of Sydney, Australia, a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona, and a graduate certificate in science writing from the University of California, Santa Cruz. To find out what his latest project is, you can follow Michael on Twitter.
paras.zh: Michael Wall 是 Space.com 的太空飞行和技术编辑，于 2010 年加入该团队。他主要报道人类和机器人太空飞行、军事太空和系外行星，但以涉足太空艺术领域而闻名。他关于寻找外星生命的书《Out There》于 2018 年 11 月 13 日出版。在成为科普作家之前，迈克尔曾是一名爬行动物学家和野生动物生物学家。他拥有博士学位。澳大利亚悉尼大学进化生物学博士学位、亚利桑那大学学士学位以及加州大学圣克鲁斯分校科学写作研究生证书。要了解他的最新项目是什么，您可以在 Twitter 上关注 Michael。

articles.title: Andy Weir says his new sci-fi audio drama 'Exoplanet' is a way to 'revive the old art of radio plays' (interview)
articles.author: Jeff Spry

paras.en: Hot off the tremendous theatrical success of this year's "Project Hail Mary," adapted from Andy Weir's 2021 novel of the same name, the New York Times bestselling author is rocketing back into deep space with a brand new Audible Original release landing on Nov. 5, 2026, titled "Exoplanet."
paras.zh: 继今年改编自安迪·威尔 20​​21 年同名小说的《万福玛丽计划》在戏剧界取得巨大成功之后，这位《纽约时报》畅销书作家将带着全新的 Audible Original 版本于 2026 年 11 月 5 日登陆深空，名为《系外行星》。

paras.en: Weir ("The Martian") is executive producing this ambitious full-cast audiobook drama with acclaimed author and ace comic writer Benjamin Percy ("Wolverine") for the first in a series of curated sci-fi projects for Amazon's Audible.
paras.zh: 威尔（《火星救援》）与著名作家兼王牌漫画作家本杰明·珀西（《金刚狼》）共同制作了这部雄心勃勃的全演员有声读物剧，这是亚马逊 Audible 策划的一系列科幻项目中的第一部。

paras.en: The seven-episode sci-fi thriller stars the vocal talents of Anthony Mackie, Ariana DeBose, and John Leguizamo in a wild time-travel space disaster odyssey that also benefits from Lucasfilm’s Skywalker Sound, which provided the show’s immersive acoustic elements.
paras.zh: 这部七集的科幻惊悚片由安东尼·麦基、阿丽亚娜·德博斯和约翰·雷吉扎莫等声乐天才主演，展开了一场狂野的时空旅行灾难之旅，这也得益于卢卡斯影业的天行者音效，该音效为该剧提供了身临其境的声学元素。

paras.en: "One crew. One planet. Three timelines. No one survives alone," states the official synopsis. "When a quantum anomaly tears apart the starship Wild Blue Yonder, each surviving crew member crash-lands in a different era on the same deadly exoplanet—hunted, alone, and running out of time."
paras.zh: “一个船员，一个星球，三个时间线。没有人能够独自生存，”官方剧情简介说道。 “当量子异常撕裂了星际飞船“野蓝远方”时，每个幸存的船员都在不同的时代迫降在同一个致命的系外行星上——被追捕，孤独，时间不多了。”

paras.en: Ahead of the audio drama's launch, we sat down with Weir and Percy to find out more about this exciting science fiction adventure.
paras.zh: 在音频剧推出之前，我们与威尔和珀西坐下来，了解更多关于这个激动人心的科幻冒险的信息。

paras.en: When Percy was first approached by Audible about this challenging endeavor, it was part of a bake-off situation where he was competing with several other writers, all jockeying for position.
paras.zh: 当 Audible 第一次就这项具有挑战性的工作与 Percy 接洽时，当时他正在与其他几位作家竞争，争夺职位。

paras.en: "I think the thing that set me apart is my understanding of how to channel legacy properties," Percy tells Space. "Having written for DC and for Marvel, I can take 'Star Wars' or 'Predator' or Wolverine or Batman and honor that legacy but also put my own unique spin on it.
paras.zh: “我认为让我与众不同的是我对如何引导遗留财产的理解，”珀西告诉《太空》。 “在为 DC 和漫威写过剧本后，我可以选择《星球大战》、《铁血战士》、《金刚狼》或《蝙蝠侠》，向这一传统致敬，同时也加入我自己独特的风格。

paras.en: "When it came to the banner of 'Andy Weir Presents,' my job was to write my best version of an awesome Andy Weir story. So I thought about space disasters, big-hearted hopefulness, quippy humor, and a roller coaster plot, and then I nested into all of that a time-travel story."
paras.zh: “当谈到‘安迪·威尔的礼物’时，我的工作就是写出我最好的安迪·威尔故事的版本。所以我想到了太空灾难、慷慨的希望、俏皮的幽默和过山车的情节，然后我在这一切中嵌入了一个时间旅行的故事。”

paras.en: Writing an audio drama is unlike the comic work that Percy is known for, but as he explains, it's also quite different from working on conventional shows and movies too.
paras.zh: 编写有声剧与珀西闻名的喜剧作品不同，但正如他解释的那样，这也与传统节目和电影的工作有很大不同。

paras.en: "If you’re watching TV or film, you’re passive and letting it wash over you. You’re taking in the story as a passenger," notes Percy. "But when you're listening to audio, you're invited in with the dialogue, the narration, the sound cues. You’re invited to fill in the vacancies. As a result of that, you become like a co-author in the experience. I was super excited to jump into this project."
paras.zh: “如果你在看电视或电影，你就会处于被动状态，并让它淹没你。你是以乘客的身份看待故事，”珀西指出。 “但是当你听音频时，你会被邀请参与对话、旁白和声音提示。你会被邀请填补空缺。因此，你就像是体验中的共同作者。我非常兴奋能够加入这个项目。”

paras.en: The genesis of "Exoplanet" started with Audible approaching Weir with the basic idea, but what they didn't know was that he had already been thinking about resurrecting great radio dramas of the past.
paras.zh: 《系外行星》的诞生始于 Audible 向 Weir 提出基本想法，但他们不知道的是，他已经在考虑复活过去伟大的广播剧。

paras.en: "Earlier on in my life, even before 'The Martian,' I wanted to bring back audio-only entertainment with full-cast productions and sound effects," shares Weir. "I got into listening to things like 'The Lone Ranger' and 'The Shadow' and, of course, the Basil Rathbone Sherlock Holmes adaptations. Also, 'Zorro' was a radio show, and there were a lot of good westerns.
paras.zh: “在我生命的早期，甚​​至在《火星救援》之前，我就想通过全阵容制作和音效带回纯音频娱乐，”威尔分享道。 “我喜欢听《独行侠》和《影子》，当然还有巴兹尔·拉思伯恩的《大侦探福尔摩斯》的改编作品。此外，《佐罗》是一个广播节目，有很多优秀的西部片。

paras.en: "At the time, I wasn't yet famous or a writer, but I thought I could do this myself. I could write something, narrate it, throw in some sound effects, and put it up online," Weir recalls. "But then I didn't because I’m really lazy. Then many moons later, Audible comes up to me, and I have an opportunity to participate in that exact thing. I especially like the part where all the hard work is done by Ben. That’s my favorite part."
paras.zh: “当时，我还没有出名，也没有成为一名作家，但我认为我自己可以做到这一点。我可以写一些东西，叙述它，加入一些音效，然后把它放在网上，”威尔回忆道。 “但后来我没有，因为我真的很懒。然后很多个月后，Audible 出现在我面前，我有机会参与到那件事中。我特别喜欢 Ben 完成所有艰苦工作的部分。这是我最喜欢的部分。”

paras.en: As Weir points out, he's thankfully not the one wielding the pen this time around, but he did select Percy to be his champion.
paras.zh: 正如威尔指出的那样，幸运的是，这次他不是挥舞笔的人，但他确实选择了珀西作为他的冠军。

paras.en: "We got a bunch of different story concepts submitted to us from lots of talented authors, and Ben's was the one that stood out head and shoulders above the rest. It’s a really interesting concept," says Weir.
paras.zh: “我们收到了许多才华横溢的作者提交给我们的一堆不同的故事概念，而本的故事概念在其他故事中脱颖而出。这是一个非常有趣的概念，”威尔说。

paras.en: "It's not just trope sci-fi with an evil empire of bad guys and some plucky rebels. Ben came up with a unique story with a unique angle. Audio is quickly becoming a larger and larger medium. Everyone's on the go, and now for the first time in history we all have computers in our pocket capable of storing multiple audiobooks to last us years. It's a great time to revive the old art of radio plays, and I think this is a great way to do it.”
paras.zh: “这不仅仅是一个由坏人和一些勇敢的反叛者组成的邪恶帝国的比喻科幻小说。本以独特的角度想出了一个独特的故事。音频正在迅速成为一种越来越大的媒体。每个人都在忙碌，现在我们历史上第一次在我们的口袋里有了能够存储多本有声读物的电脑，可以供我们使用多年。现在是复兴广播剧的古老艺术的好时机，我认为这是一个很好的方式。”

paras.en: Weir's enthusiasm for the project is clear, and we can't wait to check it out. And we won't have to, because it releases today!
paras.zh: 威尔对该项目的热情是显而易见的，我们迫不及待地想看看。我们不必这么做，因为它今天就发布了！

paras.en: "Exoplanet" is available starting Nov. 5 exclusively from Audible for members of its subscription tiers or as an a la carte option.
paras.zh: 《Exoplanet》从 11 月 5 日起仅由 Audible 为其订阅级别的会员提供，或作为点菜选项提供。

paras.en: One crew. One planet. Three timelines. No one survives alone. A sci-fi thriller executive produced by Andy Weir (#1 bestselling author of Project Hail Mary, The Martian), with an all-star cast led by Anthony Mackie, Ariana DeBose and John Leguizamo.
paras.zh: 一名船员。一颗行星。三个时间线。没有人能够独自生存。这部科幻惊悚片由安迪·威尔（《万福玛丽计划》、《火星救援》畅销书作者）监制，演员阵容由安东尼·麦基、阿丽亚娜·德博斯和约翰·雷吉扎莫领衔。

paras.en: Exoplanet is free for Audible members, but also available for purchase separately.
paras.zh: Exoplanet 对 Audible 会员免费，但也可以单独购买。

paras.en: Jeff Spry is an award-winning screenwriter and veteran freelance journalist covering TV, movies, video games, books, and comics. His work has appeared at SYFY Wire, Inverse, Collider, Bleeding Cool and elsewhere. Jeff lives in beautiful Bend, Oregon amid the ponderosa pines, classic muscle cars, a crypt of collector horror comics, and two loyal English Setters.
paras.zh: 杰夫·斯普里 (Jeff Spry) 是一位屡获殊荣的编剧和资深自由记者，报道电视、电影、视频游戏、书籍和漫画。他的作品曾出现在 SYFY Wire、Inverse、Collider、Bleeding Cool 等网站上。杰夫住在俄勒冈州美丽的本德，周围有黄松、经典肌肉车、收藏恐怖漫画的地窖和两只忠诚的英国塞特犬。

articles.title: 'We got it done!' Spacewalking astronauts finish installing next-gen ISS solar arrays
articles.author: Robert Z. Pearlman

paras.en: Just as NASA is preparing to demonstrate "Max Power" on the ground, two astronauts on a spacewalk have provided the International Space Station (ISS) with the same.
paras.zh: 正当美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 准备在地面展示“最大功率”时，太空行走中的两名宇航员也向国际空间站 (ISS) 提供了同样的效果。

paras.en: Expedition 75 flight engineers Anil Menon of NASA and Joshua Kutryk of the Canadian Space Agency installed and deployed the eighth and final ISS Roll-Out Solar Array (iROSA) on Thursday (Nov. 5), augmenting the space station's legacy solar array wings to produce as much as 30% more electricity.
paras.zh: 周四（11 月 5 日），NASA 的 Expedition 75 飞行工程师 Anil Menon 和加拿大航天局的 Joshua Kutryk 安装并部署了第八个也是最后一个国际空间站滚出式太阳能电池阵列 (iROSA)，增强了空间站的传统太阳能电池阵列机翼，发电量增加了 30%。

paras.en: "We got it done!" said Menon at the end of the 6-hour-and-59-minute spacewalk. The EVA (extravehicular activity) began at 8:36 a.m. EST and ended at 3:35 p.m. EST (1336 to 2035 GMT).
paras.zh: “我们完成了！”梅农在 6 小时 59 分钟的太空行走结束时说道。 EVA（舱外活动）于东部标准时间上午 8:36 开始，于下午 3:35 结束。美国东部时间（格林尼治标准时间 1336 至 2035）。

paras.en: Repeating many of the same tasks as they did on an Oct. 29 spacewalk that added the penultimate iROSA, Menon and Kutryk worked this time on the starboard side of the station's backbone truss on the 3B power channel. The two retrieved the 750-pound (340 kilograms) iROSA assembly from a temporary stowage platform, carried it to the worksite by way of the Canadarm2 robotic arm and mounted it to its previously assembled bracket kit.
paras.zh: Menon 和 Kutryk 重复了许多与 10 月 29 日添加倒数第二个 iROSA 的太空行走相同的任务，这次他们在空间站主干桁架的右舷 3B 电力通道上进行工作。两人从临时装载平台上取回了 750 磅（340 公斤）重的 iROSA 组件，通过 Canadaarm2 机械臂将其运送到工地，并将其安装到之前组装的支架套件上。

paras.en: Menon then attached the cables to tie the iROSA into the station's systems but ran into a problem.
paras.zh: Menon 随后连接了电缆，将 iROSA 连接到空间站的系统中，但遇到了问题。

paras.en: "We are seeing half of the expected shunt current that we want," radioed Nichole Stilwell, a NASA astronaut serving as the spacewalk officer in Mission Control. "In this current config, we are not necessarily going to deploy."
paras.zh: “我们看到的分流电流只有我们想要的一半，”美国宇航局宇航员、任务控制中心太空行走官员尼科尔·史迪威在无线电中说道。 “在当前的配置中，我们不一定要部署。”

paras.en: To address the issue, the connectors needed to be inspected. Out of safety concerns — given that the arrays generate electricity whenever lit by the sun — the astronauts needed to wait for the space station to enter the shadow of Earth to see what could be done. In the interim, they spent the time cleaning up their worksite and returning the Canadarm2 to its park site as they would have done after the deployment.
paras.zh: 为了解决这个问题，需要检查连接器。出于安全考虑——考虑到阵列在阳光照射下就会发电——宇航员需要等待空间站进入地球的阴影，看看能做什么。在此期间，他们花时间清理工作地点并将 Canadaarm2 返回到其停放地点，就像部署后所做的那样。

paras.en: Fortunately, they were able to clear the issue.
paras.zh: 幸运的是，他们能够解决这个问题。

paras.en: "We are seeing good shunt currents on the ground, so we are go for deploy," said Stilwell.
paras.zh: 史迪威说：“我们在地面上看到了良好的分流电流，因此我们将进行部署。”

paras.en: After releasing two bolts, Kutryk and Menon watched as the array started to unfurl to its full 63-foot (19 meters) length. No motor was needed; the iROSA, as designed, used only the potential energy stored by its rolled-up carbon composite booms to extend itself. The entire process took about 10 minutes.
paras.zh: 释放两颗螺栓后，库特里克和梅农看着阵列开始展开至 63 英尺（19 米）长。不需要马达；按照设计，iROSA 仅利用其卷起的碳复合材料吊杆储存的势能来伸展自身。整个过程持续了大约10分钟。

paras.en: "Today marks the completion of not just one solar array but, over 15 years after its development, eight arrays," said Menon at the close of the spacewalk. "These solar arrays are incredible. Half the size of the old ones and bringing 40% more power."
paras.zh: “今天不仅标志着一个太阳能电池阵列的完成，而且在其开发 15 年后，八个太阳能电池阵列的完成，”梅农在太空行走结束时说道。 “这些太阳能电池阵列令人难以置信。尺寸只有旧太阳能电池阵列的一半，发电量却增加了 40%。”

paras.en: Each of the eight iROSAs and their mounting assemblies were delivered to the space station by SpaceX Dragon cargo spacecraft. Beginning in June 2021, four teams of two astronauts did as was done on Thursday to deploy each array. In addition to Kutryk and Menon's work on the 2A and 3B power channels, the spacewalkers included Shane Kimbrough of NASA and Thomas Pesquet of the European Space Agency for the 2B and 4B channels; Josh Cassada and Frank Rubio, both with NASA, on 3A and 4A in December 2022; and NASA's Steve Bowen and Woody Hoburg on 1A and 1B in June 2023.
paras.zh: 八个 iROSA 及其安装组件均由 SpaceX Dragon 货运飞船运送到空间站。从 2021 年 6 月开始，由两名宇航员组成的四组按照周四的做法部署了每个阵列。除了 Kutryk 和 Menon 在 2A 和 3B 功率通道方面的工作外，太空行走者还包括 NASA 的 Shane Kimbrough 和欧洲航天局的 Thomas Pesquet 在 2B 和 4B 通道方面的工作；乔什·卡萨达 (Josh Cassada) 和弗兰克·卢比奥 (Frank Rubio) 均来自 NASA，于 2022 年 12 月登上 3A 和 4A；以及 NASA 的 Steve Bowen 和 Woody Hoburg 于 2023 年 6 月在 1A 和 1B 上进行的讨论。

paras.en: The need for the iROSA augmentations was discovered by flight controllers when the space station's eight original arrays began to show degraded power output as they exceeded their 15-year design life. The iROSAs provide the additional electricity needed to support ISS operations through its retirement and controlled deorbit, which are currently scheduled to occur in late 2030.
paras.zh: 当空间站的八个原始阵列由于超过 15 年设计寿命而开始出现功率输出下降时，飞行控制人员发现了对 iROSA 增强功能的需求。 iROSA 通过退役和受控脱轨提供支持国际空间站运行所需的额外电力，目前计划于 2030 年底进行。

paras.en: "Congratulations to you all on your stellar work to finish the last of the roll-out solar arrays and the upgrades to the ISS power system that will take it to the end of its journey," said Stilwell, addressing Menon and Kutryk. "It is fitting that we just surpassed 26 years of constant human presence on the International Space Station, and you all showed us what the best of humanity looks like executing one of the most difficult and dangerous [things] humans do and making it look easy. Congratulations!"
paras.zh: 史迪威对梅农和库特里克说道：“祝贺你们所有人出色的工作，完成了最后一批太阳能电池阵列的部署和国际空间站电力系统的升级，这将使其完成旅程。” “人类在国际空间站上持续存在的时间刚刚超过 26 年，这是很恰当的，你们向我们展示了人类最优秀的一面，执行人类所做的最困难和最危险的[事情]之一，并使它看起来很容易。恭喜！”

paras.en: Menon has now logged 33 hours and 30 minutes on four spacewalks, while Kutryk has tailed 14 hours and 10 minutes on two EVAs. Thursday's spacewalk was the 101st U.S. EVA at the International Space Station without a space shuttle being present and the 286th overall in support of ISS assembly, maintenance and upgrades. It was the ninth spacewalk of 2026 and the sixth conducted by the station's 75th resident crew.
paras.zh: 梅农目前已在四次太空行走中花费了 33 小时 30 分钟，而库特里克则在两次 EVA 中花费了 14 小时 10 分钟。周四的太空行走是美国在国际空间站进行的第 101 次没有航天飞机的 EVA 飞行，也是第 286 次太空行走，旨在支持国际空间站的组装、维护和升级。这是 2026 年的第九次太空行走，也是空间站第 75 名常驻宇航员进行的第六次太空行走。

paras.en: Robert Pearlman is a space historian, journalist and the founder and editor of collectSPACE.com, a daily news publication and community devoted to space history with a particular focus on how and where space exploration intersects with pop culture. Pearlman is also a contributing writer for Space.com and co-author of "Space Stations: The Art, Science, and Reality of Working in Space” published by Smithsonian Books in 2018.
paras.zh: 罗伯特·皮尔曼 (Robert Pearlman) 是一位太空历史学家、记者，也是 CollectSPACE.com 的创始人和编辑，该网站是一家致力于太空历史的每日新闻出版物和社区，特别关注太空探索如何以及在何处与流行文化相交叉。 Pearlman 也是 Space.com 的特约撰稿人，也是史密森尼图书 2018 年出版的《空间站：太空工作的艺术、科学和现实》一书的合著者。

paras.en: In 2009, he was inducted into the U.S. Space Camp Hall of Fame in Huntsville, Alabama. In 2021, he was honored by the American Astronautical Society with the Ordway Award for Sustained Excellence in Spaceflight History. In 2023, the National Space Club Florida Committee recognized Pearlman with the Kolcum News and Communications Award for excellence in telling the space story along the Space Coast and throughout the world.
paras.zh: 2009年，他入选位于阿拉巴马州亨茨维尔的美国太空营名人堂。 2021年，他被美国宇航学会授予航天史上持续卓越奥德威奖。 2023 年，佛罗里达国家太空俱乐部委员会授予皮尔曼科尔库姆新闻与传播奖，以表彰他在讲述太空海岸和全世界太空故事方面的卓越表现。

articles.title: ESI supplying solar array components to missile defense programs
articles.author: ESI Motion

paras.en: Oct. 30, 2026 – ESI Motion Inc. is proud to announce that it is supplying the Solar Array Drive Electronics (SADE) to Lockheed Martin for its work on the Space Development Agency’s Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture (PWSA) programs.
paras.zh: 2026 年 10 月 30 日 – ESI Motion Inc. 自豪地宣布，它正在向洛克希德·马丁公司提供太阳能阵列驱动电子设备 (SADE)，用于其太空发展局扩散作战空间架构 (PWSA) 项目的工作。

paras.en: Under the agreement, ESI Motion’s SADE technology will support SDA as the PWSA is developed.
paras.zh: 根据协议，随着 PWSA 的开发，ESI Motion 的 SADE 技术将支持 SDA。

paras.en: Defending our nation in space is more important than ever. The Space Development Agency’s PWSA programs provide the military with a network of satellites with secure communication, missile tracking and space-based support to make sure our troops have the latest and greatest technology.
paras.zh: 在太空中保卫我们的国家比以往任何时候都更加重要。太空发展局的 PWSA 计划为军队提供了一个卫星网络，提供安全通信、导弹跟踪和天基支持，以确保我们的部队拥有最新、最先进的技术。

paras.en: The SADE consists of our Space-rated, flight heritage, SuperNova and Pulsar motor controllers. These motion controllers ensure all mission parameters are fulfilled, with high-reliable technology.
paras.zh: SADE 由我们的太空级、飞行传统、SuperNova 和 Pulsar 电机控制器组成。这些运动控制器采用高可靠性技术，确保满足所有任务参数。

paras.en: ESI Motion Inc., U.S. Company, is a trusted supplier and partner, supporting mission operations for space, military and industrial customers around the world for over 20 years. Please visit our website; www.esimotion.com
paras.zh: ESI Motion Inc.，美国公司，是值得信赖的供应商和合作伙伴，20 多年来为世界各地的太空、军事和工业客户的任务运营提供支持。请访问我们的网站； www.esimotion.com

paras.zh: 媒体联系人：Mitchell Haerterich，高级营销和销售专家

articles.title: DETUMBLER: Airbus’ Passive Spin Stabilization Solution
articles.author: Airbus

paras.en: The tumbling crisis: why dead satellites threaten orbit
paras.zh: 翻滚危机：为何死亡卫星威胁轨道

paras.en: Every year, hundreds of satellites reach end-of-life, most are deorbited, but some fail abruptly. Yet, even when properly decommissioned, some dead satellites may start tumbling on their own, through the accumulation of tiny disturbances like solar radiation pressure, to the point where they become impossible to capture by active debris removal missions.
paras.zh: 每年都有数百颗卫星报废，大多数卫星脱离轨道，但也有一些卫星突然失效。然而，即使正确退役，一些报废的卫星也可能会通过太阳辐射压力等微小扰动的积累而开始自行翻滚，直至主动碎片清除任务无法捕获它们。

paras.en: With over 36,500 tracked debris objects in orbit, the risk of cascading collisions is real. ESA warns that without ADR (Active Debris Removal) solutions, some LEO orbits will become unusable. Ensuring that all dead satellites are properly detumbled would be a major element towards making ADR economically feasible.
paras.zh: 轨道上有超过 36,500 个被跟踪的碎片物体，级联碰撞的风险是真实存在的。欧空局警告说，如果没有 ADR（主动碎片清除）解决方案，一些低地球轨道将变得无法使用。确保所有报废卫星得到适当的修复将是使 ADR 在经济上可行的一个主要因素。

paras.en: Detumbler: the game-changing alternative
paras.zh: Detumbler：改变游戏规则的替代方案

paras.en: Developed by Airbus R&D, the Detumbler is a passive magnetic damping device that stabilizes tumbling satellites before they become uncontrollable. Acting like an induction brake, it dissipates kinetic energy through the Earth’s magnetic field, stopping tumbling in a few months. For the first time, operators have a reliable, low-cost, fully passive solution to prevent post-mission tumbling.
paras.zh: Detumbler 由空客研发部开发，是一种无源磁阻尼装置，可在翻滚的卫星变得失控之前稳定它们。它的作用就像感应制动器，通过地球磁场耗散动能，几个月后就停止翻滚。运营商第一次拥有了可靠、低成本、完全被动的解决方案来防止任务后翻滚。

paras.en: Without power and thus actuators, the only phenomenon that can limit tumbling rates in a dead spacecraft are the natural eddy currents created by the Earth’s magnetic field in the satellite’s rotating metallic structure. Short circuiting the magnetorquers at the end of life could help boost that natural effect. Unfortunately, the resulting resistive torque is proportional to the low magnetic field squared (the induced dipole moment M is proportional to B, and the resulting magnetic torque is MxB), making such effects extremely weak, too weak to prevent spontaneous tumbling in case of any asymmetry in the external disturbances. As an example, in 2017, 12 years after decommissioning, Topex-Poseidon had reached a spin rate of 34 deg/s (40,000 Nms of accumulated momentum).
paras.zh: 在没有电源和执行器的情况下，唯一可以限制报废航天器翻滚速率的现象是地球磁场在卫星旋转金属结构中产生的自然涡流。在磁力器寿命结束时将其短路可能有助于增强这种自然效应。不幸的是，产生的阻力矩与低磁场的平方成正比（感应偶极矩M与B成正比，产生的磁力矩为MxB），使得这种效应极其微弱，太弱以至于无法在外部干扰不对称的情况下防止自发翻滚。例如，2017 年，即退役 12 年后，Topex-Poseidon 的旋转速度达到了 34 度/秒（累积动量 40,000 Nms）。

paras.en: Despite its very modest mass and volume, the Detumbler can reach efficiencies many orders of magnitude higher, by using permanent magnets so that the braking torque is proportional to B, not B².
paras.zh: 尽管其质量和体积非常适中，但通过使用永磁体，制动力矩与 B 而不是 B² 成正比，Detumbler 的效率可以提高许多数量级。

paras.en: ESA’s Space Safety Program requires detumbling capacities for LEO missions >500kg (1100 lbs), targeting detumbling performances from 3°/s to 0.75°/s in less than a year. Airbus’ Detumbler is a leading solution for meeting ESA’s requirements and thus enabling active debris removal (ADR).
paras.zh: ESA 的空间安全计划要求低地球轨道任务的减滚能力 >500 公斤（1100 磅），目标是在不到一年的时间内将减滚性能从 3°/s 提高到 0.75°/s。空中客车公司的 Detumbler 是一种领先的解决方案，可满足 ESA 的要求，从而实现主动碎片清除 (ADR)。

paras.en: How the Detumbler works: a satellite’s “magnetic brake”
paras.zh: Detumbler 的工作原理：卫星的“磁力制动器”

paras.en: The magnetized rotor inside the Detumbler tends to remain aligned with the Earth’s magnetic field. As the satellite tumbles, the Detumbler’s conductive housing rotates around the magnetized rotor, thus causing magnetic braking through eddy currents. This slowly but steadily dissipates the satellite’s kinetic energy, reducing the angular momentum exponentially, ultimately reaching a detumbled steady-state with very low residual rates. This is achieved without the need for any electrical or computing power, contrary to all other attitude control actuators.
paras.zh: Detumbler 内部的磁化转子往往与地球磁场保持一致。当卫星翻滚时，Detumbler 的导电外壳围绕磁化转子旋转，从而通过涡流产生磁力制动。这缓慢但稳定地消耗了卫星的动能，以指数方式减少角动量，最终达到残余率非常低的稳定状态。与所有其他姿态控制执行器相反，这是不需要任何电力或计算能力即可实现的。

paras.en: The Detumbler can then cancel or respectively prevent tumbling in all situations that might cause it:
paras.zh: 然后，Detumbler 可以在所有可能导致翻滚的情况下取消或分别防止翻滚：

paras.en: - catastrophic dynamic events (leaks, propulsion failures, impacts from debris or micrometeoroids)
paras.zh: - 灾难性动态事件（泄漏、推进故障、碎片或微流星体的影响）

paras.en: - slow buildup of angular momentum through the relentless action of tiny disturbance sources such as asymmetric solar radiation pressure (similar to the YORP effect in astronomy).
paras.zh: - 通过微小扰动源（例如不对称太阳辐射压力）的持续作用，角动量缓慢积累（类似于天文学中的 YORP 效应）。

paras.en: Weighing around 200g (0,440 lbs), the palm-sized device can be integrated almost anywhere (just not too close to the magnetometer) into existing platform designs, with little-to-no modifications, making it an easy decision for future LEO space missions.
paras.zh: 这款手掌大小的设备重约 200 克（0,440 磅），几乎可以在任何地方（只是距离磁力计不太近）集成到现有平台设计中，几乎不需要任何修改，这使其成为未来低地球轨道太空任务的一个轻松决定。

paras.en: Detumbler is no longer in R&D, it’s TRL 8 and already commercially available through the Airbus Space Electronics product portfolio.
paras.zh: Detumbler 不再处于研发阶段，它是 TRL 8，并且已经通过空中客车航天电子产品组合投入商业使用。

paras.en: ✔ 100% passive: Neither power nor attitude-control actuators intervention; working even after the end of the mission
paras.zh: ✔ 100%被动：动力和姿态控制执行器均不干预；任务结束后仍继续工作

paras.en: ✔ Compatible with a large range of platform sizes (from ~150 kg (330 lbs) to ~1.5 tons (3300 lbs)
paras.zh: ✔ 与多种平台尺寸兼容（从约 150 公斤（330 磅）到约 1.5 吨（3300 磅））

paras.en: ✔ Detumbling within weeks for the smaller platforms, within a year for the upper end of the size range
paras.zh: ✔ 对于较小的平台，可在数周内进行除滚；对于较大尺寸的平台，可在一年内进行除滚

paras.en: ✔ Prevents tumbling despite average external disturbances up to 5 µNm
paras.zh: ✔ 即使平均外部干扰高达 5 µNm，也能防止翻滚

paras.en: ✔ Tested under launch vibrations and orbital conditions.
paras.zh: ✔ 在发射振动和轨道条件下进行测试。

paras.en: While available now, Detumbler’s potential lies in large-scale adoption. MDA Space has selected the Detumbler for its first MDA AURORATM LEO satellite constellation order, with a view to tangibly ensuring a safer, sustainable use of Space. When the constellation launches, it will mark the first commercial large-scale integration of passive detumbling in orbit.
paras.zh: Detumbler 现已推出，其潜力在于大规模采用。 MDA Space 为其首个 MDA AURORATM LEO 卫星星座订单选择了 Detumbler，以切实确保更安全、可持续地利用太空。当该星座发射时，将标志着被动减滚在轨首次商业化大规模集成。

paras.en: Detumbler is more than a product; it’s a cornerstone of Airbus’ sustainable space vision. By enabling active debris removal, it supports ESA’s Zero Debris targets and EU Space Traffic Management regulations, ensuring long-term orbital viability.
paras.zh: Detumbler 不仅仅是一种产品；它更是一种产品。它是空客可持续太空愿景的基石。通过主动清除碎片，它支持欧空局的零碎片目标和欧盟空间交通管理法规，确保长期轨道可行性。

paras.en: For Airbus, Detumbler proves that even the most complex space challenges can be solved through innovation and responsibility. As mega-constellations expand, technologies like Detumbler will be essential to preserving the usability of the shared low Earth orbit environment.
paras.zh: 对于空中客车公司来说，Detumbler 证明即使是最复杂的太空挑战也可以通过创新和责任来解决。随着巨型星座的扩张，像 Detumbler 这样的技术对于保持共享的近地轨道环境的可用性至关重要。

paras.en: The Detumbler effect: stability for a sustainable future
paras.zh: Detumbler 效应：稳定的未来

paras.en: The problem of tumbling satellites has persisted for decades, but Detumbler, ESA’s mandates, and renewed urgency for sustainability now require industry to solve it. By stabilizing uncontrolled satellites, Detumbler reduces ADR risks, costs, and complexity, making removal feasible at scale.
paras.zh: 卫星翻滚的问题已经持续了数十年，但 Detumbler、欧空局的指令以及可持续发展的新紧迫性现在需要工业界来解决这个问题。通过稳定不受控制的卫星，Detumbler 降低了 ADR 风险、成本和复杂性，使大规模移除成为可能。

paras.en: For operators, the message is clear: integrating Detumbler is not just compliance, it’s a business imperative. For the industry, it’s a step toward a stable and accessible orbit.
paras.zh: 对于运营商来说，信息很明确：集成 Detumbler 不仅仅是合规性，更是业务的当务之急。对于该行业来说，这是迈向稳定且可进入的轨道的一步。

paras.en: Ready to upgrade your next platform for meeting the sustainability imperatives of the upcoming decades? Contact Airbus Space Electronics to learn how the Detumbler secures the endgame in your mission’s life-cycle.

articles.title: CesiumAstro Secures $730 Million in Janus Henderson-Led Series D at a Valuation Above $4.5 Billion; Unveils Synchronicity Satellite Constellation Following Fully Successful Element-1 Mission
articles.author: CesiumAstro

paras.en: CesiumAstro Inc., a global leader in space and defense communications systems and satellites, today announced the closing of $730 million in Series D financing, valuing the company at more than $4.5 billion. The financing brings CesiumAstro’s total capital announced in 2026 to more than $1.2 billion and supports its expansion into developing and operating its own satellite infrastructure.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro Inc. 是太空和国防通信系统及卫星领域的全球领导者，今天宣布完成 7.3 亿美元的 D 轮融资，公司估值超过 45 亿美元。此次融资使 CesiumAstro 宣布的 2026 年总资本超过 12 亿美元，并支持其扩张至开发和运营自己的卫星基础设施。

paras.en: The company also announced Synchronicity, a planned 737-satellite, AI-enabled constellation for commercial, sovereign, and defense missions. The announcement follows the launch of CesiumAstro’s first satellite Element-1, and the start of its on-orbit operations.
paras.zh: 该公司还宣布了 Synchronicity，这是一个计划由 737 颗卫星组成、支持人工智能的星座，用于商业、主权和国防任务。该公告是在 CesiumAstro 的第一颗卫星 Element-1 发射并开始在轨运行之后发布的。

paras.en: This expansion builds on three strategic acquisitions that have strengthened CesiumAstro’s vertical integration from semiconductors to mission operations, helping accelerate the development and deployment of Synchronicity. The company is also expanding its engineering and manufacturing operations worldwide. As part of that effort, CesiumAstro has announced a $500 million investment over five years to expand its Austin-area headquarters, including the purchase of 270,000 square feet of advanced manufacturing space.
paras.zh: 此次扩张建立在三项战略收购的基础上，这些收购加强了 CesiumAstro 从半导体到任务运营的垂直整合，有助于加速 Synchronicity 的开发和部署。该公司还在全球范围内扩展其工程和制造业务。作为这一努力的一部分，CesiumAstro 宣布在五年内投资 5 亿美元来扩建其奥斯汀地区总部，包括购买 270,000 平方英尺的先进制造空间。

paras.en: The equity round was led by Janus Henderson, with participation from Insight Partners, Sands Capital, Sumitomo Corporation of Americas, Woven Capital – Toyota’s Growth Fund, Incharge Capital, Magnetar, AV, and NewSpace Capital, alongside $100 million in debt financing provided through the Export-Import Bank of the United States (EXIM) and JPMorgan.
paras.zh: 此轮股权融资由 Janus Henderson 领投，Insight Partners、Sands Capital、Sumitomo Corporation of Americas、Woven Capital – 丰田成长基金、Incharge Capital、Magnetar、AV 和 NewSpace Capital 参与，此外还通过美国进出口银行 (EXIM) 和摩根大通提供了 1 亿美元的债务融资。

paras.en: The new capital will support advanced technologies, expansion of U.S. manufacturing capacity, development and production of next-generation spacecraft, Synchronicity deployment, and international growth.
paras.zh: 新资金将支持先进技术、美国制造能力的扩张、下一代航天器的开发和生产、同步部署和国际增长。

paras.en: “For nearly a decade, we have invested in the engineering, intellectual property, manufacturing infrastructure, and the talented people required to build an enduring space technology company,” said Shey Sabripour, Founder and CEO of CesiumAstro. “With our technology proven on orbit, on the ground and in the air, a significantly expanded set of capabilities, and more than $1.2 billion in new capital raised this year, we are positioned to take the next major step in our growth.”
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 创始人兼首席执行官 Shey Saripour 表示：“近十年来，我们在工程、知识产权、制造基础设施和人才方面进行了投资，以建立一家持久的太空技术公司。” “凭借我们在轨道、地面和空中验证的技术、显着扩展的能力以及今年筹集的超过 12 亿美元的新资本，我们已准备好在增长方面迈出下一个重大步骤。”

paras.en: “Shey Sabripour is an extraordinary entrepreneur, and CesiumAstro is poised to revolutionize the space communications industry. This industry is at an inflection point; legacy solutions are not equipped for the demands of today’s customers,” said Aaron Schaechterle, Portfolio Manager, Janus Henderson. “When we met Shey and his team, it became clear that CesiumAstro provides transformative technology that is critical to the industry’s future. This investment was originated through the Janus Henderson Ascent platform, which was created to provide private market capital to visionary companies that redefine their industries and to support these companies on the journey from private to public markets.”
paras.zh: Janus Henderson 产品组合经理 Aaron Schaechterle 表示：“Shey Sabripour 是一位杰出的企业家，CesiumAstro 有望彻底改变太空通信行业。这个行业正处于拐点；传统解决方案无法满足当今客户的需求。” “当我们见到 Shey 和他的团队时，我们发现 CesiumAstro 提供的变革性技术对行业的未来至关重要。这项投资源自 Janus Henderson Ascent 平台，该平台的创建是为了向有远见的公司提供私募市场资本，重新定义其行业，并支持这些公司从私募市场走向公开市场。”

paras.en: Introducing Synchronicity: A 737-Satellite, AI-Enabled Constellation
paras.zh: 同步性简介：由 737 颗卫星组成、支持人工智能的星座

paras.en: Synchronicity takes CesiumAstro beyond supplying advanced space technologies and complete spacecraft to developing and operating its own integrated space infrastructure.
paras.zh: 同步性使 CesiumAstro 不仅提供先进的空间技术和完整的航天器，还开发和运营自己的综合空间基础设施。

paras.en: The constellation is designed around a dynamically managed, multi-beam, multi-frequency architecture supporting Ku-, Ka-, and V-band communications, advanced edge compute, and multi-orbit operations. This unified system aims to deliver more flexible, resilient, and adaptable connectivity across a broad range of commercial and national security missions.
paras.zh: 该星座围绕动态管理、多波束、多频率架构设计，支持 Ku、Ka 和 V 频段通信、高级边缘计算和多轨道操作。这个统一的系统旨在为广泛的商业和国家安全任务提供更灵活、有弹性和适应性强的连接。

paras.en: AI is integrated throughout the architecture, enabling network optimization, dynamic allocation of communications resources, and autonomous adaptation to changing mission requirements and operating conditions. Edge processing capabilities are intended to bring compute closer to where data is generated, reducing dependence on terrestrial infrastructure and supporting increasingly time-sensitive applications.
paras.zh: 人工智能集成在整个架构中，可实现网络优化、通信资源的动态分配以及自主适应不断变化的任务要求和操作条件。边缘处理功能旨在使计算更接近数据生成的地方，减少对地面基础设施的依赖并支持对时间日益敏感的应用程序。

paras.en: Unlike architectures assembled from independently sourced components, Synchronicity will leverage CesiumAstro’s vertically integrated technology portfolio, including custom silicon, best-in-class active phased arrays, software-defined payloads, advanced processors, spacecraft, mission software, and terminals for air, ground, mobility, and maritime platforms. This approach enables system-wide performance optimization.
paras.zh: 与由独立采购的组件组装而成的架构不同，Synchronicity 将利用 CesiumAstro 的垂直集成技术组合，包括定制芯片、一流的有源相控阵、软件定义的有效载荷、先进处理器、航天器、任务软件以及空中、地面、移动和海上平台的终端。这种方法可以实现系统范围的性能优化。

paras.en: “Synchronicity is the culmination of the technology stack we have methodically built since CesiumAstro was founded,” said Sabripour. “We designed the silicon, the active phased array, the payload, processors, the spacecraft, ground terminals, and the network as one system. That vertical integration gives us the ability to build capabilities in space that evolve as mission requirements, technology, and operating conditions change.”
paras.zh: “同步性是我们自 CesiumAstro 成立以来有条不紊地构建的技术堆栈的顶峰，”Saripour 说。 “我们将芯片、有源相控阵、有效载荷、处理器、航天器、地面终端和网络设计为一个系统。这种垂直整合使我们能够在太空中构建随着任务要求、技术和操作条件的变化而发展的能力。”

paras.en: Three Strategic Acquisitions Expand CesiumAstro’s Capabilities
paras.zh: 三项战略收购扩大了 CesiumAstro 的能力

paras.en: In the past 12 months, CesiumAstro has brought critical semiconductor, mission software, and artificial intelligence capabilities together through three acquisitions: Jariet Technologies, 1Aardvark, and Vidrovr.
paras.zh: 在过去 12 个月中，CesiumAstro 通过三项收购将关键的半导体、任务软件和人工智能能力整合在一起：Jariet Technologies、1Aardvark 和 Vidrovr。

paras.en: Jariet Technologies — A leading millimeter-wave RF System-on-Chip (RF-SoC) semiconductor company specializing in advanced solutions for satellite communications, electronic warfare, and radar systems. The acquisition strengthens CesiumAstro’s technology portfolio with advanced mixed-signal semiconductors, digital signal processing, and digital beamforming capabilities, enabling greater performance and control across its communications payloads, active phased arrays, and spacecraft.
paras.zh: Jariet Technologies — 一家领先的毫米波射频片上系统 (RF-SoC) 半导体公司，专注于卫星通信、电子战和雷达系统的先进解决方案。此次收购增强了 CesiumAstro 的技术组合，包括先进的混合信号半导体、数字信号处理和数字波束形成功能，从而实现其通信有效载荷、有源相控阵和航天器的更高性能和控制。

paras.en: 1Aardvark — A company specializing in mission software, algorithms, and systems engineering for national defense programs. The acquisition expands CesiumAstro’s autonomous mission capabilities, enabling spacecraft to dynamically respond to changing conditions, operate with greater resilience, and maintain mission effectiveness in contested or connectivity-constrained environments.
paras.zh: 1Aardvark — 一家专门从事国防项目任务软件、算法和系统工程的公司。此次收购扩大了CesiumAstro的自主任务能力，使航天器能够动态响应不断变化的条件，以更大的弹性运行，并在有争议或连接受限的环境中保持任务有效性。

paras.en: Vidrovr — An AI company specializing in real-time multimodal signal analysis. The acquisition accelerates CesiumAstro’s integration of AI into space communications and sensing systems, enabling intelligent RF optimization, autonomous satellite operations, and reconfigurable edge compute across its space and defense platforms.
paras.zh: Vidrovr — 一家专门从事实时多模态信号分析的人工智能公司。此次收购加速了 CesiumAstro 将人工智能集成到空间通信和传感系统中，从而在其空间和国防平台上实现智能射频优化、自主卫星操作以及可重新配置的边缘计算。

paras.en: Element: A Decade of Engineering Proven on Orbit
paras.zh: 元素：在轨道上经过十年验证的工程

paras.en: CesiumAstro successfully launched and began on-orbit operation of Element-1 in October 2026.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 于 2026 年 10 月成功发射 Element-1 并开始在轨运行。

paras.en: Element-1 integrates CesiumAstro’s proprietary communications payloads, active phased array technology, compute systems, and spacecraft engineering in an operational satellite. The mission validates nearly a decade of investment in proprietary intellectual property, specialized engineering expertise, and in-house manufacturing capabilities.
paras.zh: Element-1 在一颗运行卫星中集成了 CesiumAstro 专有的通信有效载荷、有源相控阵技术、计算系统和航天器工程。该任务验证了近十年来在专有知识产权、专业工程专业知识和内部制造能力方面的投资。

paras.en: Element-1 is the first of eight planned spacecraft, with seven more launches secured for the next deployment phase. The Element program also advances CesiumAstro’s space-based edge processing and compute capabilities, enabling data to be processed closer to its source and supporting more intelligent, responsive, and autonomous missions.
paras.zh: Element-1 是计划中的八艘航天器中的第一艘，下一部署阶段还有七次发射。 Element 计划还提升了 CesiumAstro 的天基边缘处理和计算能力，使数据能够在更接近其来源的地方进行处理，并支持更智能、响应更快和自主的任务。

paras.en: Expanding Global Operations and Manufacturing Capacity
paras.zh: 扩大全球运营和制造能力

paras.en: In Texas, CesiumAstro announced a $500 million investment over five years to expand its global headquarters in Austin, including the purchase of 270,000 square feet of advanced manufacturing space. The expansion will support precision electronics and spacecraft manufacturing, engineering, integration, and test, with plans to add 550 jobs and grow the Austin-area workforce to more than 1,000 employees by 2030.
paras.zh: 在德克萨斯州，CesiumAstro 宣布在五年内投资 5 亿美元，以扩建其位于奥斯汀的全球总部，包括购买 270,000 平方英尺的先进制造空间。此次扩建将支持精密电子和航天器制造、工程、集成和测试，计划到 2030 年增加 550 个就业岗位，并将奥斯汀地区的员工人数增加到 1,000 多人。

paras.en: Across the United States, the company is investing hundreds of millions of dollars to expand its engineering, manufacturing, and operational capabilities, with additional facilities in Colorado, California, Alabama, Florida, and the Washington, D.C. area.
paras.zh: 在美国各地，该公司正在投资数亿美元来扩大其工程、制造和运营能力，并在科罗拉多州、加利福尼亚州、阿拉巴马州、佛罗里达州和华盛顿特区设立了额外的工厂。

paras.en: In Europe and Asia, the company is expanding its presence, with operations in the United Kingdom, Germany, Switzerland, Taiwan, Singapore, and Japan.
paras.zh: 在欧洲和亚洲，该公司正在扩大其业务，在英国、德国、瑞士、台湾、新加坡和日本开展业务。

paras.en: These expansions will support scaled production of its communications and sensing systems, advanced compute technologies, and spacecraft, as well as development and deployment of its next-generation space infrastructure.
paras.zh: 这些扩建将支持其通信和传感系统、先进计算技术和航天器的规模生产，以及下一代空间基础设施的开发和部署。

articles.title: Taking a Gander at Utah’s Goosenecks

paras.en: Tens of millions of years ago, the San Juan River in what is now southern Utah shared some characteristics with today's Mississippi River. In a bygone geologic era, the San Juan flowed across a relatively flat plain that formed in an ancient marine environment. Unencumbered by rugged terrain, the river was free to take a long, meandering path on its gradual journey downslope.
paras.zh: 数千万年前，现在犹他州南部的圣胡安河与今天的密西西比河有一些共同的特征。在过去的地质时代，圣胡安河流经在古代海洋环境中形成的相对平坦的平原。河流不受崎岖地形的阻碍，可以自由地沿着一条漫长而蜿蜒的小路缓缓下坡。

paras.en: But this part of the San Juan changed when geologic forces pushed the Colorado Plateau upward. Some experts think that within the later stages of this “still-enigmatic” history, starting around 20 million years ago, the plateau’s rise elevated the San Juan’s headwaters, which increased the river’s gradient and sped its flow. With that, the water’s erosive power intensified, and the river started carving its winding path deeper and deeper through 300-million-year-old rock.
paras.zh: 但当地质力量将科罗拉多高原向上推时，圣胡安河的这一部分发生了变化。一些专家认为，在这段“仍然神秘”的历史后期，从大约2000万年前开始，高原的上升抬高了圣胡安河的源头，从而增加了河流的坡度并加快了水流。随之而来的是，水流的侵蚀力增强了，河流开始在三亿年前的岩石中蜿蜒前行，越陷越深。

paras.en: Today, on its westward path to Lake Powell, the San Juan River flows through an impressive series of entrenched meanders, also known as “goosenecks.” An astronaut aboard the International Space Station photographed the stark desert topography on October 6, 2026.
paras.zh: 如今，圣胡安河在向西流向鲍威尔湖的途中，流经一系列令人印象深刻的根深蒂固的河曲，也称为“鹅颈河”。 2026 年 10 月 6 日，国际空间站上的一名宇航员拍摄了荒凉的沙漠地形。

paras.en: In Utah’s Goosenecks State Park, the river runs through a canyon 1,000 feet (300 meters) deep. In places, it nearly loops back on itself, making horseshoe-shaped bends. One section is so curvy that the river travels 5.5 miles (8.9 kilometers) between two points that are only 1.3 miles (2.1 kilometers) apart as the crow—nay, goose—flies.
paras.zh: 在犹他州的鹅颈州立公园，河流流经 1,000 英尺（300 米）深的峡谷。在某些地方，它几乎会自行绕回，形成马蹄形的弯曲。其中一段非常弯曲，以至于河流在相距仅 1.3 英里（2.1 公里）的两点之间蜿蜒行驶 5.5 英里（8.9 公里）。

paras.en: While the goosenecks are an unusual geologic wonder to behold by day, the area’s dark skies are a spectacle by night. Goosenecks State Park’s remote, high-desert location and 360-degree views of the sky helped earn it an International Dark Sky Park designation in 2021. According to DarkSky International, features such as the Double Cluster in Perseus and the Messier 24 star cloud in the Sagittarius spiral arm of the Milky Way are visible to the unaided eye from the park. In November 2026, dark skies offer the chance to view several meteor showers, with the Northern Taurids, Southern Taurids, and Leonids reaching their peaks throughout the month.
paras.zh: 虽然鹅颈在白天是一个不寻常的地质奇观，但该地区的黑暗天空在夜间却是一个奇观。鹅颈州立公园地处偏远、高沙漠位置，加上 360 度的天空视野，使其在 2021 年获得国际暗夜公园称号。根据 DarkSky International 的说法，从公园肉眼可以看到英仙座双星团和银河系人马座旋臂中的梅西耶 24 星云等特征。 2026 年 11 月，黑暗的天空提供了观看多场流星雨的机会，北金牛座流星雨、南金牛座流星雨和狮子座流星雨在整个月达到顶峰。

paras.en: Astronaut photograph ISS075-E-188830 was acquired on October 6, 2026, with a Nikon Z9 digital camera using a focal length of 400 millimeters. It is provided by the ISS Crew Earth Observations Facility and the Earth Science and Remote Sensing Unit at NASA Johnson Space Center. The image was taken by a member of the Expedition 75 crew. The image has been cropped and enhanced to improve contrast, and lens artifacts have been removed. The International Space Station Program supports the laboratory as part of the ISS National Lab to help astronauts take pictures of Earth that will be of the greatest value to scientists and the public, and to make those images freely available on the internet. Additional images taken by astronauts and cosmonauts can be viewed at the NASA/JSC Gateway to Astronaut Photography of Earth. Photo by Bob Wick (BLM), via Flickr. Story by Lindsey Doermann.
paras.zh: 宇航员照片 ISS075-E-188830 于 2026 年 10 月 6 日使用尼康 Z9 数码相机拍摄，焦距为 400 毫米。它由国际空间站机组人员地球观测设施和美国宇航局约翰逊航天中心的地球科学与遥感部门提供。这张照片是由 Expedition 75 号船员拍摄的。图像经过裁剪和增强以提高对比度，并且镜头伪影已被消除。国际空间站计划支持该实验室作为国际空间站国家实验室的一部分，帮助宇航员拍摄对科学家和公众最有价值的地球照片，并在互联网上免费提供这些图像。宇航员拍摄的其他图像可以在 NASA/JSC 地球宇航员摄影网关查看。摄影：Bob Wick (BLM)，来自 Flickr。林赛·杜尔曼的故事。

articles.title: Syria’s undocumented children ‘pay the price’ of war and a law that shuts out mothers

paras.en: Syria’s undocumented children ‘pay the price’ of war and a law that shuts out mothers
paras.zh: 叙利亚无证儿童为战争和禁止母亲的法律“付出了代价”

paras.en: Many children born in Syria since the war began in 2011 have no legal identity because nationality passes only through fathers – many of whom are dead or missing – a member of the independent UN commission investigating rights violations in the country said on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 负责调查该国侵犯人权行为的联合国独立委员会的一名成员周三表示，自 2011 年战争爆发以来，许多在叙利亚出生的儿童没有合法身份，因为国籍只能通过父亲传递——其中许多人已经死亡或失踪。

paras.en: “A child born in the war did not choose the war, did not choose the enforced disappearance of their father, did not choose their mother’s unregistered marriage...Yet they alone pay the price – in education, in health, in nationality and in dignity,” said Monia Ammar, one of the commissioners on the Independent International Commission of Inquiry on Syria.
paras.zh: “在战争中出生的孩子没有选择战争，没有选择父亲的强迫失踪，没有选择母亲未登记的婚姻……然而，他们独自付出了代价——教育、健康、国籍和尊严，”叙利亚问题独立国际调查委员会委员之一莫妮娅·阿马尔说。

paras.en: Ms. Ammar was speaking at a high-level panel in Geneva, co-hosted with the Syrian Government, as the Commission released a new policy paper on the issue.
paras.zh: 阿马尔女士在日内瓦与叙利亚政府共同主办的高级别小组会议上发表讲话，委员会就此问题发布了一份新的政策文件。

paras.en: She called the lack of documents “among the most serious consequences of the legacy of the conflict”.
paras.zh: 她称缺乏文件是“冲突遗留下来的最严重后果之一”。

paras.en: Syria’s social affairs minister told the same meeting that a reform letting mothers pass on nationality is nearing approval.
paras.zh: 叙利亚社会事务部长在同一次会议上表示，允许母亲继承国籍的改革即将获得批准。

paras.en: The problem is especially acute because an estimated 12 out of every 13 people killed in the war were men.
paras.zh: 这个问题尤其严重，因为据估计，在战争中丧生的每 13 人中就有 12 人是男性。

paras.en: Under Syria’s 1969 nationality law, when the father is absent “the child finds themselves in a legal vacuum”, Ms. Ammar said.
paras.zh: 阿马尔女士说，根据叙利亚 1969 年的国籍法，当父亲缺席时，“孩子就会发现自己处于法律真空”。

paras.en: She described the law as gender-based discrimination that is “doubled for girls”. It is also at odds with Syria’s obligations under the Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination against Women.
paras.zh: 她将该法律描述为基于性别的歧视，“对女孩来说是双重歧视”。这也违背了叙利亚根据《消除对妇女一切形式歧视公约》承担的义务。

paras.en: The Commission has no precise figures on how many children are affected, she said. But it has heard from widows and mothers “who carry their children in their arms and do not have a single piece of paper proving that these children legally exist”.
paras.zh: 她说，委员会没有关于有多少儿童受到影响的确切数字。但它从寡妇和母亲那里听说，“她们怀里抱着孩子，却没有一张纸证明这些孩子合法存在”。

paras.en: They face “a wall of procedures” and social stigma, and many end up giving up.
paras.zh: 他们面临着“程序之墙”和社会耻辱，许多人最终放弃了。

paras.en: Ms. Ammar welcomed the steps the authorities have taken since the fall of the former regime. But she warned that “legal reforms, however important, are not enough on their own” without changes in practice and culture.
paras.zh: 阿马尔女士对前政权倒台后当局采取的措施表示欢迎。但她警告说，如果不改变实践和文化，“法律改革无论多么重要，光靠法律改革是不够的”。

paras.en: The paper calls for every child to be registered whatever the circumstances of their birth, alternative documents to be accepted and nationality granted to children of Syrian mothers.
paras.zh: 该文件呼吁对每个孩子进行登记，无论其出生情况如何，接受替代文件并给予叙利亚母亲的孩子国籍。

paras.en: Syria’s Minister of Social Affairs and Labour, Hind Kabawat, told the story of Maryam, a mother from Dara’a.
paras.zh: 叙利亚社会事务和劳工部长欣德·卡巴瓦特讲述了来自德拉的母亲玛丽亚姆的故事。

paras.en: Maryam was left alone and displaced with two young children after losing her husband in the war. Her marriage had been conducted locally and his death was never officially recorded.
paras.zh: 在战争中失去丈夫后，玛丽亚姆独自一人，带着两个年幼的孩子流离失所。她的婚姻是在当地举行的，他的死亡从未被正式记录。

paras.en: “Under our outdated laws, she cannot pass her Syrian nationality to her children, so in the eyes of the State they became invisible,” the minister said.
paras.zh: “根据我们过时的法律，她无法将叙利亚国籍传给她的孩子，因此在国家眼中他们变得隐形，”部长说。

paras.en: Desperate families sometimes register children under relatives’ names, including maternal uncles, just to get them into school or medical care. Ms. Kabawat said these families deserve support rather than punishment.
paras.zh: 绝望的家庭有时会把孩子登记在亲戚的名下，包括叔叔的名字，只是为了让他们上学或接受医疗。卡巴瓦特女士说，这些家庭应该得到支持而不是惩罚。

paras.en: She called for a legal grace period so they can put the records right.
paras.zh: 她呼吁给予法律宽限期，以便他们能够纠正记录。

paras.en: The proposal now at the approval stage would allow mothers to pass on nationality under certain conditions, “so that no child is punished or left stateless simply because their father is missing, dead or foreign”.
paras.zh: 目前处于批准阶段的提案将允许母亲在一定条件下继承国籍，“这样，孩子就不会因为父亲失踪、死亡或外国人而受到惩罚或成为无国籍人”。

paras.en: Ms. Kabawat stressed that children of ISIL (or Da’esh) fighters should not be held responsible for their fathers’ choices. She repeated the call for countries of origin to take some responsibility for child welfare.
paras.zh: 卡巴瓦特女士强调，“伊斯兰国”（或“达伊沙”）武装分子的子女不应为其父亲的选择负责。她再次呼吁原籍国对儿童福利承担一些责任。

paras.en: Her Government’s aim, she said, is that “Maryam from Dara’a will never again have to wonder whether her children truly belong to the country they were born in.”
paras.zh: 她说，她的政府的目标是“来自德拉的玛丽亚姆再也不用怀疑她的孩子是否真正属于他们出生的国家。”

articles.title: Abyei: Deadly drone strikes mark ‘new and concerning’ threat, UN peacekeeping chief warns

paras.en: Abyei: Deadly drone strikes mark ‘new and concerning’ threat, UN peacekeeping chief warns
paras.zh: 阿卜耶伊：联合国维和部队负责人警告说，致命的无人机袭击标志着“新的、令人担忧的”威胁

paras.en: Drone strikes that killed at least 30 people in Abyei last month have added “a new and concerning dimension” to security in the disputed area, the UN’s peacekeeping chief told the Security Council on Thursday.
paras.zh: 联合国维和事务负责人周四向安理会表示，上个月在阿卜耶伊发动的无人机袭击造成至少 30 人死亡，这给该争议地区的安全带来了“新的、令人担忧的层面”。

paras.en: Jean-Pierre Lacroix said the 19 October attacks were the first of their kind in Abyei. They set off major fires, injured about 59 people and forced dozens of civilians from their homes. Peacekeepers are still checking whether the death toll is an underestimate.
paras.zh: 让-皮埃尔·拉克鲁瓦 (Jean-Pierre Lacroix) 表示，10 月 19 日发生的袭击是阿卜耶伊首次发生此类袭击。他们引发大火，造成约 59 人受伤，并迫使数十名平民离开家园。维和人员仍在检查死亡人数是否被低估。

paras.en: The strikes followed violence on 15 September in and around Amiet Common Market, where clashes involving members of the Ngok Dinka, Misseriya and Nuba communities left 124 people dead and 40 injured.
paras.zh: 此次罢工是在 9 月 15 日阿米特共同市场及其周边发生暴力事件之后发生的，恩哥克-丁卡族、米塞里亚族和努巴族社区成员之间发生冲突，造成 124 人死亡、40 人受伤。

paras.en: Taken together, Mr. Lacroix said, the incidents show that threats to stability in Abyei “are evolving, extending beyond traditional intercommunal dynamics and are increasingly influenced by wider political and economic regional conflicts”.
paras.zh: 拉克鲁瓦先生说，总的来说，这些事件表明，阿卜耶伊的稳定面临的威胁“正在演变，超出了传统的族群间动态，并越来越受到更广泛的政治和经济区域冲突的影响”。

paras.en: Amiet is now much more than a trading post. It is Abyei’s main economic hub and a transit point for more than 49,000 refugees and returnees who have fled the war in Sudan. Mr. Lacroix warned that this concentration of trade and people was opening the door to criminal networks and armed groups.
paras.zh: 阿米特现在不仅仅是一个贸易站。它是阿卜耶伊的主要经济中心，也是 49,000 多名逃离苏丹战争的难民和回返者的中转站。拉克鲁瓦警告说，贸易和人员的集中正在为犯罪网络和武装团体打开大门。

paras.en: He also pointed to real gains. Recorded security incidents fell by about 32 per cent compared with the same period last year, and this year’s seasonal cattle migration passed without a single related death.
paras.zh: 他还指出了实际收益。与去年同期相比，记录的安全事件减少了约32%，今年的季节性牛群迁徙没有发生一起相关死亡事件。

paras.en: Sudan and South Sudan resumed formal talks in August through their Joint Political and Security Mechanism, for the first time since January 2023. A second meeting is due in Khartoum from 8 to 10 November.
paras.zh: 苏丹和南苏丹于 8 月通过联合政治与安全机制恢复了正式会谈，这是自 2023 年 1 月以来的首次。第二次会议将于 11 月 8 日至 10 日在喀土穆举行。

paras.en: But the reported appointment by the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) of its own representative to the Abyei Joint Oversight Committee risks setting up competing claims of authority and drawing the area further into Sudan’s conflict, he said.
paras.zh: 但他表示，据报道，准军事快速支援部队（RSF）在阿卜耶伊联合监督委员会任命了自己的代表，这可能会引发相互竞争的权力主张，并使该地区进一步陷入苏丹冲突。

paras.en: As the council weighs the future mandate of the UN Interim Security Force for Abyei (UNISFA), Mr. Lacroix said the conditions for any major change to the mission’s set-up “do not yet exist”. He called for stronger protection for peacekeepers against aerial threats.
paras.zh: 在安理会权衡联合国阿卜耶伊临时安全部队（联阿安全部队）的未来任务时，拉克鲁瓦先生表示，对该特派团的设置进行任何重大改变的条件“尚不存在”。他呼吁加强保护维和人员免受空中威胁。

paras.en: “UNISFA needs the Council’s support now more than ever,” he said.
paras.zh: “联阿安全部队现在比以往任何时候都更需要安理会的支持，”他说。

paras.en: The Secretary-General’s Special Envoy for the Horn of Africa, Guang Cong, called the October drone strikes one of the deadliest incidents in Abyei’s history. He urged a prompt and independent investigation and called on both governments to uphold the area’s demilitarized status.
paras.zh: 秘书长非洲之角特使丛光称十月份的无人机袭击是阿卜耶伊历史上最致命的事件之一。他敦促立即进行独立调查，并呼吁两国政府维持该地区的非军事地位。

paras.en: In Sudan, Humanitarian Coordinator Denise Brown warned again that drone strikes are hitting power stations and fuel facilities. Where fuel is scarce, she said, lifesaving aid work is being badly affected.
paras.zh: 在苏丹，人道主义协调员丹尼斯·布朗再次警告说，无人机袭击正在袭击发电站和燃料设施。她说，在燃料短缺的地方，救生援助工作就会受到严重影响。

paras.en: According to local sources, drones struck an electricity transmission station and the Ar Rusayris Dam in Ed Damazine on Tuesday, causing widespread blackouts.
paras.zh: 据当地消息人士称，周二，无人机袭击了埃德达马辛的一个输电站和 Ar Rusayris 大坝，导致大范围停电。

paras.en: Another strike on a residential area killed two civilians. The same day, airstrikes in Um Bader killed two women, injured 10 people and badly damaged two water stations.
paras.zh: 另一次对住宅区的袭击造成两名平民死亡。同一天，乌姆巴德的空袭造成两名妇女死亡、十人受伤，两个水站严重受损。

paras.en: Aid is still getting through. The UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) has delivered malaria treatment to 765 health facilities across Darfur and West Kordofan, enough for 800,000 people. But with the year nearly over, the $2.9 billion humanitarian appeal for Sudan is less than half funded.
paras.zh: 援助仍在进行中。联合国儿童基金会 (UNICEF) 已向达尔富尔和西科尔多凡州的 765 个医疗机构提供疟疾治疗，足以满足 80 万人的需要。但随着这一年即将结束，为苏丹筹集的 29 亿美元人道主义援助资金还不到一半。

paras.en: On the Sudan–South Sudan border, the International Organization for Migration (IOM) warned that about 100,000 people could lose healthcare if the only clinic at the Wunthou crossing closes. It could shut by December without urgent funding.
paras.zh: 在苏丹和南苏丹边境，国际移民组织 (IOM) 警告称，如果文图过境点唯一的诊所关闭，大约 10 万人可能会失去医疗服务。如果没有紧急资金，它可能会在 12 月关闭。

paras.en: The clinic has carried out more than 400,000 consultations, given over 260,000 vaccinations and helped deliver more than 1,000 babies. It still sees more than 1,000 outpatients every week.
paras.zh: 该诊所已开展了超过40万次咨询，接种了超过26万次疫苗，并帮助接生了超过1000名婴儿。每周门诊量仍超过1000人次。

articles.title: World News in Brief: Korea tensions mount, UN demands answers over staff death in Yemen, Guterres in Spain, Nepal alert ahead of COP31

paras.en: World News in Brief: Korea tensions mount, UN demands answers over staff death in Yemen, Guterres in Spain, Nepal alert ahead of COP31
paras.zh: 世界新闻简讯：韩国紧张局势升级、联合国要求就也门工作人员死亡、西班牙古特雷斯、尼泊尔在 COP31 之前发出警报作出答复

paras.en: UN Secretary-General António Guterres remains concerned over the situation on the Korean Peninsula, including the potential escalation of tensions across the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ), his Spokesperson said on Thursday.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯的发言人周四表示，他仍然对朝鲜半岛局势感到担忧，包括非军事区（DMZ）紧张局势可能升级。

paras.en: The Secretary-General encouraged the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (DPRK) and neighbouring Republic of Korea – more commonly known as North and South Korea – to resume communication channels, including on the military-to-military level, to avoid unintended accidents or miscalculations, UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric told journalists in New York.
paras.zh: 联合国发言人斯特凡·杜雅里克在纽约对记者表示，秘书长鼓励朝鲜民主主义人民共和国（朝鲜）和邻国大韩民国（通常称为朝鲜和韩国）恢复沟通渠道，包括军事层面的沟通渠道，以避免意外事故或误判。

paras.en: “Diplomatic engagement and renewed dialogue remain the only pathway to reduce tensions and to achieve sustainable peace on the Korean Peninsula,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“外交接触和重新对话仍然是缓解朝鲜半岛紧张局势和实现可持续和平的唯一途径。”

paras.en: Yemen: UN calls for investigation into staffer’s death
paras.zh: 也门：联合国呼吁对工作人员死亡事件进行调查

paras.en: The circumstances surrounding the death of UN staff member Mohammad el Shami, who was arbitrarily detained by the Houthi de facto authorities in Yemen, “raise serious concerns about possible ill-treatment”, the UN said on Thursday.
paras.zh: 联合国周四表示，被也门胡塞事实上的当局任意拘留的联合国工作人员穆罕默德·沙米的死亡情况“引起了人们对可能遭受虐待的严重担忧”。

paras.en: Theses include the Houthis’ prolonged failure to disclose reliable information about his fate and well-being, Mr. Dujarric said.
paras.zh: 杜贾里克先生说，这些问题包括胡塞武装长期以来未能透露有关他的命运和福祉的可靠信息。

paras.en: He called for a prompt, independent, impartial and transparent investigation into the exact time, cause and circumstances of Mr. el Shami’s death.
paras.zh: 他呼吁对沙米先生死亡的确切时间、原因和情况进行迅速、独立、公正和透明的调查。

paras.en: It should cover the conditions of his detention, whether he received adequate and timely medical care, and why his family and the UN were not promptly informed, Mr. Dujarric continued.
paras.zh: 杜哈里克先生继续说，其中应涵盖他的拘留条件、他是否得到充分和及时的医疗护理，以及为什么他的家人和联合国没有得到及时通知。

paras.en: Those responsible must be identified and held to account, he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，必须查明责任人并追究其责任。

paras.en: Mr. el Shami is the second UN colleague to die while arbitrarily detained by Houthi forces, raising grave concerns for all other UN and humanitarian personnel held in similar conditions – particularly those with serious medical conditions.
paras.zh: 沙米先生是第二位在胡塞武装任意拘留期间死亡的联合国同事，这引起了所有其他处于类似条件下的联合国和人道主义人员的严重关切，特别是那些患有严重疾病的人员。

paras.en: The UN called on Houthi leadership to provide verifiable information on all detainees’ whereabouts and health, and to release all arbitrarily detained UN personnel immediately and unconditionally.
paras.zh: 联合国呼吁胡塞领导人提供有关所有被拘留者下落和健康状况的可核实信息，并立即无条件释放所有被任意拘留的联合国人员。

paras.en: Meanwhile, nearly 135,000 people are now displaced within Taiz, more than 40 per cent of all those recently uprooted across Yemen.
paras.zh: 与此同时，塔伊兹境内目前有近 135,000 人流离失所，占也门最近背井离乡人数的 40% 以上。

paras.en: On Wednesday, the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) delivered four trucks of essential medical supplies, including surgical kits, to hospitals in the encircled city.
paras.zh: 周三，红十字国际委员会向被包围城市的医院运送了四卡车的基本医疗用品，其中包括手术包。

paras.en: The World Food Programme (WFP) and its partners launched an emergency meals initiative using locally sourced ingredients, initially aiming to reach 2,000 vulnerable families across three districts.
paras.zh: 世界粮食计划署 ​​(WFP) 及其合作伙伴发起了一项使用当地食材的紧急膳食计划，最初旨在为三个地区的 2,000 个弱势家庭提供帮助。

paras.en: Shelter partners have so far provided emergency shelter to about 5,600 displaced families, just over one in ten of the more than 51,000 families displaced since August.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，庇护所合作伙伴已为约 5,600 个流离失所家庭提供了紧急庇护所，仅占 8 月份以来超过 51,000 个流离失所家庭的十分之一。

paras.en: Guterres warns of AI shaped by ‘a handful of companies’
paras.zh: 古特雷斯警告人工智能由“少数公司”塑造

paras.en: Addressing the 30th Ibero-American Summit in Madrid on Thursday, Mr. Guterres called for artificial intelligence “that speaks with all our voices – without a handful of companies deciding what we see, read and believe.”
paras.zh: 古特雷斯周四在马德里举行的第 30 届伊比利亚美洲峰会上发表讲话，呼吁人工智能“代表我们所有人的声音——而不是由少数公司决定我们所看到的、读到的和相信的内容。”

paras.en: “The more capable machines become, the more we will need what makes us human,” he said, urging more arts and humanities in education to cultivate critical thinking.
paras.zh: 他说：“机器的能力越强，我们就越需要人类的本质。”他敦促教育中更多的艺术和人文学科来培养批判性思维。

paras.en: The summit brings together the Spanish and Portuguese-speaking countries of Latin America and Europe, and was first held in Guadalajara, Mexico, 35 years ago.
paras.zh: 该峰会汇集了拉丁美洲和欧洲的西班牙语和葡萄牙语国家，35年前首次在墨西哥瓜达拉哈拉举行。

paras.en: “Ibero-America is not a military or economic superpower, but it is a cultural superpower,” the Secretary-General said.
paras.zh: “伊比利亚美洲不是军事或经济超级大国，但它是文化超级大国，”秘书长说。

paras.en: Mr. Guterres hosted the summit in Porto 28 years ago, and used this year’s address to bid farewell, thanking leaders for their friendship and support during his 10-year term.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯先生28年前在波尔图主办峰会，并在今年的致辞中告别，感谢各国领导人在他10年任期内的友谊和支持。

paras.en: Nepal floods: UN urges global support ahead of COP31
paras.zh: 尼泊尔洪水：联合国在 COP31 之前敦促全球支持

paras.en: Nepal needs international solidarity to recover from catastrophic floods that struck 10 weeks ago, the top UN official in the country said on Thursday, ahead of the COP31 climate conference in Antalya, Türkiye.
paras.zh: 周四，在土耳其安塔利亚举行的 COP31 气候会议之前，尼泊尔驻尼泊尔高级官员表示，尼泊尔需要国际团结来从 10 周前发生的灾难性洪水中恢复过来。

paras.en: On 26 August, a glacier collapsed on the border with China’s Tibet Autonomous Region. UN Resident Coordinator Lila Pieters Yahia described the “awful wall of water, mud and heavy rock” which tore through 150 kilometres of Himalayan valleys.
paras.zh: 8月26日，中国西藏自治区边境的一座冰川崩塌。联合国驻地协调员莉拉·皮特斯·叶海亚 (Lila Pieters Yahia) 描述了“可怕的水、泥和重石墙”，它撕裂了 150 公里的喜马拉雅山谷。

paras.en: More than 1,450 people were killed, nearly 5,000 remain missing and over 84,000 were affected. Homes, schools, power grids and 115 bridges were damaged.
paras.zh: 超过 1,450 人死亡，近 5,000 人失踪，超过 84,000 人受到影响。房屋、学校、电网和 115 座桥梁遭到破坏。

paras.en: The World Bank puts the damage at $2.7 billion, and recovery will cost an estimated $4.7 billion. The authorities say the $21.5 million Nepal expects from the loss and damage fund falls far short.
paras.zh: 世界银行估计损失为 27 亿美元，恢复成本估计为 47 亿美元。当局表示，尼泊尔期望从损失和损害基金中获得的 2150 万美元远远低于预期。

paras.en: Ms. Pieters Yahia said many women who lost their husbands now support whole households, often while facing heavy debt.
paras.zh: 彼得斯·叶海亚女士表示，许多失去丈夫的女性现在要养活整个家庭，但往往还面临沉重的债务。

paras.en: Nepal and Bhutan want the needs of mountainous countries put on the COP31 agenda.
paras.zh: 尼泊尔和不丹希望将山区国家的需求列入 COP31 议程。

articles.title: Hearts bruised by Thun in self-inflicted Conference League defeat

paras.en: FC Thun vs Hearts; UEFA Conference League
paras.zh: 图恩FC vs 红心队；欧洲足联会议联赛

paras.en: FC Thun vs Hearts. UEFA Conference League.
paras.zh: 图恩队 vs 红心队。欧洲足联会议联赛。

paras.en: Thun 3-1 Hearts: Wouter Vrancken's side bruised by self-inflicted Conference League defeat
paras.zh: 图恩 3-1 哈茨：沃特·弗兰肯的球队因自己造成的分区联赛失利而受伤

paras.en: Report as Hearts lose 3-1 to Thun in the Conference League; Jamie McCart's own goal was the first of the errors; Stephen Kingsley gifted another; Stuart Findlay scored a late consolation; the Jambos have one point from their opening three games
paras.zh: 报道称哈茨队在分区联赛中以 3-1 输给图恩队；杰米·麦卡特的乌龙球是第一个失误；史蒂芬·金斯利（Stephen Kingsley）赠送了另一件礼物；斯图尔特·芬德利 (Stuart Findlay) 在最后时刻取得了安慰； Jambos 在前三场比赛中只得一分

paras.en: Depleted Hearts' Conference League bruising was almost totally self-inflicted in a 3-1 defeat by Thun in Switzerland.
paras.zh: 耗尽之心队在瑞士联赛中1-3输给图恩队的比赛中几乎完全是自己造成的。

paras.en: Belgian boss Wouter Vrancken was without 10 players through various ailments and the Scottish team were dealt another blow in the 22nd minute when defender Jamie McCart put through his own goal in calamitous fashion.
paras.zh: 比利时主帅沃特·弗兰肯因各种疾病缺席了10名球员，苏格兰队在第22分钟再次受到打击，后卫杰米·麦卡特以灾难性的方式射入乌龙球。

paras.en: Thun doubled their lead in the 33rd minute through striker Brighton Labeau after more poor defending, this time from skipper Stephen Kingsley - who went off later with an injury - and then Furkan Dursun grabbed a third in the 56th minute before Jambos defender Stuart Findlay reduced the deficit in the 82nd minute with a header.
paras.zh: 图恩在第 33 分钟通过前锋布莱顿·拉博 (Brighton Labeau) 在防守更加糟糕后将领先优势扩大了一倍，这次是队长斯蒂芬·金斯利 (Stephen Kingsley) - 后来他因伤下场 - 然后富尔坎·杜尔森 (Furkan Dursun) 在第 56 分钟获得第三个进球，随后詹博队后卫斯图尔特·芬德利 (Stuart Findlay) 在第 82 分钟用头球缩小了比分差距。

paras.en: Hearts are left with one Conference League point out of nine following a 1-1 home draw against Nordsjaelland and a 2-0 defeat away to Trabzonspor.
paras.zh: 在主场 1-1 战平北西兰、客场 2-0 输给特拉布宗体育后，红心队在联赛联赛中仅积 1 分（满分 9 分）。

paras.en: Thick smoke from a pyro halted the game soon after kick-off but when play resumed after a lengthy delay - there were nine minutes added on at the end of the first half - Hearts winger Josh McPake drew a save from Niklas Steffen with an angled drive that lacked real power.
paras.zh: 开球后不久，烟火冒出的浓烟使比赛暂停，但当比赛在长时间的延误后重新开始时——上半场结束时还剩九分钟——红心队边锋乔什·麦克帕克(Josh McPake)以一记缺乏真正力量的角度射门被尼克拉斯·史蒂芬(Niklas Steffen)扑出。

paras.en: In the 20th minute McPake's effort from 25 yards after he had drifted in from the left had the power but was beaten away by the Thun 'keeper.
paras.zh: 第20分钟，麦克帕克从左侧飘入后25码处射门，但被图恩门将挡出。

paras.en: There appeared to be nothing untoward on the horizon but then came a Hearts horror show.
paras.zh: 地平线上似乎没有什么不愉快的事情，但随后出现了红心恐怖秀。

paras.en: There was no real pressure on the Jambos goal when a long ball came into the box but with Lucien Dahler at his shoulder, a simple pass back from McCart somehow evaded Hearts 'keeper Beau Reus and slipped into the corner of the net.
paras.zh: 当长传球进入禁区时，詹博斯的球门并没有受到真正的压力，但卢西恩·达勒在他的肩膀上，麦卡特的一个简单的回传不知何故避开了哈茨队的门将博·雷乌斯并滑入网角。

paras.en: Thun's second goal was also gift-wrapped.
paras.zh: 图恩的第二个进球也被视为礼物。

paras.en: The home side broke clear and with pace following a Heart set-piece and when Nils Reichmuth crossed into the box from the right, Kingsley stuck out a leg to clear but the ball went straight to Labeau who swept it into the net from 10 yards out.
paras.zh: 主队在红心定位球后迅速破门，当尼尔斯·赖希穆斯(Nils Reichmuth)从右侧传入禁区时，金斯利伸出一条腿解围，但皮球直接传给了拉博(Labeau)，拉博在10码外将球扫入网内。

paras.en: Dursun was shown a yellow card for a forearm challenge into the face of Findlay, and it perhaps deserved more punishment.
paras.zh: 杜尔松因前臂对抗芬德利而被出示黄牌，也许应该受到更多惩罚。

paras.en: The interval gave the Tynecastle side time to reset but, three minutes after the break, Reus made a diving save from Dursun and an even better one from Reichmuth moments later.
paras.zh: 中场休息给了泰恩卡斯尔队重新调整的时间，但中场休息后三分钟，罗伊斯扑出了杜尔松的一次鱼跃扑救，随后赖希穆特又做出了一次更好的扑救。

paras.en: However, the 'keeper was beaten once again when Dursun got his toe to a Reichmuth cross.
paras.zh: 然而，当杜尔松用脚尖碰到赖希穆特的传中时，守门员再次被击败。

paras.en: On the hour mark, Nico Maier raced clear of the Hearts defence but although his chip beat Reus, it sped wide of the target.
paras.zh: 比赛进行到一小时时，尼科·迈尔突破了红心队的防守，但尽管他的射门击败了罗伊斯，但还是偏离了目标。

paras.en: The night got worse for the rattled visitors as injured Kingsley was replaced by 19-year-old Matthew Gillies, called back from a loan spell at Stenhousemuir.
paras.zh: 对于惊慌失措的客队来说，这个夜晚变得更糟，受伤的金斯利被 19 岁的马修·吉利斯取代，他从斯滕豪斯缪尔租借回来。

paras.en: Malachi Fagan-Walcott's header from a Jordi Altena free-kick was brilliantly saved by Steffen.
paras.zh: 马拉奇·法根-沃尔科特接到约尔迪·阿尔特纳的任意球头球攻门，被斯特芬精彩扑出。

paras.en: In the 78th minute Jan Bamert had the ball in the net after Steffen tipped a free-kick from substitute Nassim Zoukit on to the bar but was ruled offside, before Findlay headed in a consolation from another Altena free-kick.
paras.zh: 第78分钟，斯特芬将替补纳西姆·祖基特的任意球踢到横梁上，扬·巴默特将球射入网内，但被判越位，随后芬德利从阿尔特纳的另一个任意球中头球安慰。

paras.en: Vrancken demands unity as Hearts seek to bounce back
paras.zh: 弗兰肯要求团结，红心队寻求反弹

paras.en: "We have to stick together now. We know which situation we're in with all the circumstances.
paras.zh: “我们现在必须团结在一起。我们知道在所有情况下我们所处的情况。

paras.en: "And there's only one thing that you have to do now and that is stick together and keep working hard.
paras.zh: “你现在要做的只有一件事，那就是团结一致，继续努力。

paras.en: "In general, it was not good enough in quality and can you blame them?
paras.zh: “总的来说，它的质量不够好，你能责怪他们吗？

paras.en: "Yeah, on one hand you can because you want to always expect the best and want the best.
paras.zh: “是的，一方面你可以，因为你总是希望得到最好的并且想要最好的。

paras.en: "On the other hand, I'm still proud of what they did already in the run-up games."
paras.zh: “另一方面，我仍然为他们在助跑比赛中所做的事情感到自豪。”

articles.title: A new era for women's golf! What is the WTGL and how will it work?

paras.en: Women's TGL golf explained - how does WTGL work? Format, teams, schedule, scoring and how to watch live on Sky Sports
paras.zh: 女子 TGL 高尔夫解释 - WTGL 如何运作？赛制、球队、赛程、计分以及如何观看天空体育直播

paras.en: Five teams of LPGA Tour stars feature in the inaugural WTGL season, including Solheim Cup stars Charley Hull and Lottie Woad; all matches played at a custom-built indoor venue; watch every match exclusively live on Sky Sports Golf
paras.zh: 五支由 LPGA 巡回赛明星组成的球队将参加首届 WTGL 赛季，其中包括索尔海姆杯明星查理·赫尔 (Charley Hull) 和洛蒂·沃德 (Lottie Woad)；所有比赛均在定制的室内场地进行；独家观看天空体育高尔夫直播的每场比赛

paras.en: What is the WTGL, how does the format work and which players are involved? We take a closer look at what to expect ahead of the inaugural women's TGL season, live on Sky Sports…
paras.zh: 什么是 WTGL，其赛制如何运作以及涉及哪些选手？我们在天空体育直播中仔细研究了首届女子 TGL 赛季之前的预期……

paras.en: The WTGL follows on from the success of the Tomorrow's Golf League (TGL), founded by Tiger Woods and Rory McIlroy's TMRW Sports, in partnership with the PGA Tour.
paras.zh: WTGL 是继泰格·伍兹 (Tiger Woods) 和罗里·麦克罗伊 (Rory McIlroy) 的 TMRW Sports 与 PGA 巡回赛合作创办的明天高尔夫联盟 (TGL) 的成功之后的又一赛事。

paras.en: The women's edition of the tech-infused golf league will see LPGA Tour stars feature in a unique team format, with five teams (representing five different cities) of five-player rosters confirmed for the inaugural season.
paras.zh: 在充满科技的女子高尔夫联赛中，LPGA 巡回赛明星将以独特的球队形式亮相，首个赛季将确定五支球队（代表五个不同城市）的五名球员名单。

paras.en: - Women's TGL: Line-ups confirmed for inaugural season
paras.zh: - 女子 TGL：首赛季阵容已确定

paras.en: - Get the latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract
paras.zh: - 获取最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播

paras.en: - What golf is live on Sky Sports and when? Full TV listings
paras.zh: - 天空体育直播哪些高尔夫比赛以及何时直播？完整电视节目表

paras.en: The season-long competition takes place across November and December at the SoFi Center in Florida, a purpose-built indoor venue, with every shot live and all the players mic'd up for the made-for-TV format.
paras.zh: 整个赛季的比赛于 11 月和 12 月在佛罗里达州的 SoFi 中心举行，这是一个专门建造的室内场地，每一个镜头都是现场直播，所有选手都配有麦克风以适应电视格式。

paras.en: Both the 2026 and 2027 editions of WTGL will be broadcast exclusively on Sky Sports as part of an expansion of its golf rights, which also includes a further two years of TGL presented by SoFi.
paras.zh: 作为扩大其高尔夫转播权的一部分，2026 年和 2027 年的 WTGL 都将在天空体育独家转播，其中还包括由 SoFi 提供的另外两年的 TGL。

paras.en: Every match will be exclusively live on Sky Sports Golf, Sky Sports+ or Sky Sports Mix, while repeats will be available the following day on Sky Sports Golf. You can also download the Sky Sports App for news, highlights, scores and reports.
paras.zh: 每场比赛都将在天空体育高尔夫、天空体育+或天空体育混合上独家直播，而次日将在天空体育高尔夫上重复播放。您还可以下载天空体育应用程序以获取新闻、亮点、比分和报告。

paras.en: Around 1,500 spectators will be able to fit around TGL's field of play - which is nearly 100 yards long and 50 yards wide, with matches a hybrid of virtual and real-time golf.
paras.zh: TGL 的球场长近 100 码，宽 50 码，可容纳约 1,500 名观众，比赛采用虚拟和实时高尔夫相结合的方式进行。

paras.en: Specially created holes start in the virtual world, with players hitting into a giant 64 x 53ft simulator that is powered by Full Swing, although shots are played from areas with real grass, fairway, rough and sand.
paras.zh: 专门创建的球洞从虚拟世界开始，玩家击球进入一个由 Full Swing 驱动的巨大 64 x 53 英尺模拟器，尽管击球是在有真实草地、球道、长草区和沙地的区域进行的。

paras.en: Shots from inside 50 yards are from a custom-built short game area inside the SoFi Center, with the 'GreenZone' having a 41-yard turntable that can rotate the green and change angles of the shots required.
paras.zh: 50 码内的击球是在 SoFi 中心内定制的短杆区进行的，“GreenZone”有一个 41 码的转盘，可以旋转果岭并改变所需的击球角度。

paras.en: Teams play 15 holes of golf each match, divided into two sessions, with nine holes of triples - three against three playing alternate shot - and six holes of head-to-head singles golf.
paras.zh: 各队每场比赛打 15 洞高尔夫球，分为两节，其中包括 9 洞三人赛（三对三交替击球）和 6 洞面对面的单打高尔夫球。

paras.en: In the singles format, each of the three players involved in a team play two matches each. Each hole in both sessions is worth one point and the team with the fewest shots on a hole wins the point.
paras.zh: 在单打赛制中，每队的三名球员每人打两场比赛。两场比赛的每个洞都得一分，每洞击球数最少的球队获胜。

paras.en: The use of 'The Hammer' increases the value of a hole by one, with each team having three a match to use. If the team throws the Hammer mid-hole and the opposition rejects it, the hole is automatically conceded. The maximum a hole can be worth is three points if both teams throw a Hammer on the same hole and each is accepted.
paras.zh: 使用“锤子”可以将一洞的价值增加一洞，每支球队在一场比赛中可以使用三个洞。如果球队在洞中投掷铁锤而对手拒绝投掷，则该洞自动认输。如果两队都在同一个洞上投掷锤子并且各自被接受，则该洞的最高得分为三分。

paras.en: A shot clock limits teams to 40 seconds to play a shot, while each team has a limited number of timeouts they can use in each match. If tied after 15 holes, overtime is a three-vs-three closest-to-the-pin competition to decide a winner.
paras.zh: 进攻时钟将球队的进攻时间限制为 40 秒，而每支球队在每场比赛中可以使用的暂停次数也有限。如果 15 洞后打成平手，加时赛将采用三对三最接近的比赛来决出胜负。

paras.en: All five of the WTGL teams also feature in TGL, which begins its third season on December 27 and is also live on Sky Sports.
paras.zh: WTGL 的所有五支球队也在 TGL 中亮相，TGL 的第三个赛季将于 12 月 27 日开始，天空体育也进行直播。

paras.en: The inaugural season features 10 regular-season matches and each team playing the others in a round-robin format, with the top four then progressing to the semi-finals.
paras.zh: 首个赛季有 10 场常规赛，每支球队都以循环赛的形式与其他球队比赛，排名前四的球队将进入半决赛。

paras.en: The WTGL standings, like the men's equivalent, use a points-based system that includes two points for a match win and one point for a loss in overtime.
paras.zh: WTGL 积分榜与男子积分榜一样，采用积分制，比赛获胜得两分，加时赛输掉一分。

paras.en: A four-day post-season sees semi-finals played across successive days on December 20 and 21, before the best-of-three finals start a day later to decide the first WTGL champion.
paras.zh: 季后赛为期四天，半决赛于 12 月 20 日至 21 日连续几天进行，一天后开始进行三局两胜决赛，决出第一个 WTGL 冠军。

articles.title: Fagnano's first NFL start ends in heavy Ravens defeat to Jaguars

paras.en: Jacksonville Jaguars 33-10 Baltimore Ravens: Joe Fagnano throws two interceptions as Ravens suffer heavy loss
paras.zh: 杰克逊维尔美洲虎队 33-10 巴尔的摩乌鸦队：乔·法格纳诺两次拦截，乌鸦队损失惨重

paras.en: Baltimore Ravens' third quarterback of the season, rookie Joe Fagnano, throws for just 60 yards and two interceptions in his first NFL start as the Baltimore Ravens (4-5) suffer a fourth straight loss at home to the Jacksonville Jaguars (6-2) on Thursday night
paras.zh: 巴尔的摩乌鸦队本赛季的第三个四分卫新秀乔·法格纳诺在他的第一次 NFL 首发中仅传出 60 码并被两次拦截，周四晚上巴尔的摩乌鸦队 (4-5) 在主场连续第四次输给杰克逊维尔美洲虎队 (6-2)

paras.en: Joe Fagnano had a forgettable first NFL start as the Baltimore Ravens quarterback - their third of the season - threw for just 60 yards and had two interceptions as the Jacksonville Jaguars earned a convincing 33-10 road win on Thursday night.
paras.zh: 巴尔的摩乌鸦队四分卫乔·法格纳诺 (Joe Fagnano) 的首次 NFL 首发令人难忘，他是巴尔的摩乌鸦队 (Baltimore Ravens) 本赛季的第三个四分卫，他的传球仅 60 码，并被两次拦截，杰克逊维尔美洲虎队 (Jacksonville Jaguars) 在周四晚上以 33-10 取得了令人信服的客场胜利。

paras.en: Fagnano came in due to Lamar Jackson and backup Tyler Huntley both being injured, with the 25-year-old rookie finding things a big struggle as Baltimore (4-5) lost a fourth straight on the season.
paras.zh: 法格纳诺因拉马尔·杰克逊和替补泰勒·亨特利双双受伤而上场，这位 25 岁的新秀在巴尔的摩 (4-5) 本赛季遭遇四连败的情况下陷入了困境。

paras.en: With their top two quarterbacks on injured reserve, the Ravens now await Jacoby Brissett's arrival in a trade from the Arizona Cardinals as they try to prevent their season from falling apart.
paras.zh: 由于两名顶级四分卫都处于伤病储备名单中，乌鸦队现在等待着来自亚利桑那红雀队的雅各比·布里塞特的到来，他们试图阻止他们的赛季崩溃。

paras.en: Jacksonville (6-2) did not need to do anything extraordinary to beat a badly weakened Baltimore team. Trevor Lawrence threw for 242 yards and a touchdown as the Jags won their fifth in their last six to take further command of the AFC South.
paras.zh: 杰克逊维尔（6-2）不需要做任何非凡的事情就可以击败实力严重削弱的巴尔的摩队。特雷弗·劳伦斯 (Trevor Lawrence) 传球 242 码并达阵，美洲虎队在过去六场比赛中取得第五场胜利，进一步掌控了亚足联南部赛场。
