articles.title: 'Multitude of factors' behind firing of chef who refused pineapple on pizza

paras.en: The owner of a Brisbane restaurant that fired a chef who refused to put pineapple on a pizza says it was not the "one defining factor" behind the decision.
paras.zh: 布里斯班一家餐馆解雇了一名拒绝在披萨上放菠萝的厨师，餐馆老板表示，这并不是该决定背后的“一个决定性因素”。

paras.en: Italian chef Davide Tamburella made headlines after he lodged an unfair dismissal claim, alleging it was offensive to his culture to put pineapple on a pizza.
paras.zh: 意大利厨师 Davide Tamburella 在提出不公平解雇索赔后成为头条新闻，他声称将菠萝放在披萨上是对他的文化的冒犯。

paras.en: The claim was knocked back by the Fair Work Commission this week.
paras.zh: 这一主张本周被公平工作委员会驳回。

paras.en: Mr Tamburella was fired from the now-closed La Costa restaurant in Fortitude Valley in May, following a meeting with management.
paras.zh: 今年 5 月，坦布雷拉先生在与管理层会面后，被毅力谷现已关闭的 La Costa 餐厅解雇。

paras.en: La Costa owner Elliot Ingram said on social media that there were a "multitude of different factors" that went into the decision to fire Mr Tamburella.
paras.zh: La Costa 老板埃利奥特·英格拉姆 (Elliot Ingram) 在社交媒体上表示，解雇坦布雷拉的决定是由“多种不同因素”决定的。

paras.en: "It did contribute to the overall decision of termination, based on a customer's request that we thought was reasonable, but it was more about the other things in the background that were happening."
paras.zh: “根据我们认为合理的客户要求，它确实促成了整体终止决定，但更多的是与后台正在发生的其他事情有关。”

paras.en: In its ruling released this week, the commission noted it was the third time in four years that Mr Tamburella had refused the request.
paras.zh: 在本周发布的裁决中，该委员会指出，这是坦布雷拉先生四年来第三次拒绝这一请求。

paras.en: It also noted that reasons for his dismissal included his "acknowledged used of inappropriate language" and "ongoing concerns regarding leadership behaviour, professionalism".
paras.zh: 它还指出，他被解雇的原因包括他“承认使用了不当语言”和“对领导行为和专业精神的持续担忧”。

paras.en: Mr Ingram said the request was from a customer who was celebrating their birthday at the restaurant.
paras.zh: 英格拉姆表示，这一请求是一位正在餐厅庆祝生日的顾客提出的。

paras.en: "Being in Australia, having pineapple on pizza is very common," he said.
paras.zh: “在澳大利亚，披萨上加菠萝是很常见的，”他说。

paras.en: "With Italians they're very traditional when it comes to their food, especially pizza.
paras.zh: “意大利人的食物非常传统，尤其是披萨。

paras.en: "But at the end of the day we're not in Italy, we're in Australia."
paras.zh: “但最终我们不是在意大利，而是在澳大利亚。”

paras.en: The commission also heard Mr Tamburella had injured his hand and fractured two bones in his right hand after he struck a metal handrail while at work.
paras.zh: 该委员会还获悉，坦布雷拉先生在工作时撞到金属扶手后，手部受伤，右手两块骨头骨折。

paras.en: The commission found Mr Tamburella had submitted his application more than 21 days after being fired and did not find exceptional circumstances allowing for an extension of time.
paras.zh: 委员会发现 Tamburella 先生是在被解雇 21 天后提交申请的，并且没有发现允许延长时间的特殊情况。

articles.title: Alleged kitchen knife murderer Conor O’Neill denied bail
articles.author: Matt Garrick

paras.en: Alleged kitchen knife murderer Conor O’Neill denied bail over death of his partner
paras.zh: 涉嫌菜刀杀人犯康纳·奥尼尔因搭档死亡而被拒绝保释

paras.en: Conor O'Neill, 40, has been denied bail after being charged with murder following the death of his partner.
paras.zh: 40 岁的康纳·奥尼尔 (Conor O'Neill) 在伴侣死亡后被指控犯有谋杀罪，目前被拒绝保释。

paras.en: Mr O'Neill is alleged to have stabbed his 47-year-old partner twice while driving in the Darwin satellite city of Palmerston.
paras.zh: 奥尼尔被指控在达尔文卫星城市帕默斯顿开车时两次刺伤了他 47 岁的伴侣。

paras.en: The case is due to return to court next month, with Mr O'Neill's lawyer saying he will likely argue "defensive conduct" at trial.
paras.zh: 此案将于下个月返回法庭，奥尼尔的律师表示，奥尼尔可能会在审判中就“防御行为”进行辩护。

articles.title: Drug driver jailed for crash that resulted in premature baby death
articles.author: Charmaine Manuel

paras.en: Andrew Dean Robson, 35, has been sentenced to seven years in jail for a crash that resulted in the death of a premature baby in Albury in 2025.
paras.zh: 35 岁的安德鲁·迪恩·罗布森 (Andrew Dean Robson) 因 2025 年奥尔伯里发生的车祸导致一名早产儿死亡，被判处七年监禁。

paras.en: He crashed head-on with a car being driven by a pregnant 19-year-old learner driver who was accompanied by her driving instructor.
paras.zh: 他与一辆由一名怀孕的 19 岁学车司机驾驶的汽车正面相撞，该车由一名驾驶教练陪同。

paras.en: Robson will be eligible for parole in less than three years.
paras.zh: 罗布森将在不到三年的时间内获得假释资格。

paras.en: A man who was high on methamphetamine when he crashed into a pregnant learner driver has been jailed for seven years over the death of her baby.
paras.zh: 一名男子因吸食冰毒而撞上一名怀孕的学车司机，因导致婴儿死亡而被判入狱七年。

paras.en: Warning: This story mentions suicide and other details readers might find confronting.
paras.zh: 警告：这个故事提到了自杀和读者可能会遇到的其他细节。

paras.en: Andrew Dean Robson, 35, was driving on the wrong side of an Albury street on February 21, 2025, when he crashed head-on with the car driven by 19-year-old Angel Fewster, who was 27 weeks pregnant at the time.
paras.zh: 2025 年 2 月 21 日，35 岁的安德鲁·迪恩·罗布森 (Andrew Dean Robson) 在奥尔伯里 (Albury) 街道上逆行行驶，与当时怀孕 27 周的 19 岁女孩安吉尔·法斯特 (Angel Fewster) 驾驶的汽车迎面相撞。

paras.en: Ms Fewster, who was accompanied by her driving instructor Dominic Summers, was rushed to hospital after the crash where her baby, Casey, was born by emergency caesarean.
paras.zh: 事故发生后，法斯特女士在驾驶教练多米尼克·萨默斯 (Dominic Summers) 的陪同下被送往医院，她的孩子凯西 (Casey) 通过紧急剖腹产出生。

paras.en: She was flown with her baby to Melbourne where it became apparent the child had experienced terrible brain damage, a NSW District Court was told.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州地方法院获悉，她带着孩子飞往墨尔本，孩子显然遭受了严重的脑损伤。

paras.en: Robson, from Deniliquin, was initially charged with manslaughter, but later pleaded guilty to dangerous driving occasioning death, dangerous driving occasioning grievous bodily harm and drug driving.
paras.zh: 来自德尼利昆的罗布森最初被指控犯有过失杀人罪，但后来承认危险驾驶导致死亡、危险驾驶导致严重身体伤害和毒驾罪。

paras.en: He was today sentenced to seven years in jail with a non-parole period of four-and-a-half years.
paras.zh: 他今天被判处七年监禁，四年半不得假释。

paras.en: In sentencing, held at Sydney's Downing Centre Local and District Court, Judge Nanette Williams referred to victim impact statements previously tendered to the court.
paras.zh: 在悉尼唐宁中心地方和地方法院举行的量刑中，纳内特·威廉姆斯法官提到了之前向法院提交的受害者影响陈述。

paras.en: Ms Fewster's statement included a letter she wrote to Casey before his life support was turned off on February 24, three days after the crash.
paras.zh: Fewster女士的声明包括她在2月24日，即事故发生三天后，凯西的生命维持系统被关闭之前写给凯西的一封信。

paras.en: The court heard Casey had received extensive resuscitation efforts, blood transfusions and had brain haemorrhage and seizures.
paras.zh: 法庭获悉，凯西接受了广泛的复苏努力、输血，并出现脑出血和癫痫发作。

paras.en: Judge Williams said Ms Fewster's letter spoke of the trauma of a mother losing her child, of her anguish and suffering in the days after his death, and that she considered suicide to be with her baby again.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯法官表示，费斯特女士的信谈到了一位母亲失去孩子的创伤，她在孩子去世后几天的痛苦和痛苦，并且她认为自杀是为了再次与孩子在一起。

paras.en: She chose not to take her life "to demonstrate her strength", the judge said.
paras.zh: 法官说，她选择不自杀是“为了展示自己的力量”。

paras.en: Ms Fewster's statement to the court said the crash took away not only her son but "my chance at motherhood, my future, my mental health, my peace".
paras.zh: 法斯特女士向法庭发表的声明称，这场车祸不仅夺走了她的儿子，还夺走了“我成为母亲的机会、我的未来、我的心理健康和我的平静”。

paras.en: Mr Summers, the driving instructor, told the court he experienced "survivor's guilt" and that he was triggered when he saw utes similar to the one driven by Robson.
paras.zh: 驾驶教练萨默斯先生告诉法庭，他经历了“幸存者的负罪感”，当他看到与罗布森驾驶的类似的皮卡车时，他被触发了。

paras.en: The court heard that when police found Robson after the crash, he was anxious, sweaty, with "glassy, bloodshot eyes".
paras.zh: 法庭获悉，当警察在车祸后找到罗布森时，他很焦虑，满头大汗，“眼睛呆滞、布满血丝”。

paras.en: Blood and urine tests found methylamphetamine in his system.
paras.zh: 血液和尿液检查发现他的系统中有甲基苯丙胺。

paras.en: The judge said Robson was remorseful, citing a statement made in which he said: "I wish it was me that had died rather than the baby".
paras.zh: 法官表示罗布森感到悔恨，并援引他的一份声明说：“我希望死的是我而不是婴儿”。

paras.en: Judge Williams noted media coverage of the case had been difficult for Robson, who had the words "baby killer" spray-painted on his front fence.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯法官指出，媒体对此案的报道对罗布森来说很困难，他的前栅栏上喷着“婴儿杀手”的字样。

paras.en: The court heard that Robson had a deprived childhood. His mother, who was addicted to opioids, left when he was an infant, leaving him to be raised by a single parent.
paras.zh: 法庭得知罗布森有一个贫困的童年。他的母亲对阿片类药物上瘾，在他还是婴儿时就离开了，留下他由单亲抚养长大。

paras.en: Robson will be eligible for parole in October 2029.
paras.zh: 罗布森将于 2029 年 10 月获得假释资格。

articles.title: L.A. has a new mayor, and she's a democratic socialist

paras.en: L.A. has a new mayor, and she's a democratic socialist
paras.zh: 洛杉矶有一位新市长，她是一位民主社会主义者

paras.en: Nithya Raman makes L.A. the 4th U.S. city to elect democratic socialist to top job
paras.zh: 尼西亚·拉曼 (Nithya Raman) 使洛杉矶成为美国第四个选举民主社会主义者担任最高职务的城市

paras.en: Nithya Raman, a little-known Los Angeles City Council member backed by the Democratic Socialists of America, has defeated Mayor Karen Bass, an upset that will alter the trajectory of the nation's second-largest city.
paras.zh: 由美国民主社会主义者支持的鲜为人知的洛杉矶市议会议员尼西亚·拉曼 (Nithya Raman) 击败了市长凯伦·巴斯 (Karen Bass)，这一意外事件将改变美国第二大城市的发展轨迹。

paras.en: The India-born Raman's upstart campaign marked a generational shift at city hall as voters followed the lead of New York, where democratic socialist Zohran Mamdani was elected last year. Raman, though, never attracted the same level of national attention and stressed her willingness to break with the progressive party at times during the campaign.
paras.zh: 这位出生于印度的拉曼的竞选活动标志着市政厅的代际转变，选民追随纽约的脚步，去年纽约当选了民主社会主义者佐兰·马姆达尼。然而，拉曼从未引起全国同等程度的关注，并在竞选期间有时强调她愿意与进步党决裂。

paras.en: When she takes office next month, Raman, 45, will join the vanguard of democratic socialists in municipal government. In addition to Mamdani, Janeese Lewis George was elected Tuesday as mayor of Washington, D.C., and Katie Wilson is mayor in Seattle.
paras.zh: 45 岁的拉曼下个月上任后，将加入市政府中民主社会主义者的先锋行列。除马姆达尼外，珍尼斯·刘易斯·乔治周二当选为华盛顿特区市长，凯蒂·威尔逊则当选为西雅图市长。

paras.en: Asked about the success of democratic socialists in mayoral contests, U.S. President Donald Trump said "we'll see what happens" but warned the impact of the changes they make might be irreversible.
paras.zh: 当被问及民主社会主义者在市长竞选中的成功时，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示“我们将看看会发生什么”，但警告说他们所做的改变的影响可能是不可逆转的。

paras.en: "There'll be a point at which if people are unhappy, they'll be changed," Trump said in the Oval Office. "But unfortunately, usually that happens so late that you'll never be able to bring back a city or a country or a state. You know — when it goes too far."
paras.zh: 特朗普在椭圆形办公室表示：“到了某个时候，如果人们不满意，他们就会改变。” “但不幸的是，这种情况通常发生得太晚，以至于你永远无法恢复一座城市、一个国家或一个州。你知道——当事情走得太远的时候。”

paras.en: Raman's entry into the race marked a stunning change of heart after she had initially endorsed Bass, 73, who was once her ally. She said the city had reached a "breaking point" and announced her own candidacy just before the filing deadline.
paras.zh: 拉曼参加竞选标志着她最初支持 73 岁的巴斯（曾经是她的盟友）后，她的心发生了惊人的变化。她表示，该市已经达到了“临界点”，并在申请截止日期前宣布了自己的候选资格。

paras.en: Bass said in a statement that she called Raman to congratulate her on her victory.
paras.zh: 巴斯在一份声明中表示，她致电拉曼祝贺她的胜利。

paras.en: "While this is not the outcome we hoped for, the people of Los Angeles have spoken," Bass said. "I have committed to ensuring a smooth and seamless transition. Moving this city forward is what Los Angeles needs from all of us."
paras.zh: “虽然这不是我们希望的结果，但洛杉矶人民已经发声了，”巴斯说。 “我致力于确保平稳、无缝的过渡。推动这座城市向前发展是洛杉矶需要我们所有人做的事情。”

paras.en: Incumbent mayoral candidate Karen Bass, seen at a news conference in L.A. last week, was defeated in the election. (Jae C. Hong/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 上周在洛杉矶举行的新闻发布会上看到的现任市长候选人凯伦·巴斯在选举中落败。 （Jae C. Hong/美联社）

paras.en: Bass becomes the first Los Angeles mayor in two decades to lose a bid for re-election. Her first term was undone by the deadly Palisades fire, which ignited when she was out of the country and caught the fire department unprepared. The devastation left many voters with the unshakeable feeling that Bass should be held to account, and she never recovered.
paras.zh: 巴斯成为二十年来第一位竞选连任失败的洛杉矶市长。她的第一个任期因致命的帕利塞兹火灾而毁掉，火灾是在她出国时引发的，让消防部门措手不及。这次灾难让许多选民坚定不移地认为巴斯应该承担责任，但她再也没有恢复过来。

paras.en: As votes were being counted earlier this week, Raman delivered an election night speech Tuesday that marked a campaign coda, summing up voters' frustration with a city that seemed to be adrift, and her vision for the future.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候计票时，拉曼周二发表了选举之夜演讲，标志着竞选尾声，总结了选民对这座似乎漂泊不定的城市的挫败感，以及她对未来的愿景。

paras.en: "For too long our broken and unjust status quo has convinced Angelenos that this is the best that we can do," she said. "L.A. stopped being a place where we could build things, where we could open things, where we could film things, where we could create things."
paras.zh: 她说：“长期以来，我们破碎且不公正的现状让洛杉矶人相信，这是我们能做的最好的事情。” “洛杉矶不再是一个我们可以建造东西、可以打开东西、可以拍摄东西、可以创造东西的地方。”

paras.en: She said she would restore "that ambitious Los Angeles, that joyful Los Angeles, that creative Los Angeles, that entrepreneurial Los Angeles."
paras.zh: 她说她将恢复“那个雄心勃勃的洛杉矶、那个快乐的洛杉矶、那个创意的洛杉矶、那个创业的洛杉矶”。

paras.en: Raman's rise came in a year that saw Democratic divisions across the country, with insurgent left-wing candidates challenging establishment rivals.
paras.zh: 拉曼崛起之际，民主党在全国各地出现分歧，叛乱的左翼候选人挑战建制派竞争对手。

paras.en: Raman is promising to oust the police chief, whom she views as too accommodating with federal immigration authorities.
paras.zh: 拉曼承诺罢免警察局长，她认为警察局长对联邦移民当局过于迁就。

paras.en: She also wants to improve basic services that have deteriorated for years, leaving neighbourhoods with dirty, pothole-ridden streets, buckled sidewalks and broken streetlights.
paras.zh: 她还希望改善多年来不断恶化的基本服务，这些服务导致社区街道肮脏坑坑洼洼，人行道弯曲，路灯破损。

paras.en: Ballots are inspected on election day Tuesday. (William Liang/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 周二选举日将对选票进行检查。 （梁威廉/美联社）

paras.en: Raman called Bass's efforts to reduce homelessness ineffective. She's promising a new approach on the crisis that would expand medical teams for people who live in encampments and on the streets in an effort to build trust and eventually bring them indoors.
paras.zh: 拉曼称巴斯减少无家可归者的努力无效。她承诺采取新的应对危机的方法，为居住在营地和街头的人们扩大医疗队伍，努力建立信任并最终将他们带入室内。

paras.en: Raman also wants to provide more housing to move people out of hotels rented by the city for those who are homeless.
paras.zh: 拉曼还希望提供更多住房，让人们搬出市政府为无家可归者租用的酒店。

paras.en: She said her plans could reduce the number of people sleeping in tents and encampments by at least half by 2028, when the city will host the Olympic Games. However, the problem has long proved intractable, despite billions spent in the region.
paras.zh: 她说，她的计划可以到 2028 年该市举办奥运会时，将睡在帐篷和营地中的人数减少至少一半。然而，尽管在该地区花费了数十亿美元，但这个问题长期以来一直被证明是棘手的。

paras.en: Raman was the face of change in a year when voters were restless over long-running problems that persisted under Bass.
paras.zh: 这一年选民们对巴斯领导下持续存在的长期问题感到不安，拉曼代表了变革。

paras.en: A Berkeley IGS/LA Times poll conducted from Oct. 19 to 25 found that about four in 10 likely voters said reducing the number of homeless encampments should be a top priority for the next mayor to address, while about three in 10 said that about ensuring public safety or building more affordable housing.
paras.zh: 伯克利IGS/洛杉矶时报于10月19日至25日进行的一项民意调查发现，大约十分之四的可能选民表示，减少无家可归者营地的数量应该是下一任市长要解决的首要任务，而大约十分之三的人表示，这应该是确保公共安全或建造更多经济适用住房。

paras.en: She was able to overcome criticism from Bass that she was "not ready for primetime" and too inexperienced to run a city with 3.8 million people, and she capitalized on anxiety over the future.
paras.zh: 她克服了巴斯的批评，称她“还没有准备好迎接黄金时段”，而且缺乏管理这座拥有 380 万人口的城市的经验，她利用了对未来的焦虑。

paras.en: "Our city is in crisis," she said in one ad. The ad showed a lectern with no one behind it at the site of a massive warehouse fire from last summer, the homeless epicentre of Skid Row and shuttered malls and storefronts. "Where is our mayor?" Raman asked.
paras.zh: “我们的城市正处于危机之中，”她在一则广告中说道。广告中展示了去年夏天发生的一场大规模仓库火灾现场的一个讲台，后面无人，这里是贫民窟无家可归者的中心，购物中心和店面都已关闭。 “我们的市长在哪儿？”拉曼问道。

paras.en: Bass argued that she made enough progress to merit a second four-year term, and she branded Raman's views on policing and homelessness as "extreme."
paras.zh: 巴斯辩称，她取得了足够的进步，值得连任第二个四年任期，她认为拉曼对治安和无家可归问题的看法“极端”。

paras.en: Raman's victory came despite limited backing from the Democratic establishment. Bass had support from California Gov. Gavin Newsom, former U.S. vice president Kamala Harris and former U.S. House speaker Nancy Pelosi, along with nearly every member of the city council.
paras.zh: 尽管民主党建制派的支持有限，拉曼还是取得了胜利。巴斯得到了加利福尼亚州州长加文·纽瑟姆、美国前副总统卡马拉·哈里斯和前美国众议院议长南希·佩洛西以及几乎所有市议会成员的支持。

paras.en: Bass served in the state legislature and Congress before becoming mayor in 2022 and was under consideration to be former U.S. president Joe Biden's running mate in 2020.
paras.zh: 巴斯在 2022 年成为市长之前曾在州立法机关和国会任职，并被考虑成为美国前总统乔·拜登 2020 年的竞选搭档。

paras.en: In an important signal to the business community, billionaire developer Rick Caruso said he was voting for Bass, but stopped short of formally endorsing the candidate he lost to in the 2022 mayoral race.
paras.zh: 亿万富翁开发商里克·卡鲁索 (Rick Caruso) 表示，他将投票给巴斯，但没有正式支持他在 2022 年市长竞选中输给的候选人，这是向商界发出的一个重要信号。

paras.en: Raman, an urban planner, picked up notable support from advocacy and political groups, including Our Revolution, which was founded by Vermont Sen. Bernie Sanders, and the Sierra Club. But she was thin on endorsements from prominent local politicians.
paras.zh: 拉曼是​​一名城市规划师，他得到了倡导者和政治团体的大力支持，其中包括由佛蒙特州参议员伯尼·桑德斯创立的“我们的革命”和塞拉俱乐部。但她缺乏当地知名政客的支持。

paras.en: She landed a widely publicized private meeting with former governor Arnold Schwarzenegger, who was not involved in the race, that hinted at her efforts to broaden her circle.
paras.zh: 她与未参与竞选的前州长阿诺德·施瓦辛格进行了一次广为人知的私人会面，这暗示了她努力扩大自己的圈子。

paras.en: Expanding her network of allies could be crucial as she begins governing a city that's home to a struggling entertainment industry, a major port, world-class universities and research institutions, and serves as a major tourist destination.
paras.zh: 当她开始管理这座城市时，扩大她的盟友网络可能至关重要。这座城市拥有陷入困境的娱乐业、一个主要港口、世界一流的大学和研究机构，并且是一个主要的旅游目的地。

articles.title: Hegseth defends record as Pentagon chief, slams 'sham' push for his impeachment

paras.en: Hegseth defends record as Pentagon chief, slams 'sham' push for his impeachment
paras.zh: 赫格斯捍卫五角大楼负责人的记录，抨击弹劾他的“虚假”努力

paras.en: Secretary of war issued video message Thursday vowing to fight efforts to impeach him
paras.zh: 战争部长周四发布视频信息，誓言抵制弹劾他的努力

paras.en: U.S. Secretary of War Pete Hegseth issued a video message on Thursday vowing to fight efforts in Congress to impeach him and defending the Iran war as "courageous and historic" after voters punished Republicans over it in this week's midterm elections.
paras.zh: 美国战争部长皮特·赫格塞斯周四发布视频信息，誓言抵制国会弹劾他的努力，并在本周中期选举中选民因伊朗战争而惩罚共和党人后，为伊朗战争辩护，称其为“勇敢和历史性的”。

paras.en: Hegseth's remarks, posted on social media, came as taunts from his foes in Congress intensified and U.S. President Donald Trump swatted away questions about whether he might fire Hegseth. Trump has commended his Pentagon chief.
paras.zh: 赫格赛斯在社交媒体上发布的言论是在国会中的敌人对他的嘲讽加剧之际发表的，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普驳斥了有关他是否可能解雇赫格塞斯的问题。特朗普赞扬了他的五角大楼负责人。

paras.en: The top Democrat in the House of Representatives, Hakeem Jeffries, asked in a post: "Why is Pete Hegseth still around?"
paras.zh: 众议院民主党领袖哈基姆·杰弗里斯 (Hakeem Jeffries) 在帖子中问道：“为什么皮特·赫格斯 (Pete Hegseth) 还在？”

paras.en: Hegseth, a former Fox News host, has been a polarizing figure who has made enemies even within his own Republican Party. Critics in Congress are targeting his conduct of the Iran war, which U.S. Vice President JD Vance has said cost Republicans control of Congress, his firing of top military officers and strained relations with lawmakers as the administration seeks a $1.5-trillion US defence spending package.
paras.zh: 赫格斯是福克斯新闻的前主持人，他一直是一个两极分化的人物，甚至在自己的共和党内也树敌。国会中的批评者将矛头指向他在伊朗战争中的行为，美国副总统 JD 万斯表示，这场战争损害了共和党对国会的控制权、他解雇了高级军官，以及在政府寻求 1.5 万亿美元的美国国防开支计划之际，他与立法者的关系紧张。

paras.en: Democrats, who won control of Congress in Tuesday's elections, have promised to investigate Hegseth and his handling of the Pentagon, and congressional aides say that would include the firing of the chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, among other issues.
paras.zh: 在周二的选举中赢得国会控制权的民主党人承诺调查赫格塞斯及其对五角大楼的处理方式，国会助手表示，这将包括解雇参谋长联席会议主席等问题。

paras.en: Republican Rep. Thomas Massie promised to reintroduce articles of impeachment against Hegseth next week, warning that impeachment would be "much gentler" than what's in store for him once Republicans cede control of Congress next year to Democrats.
paras.zh: 共和党众议员托马斯·马西承诺下周重新提出针对赫格塞斯的弹劾条款，并警告称，一旦共和党明年将国会控制权让给民主党，弹劾将比他面临的弹劾“温和得多”。

paras.en: "They'll have hearings & trials," Massie wrote on X.
paras.zh: “他们将举行听证会和审判，”马西在 X 上写道。

paras.en: Hegseth defended his stewardship of the Pentagon in a more than four-minute video that boasted about firing senior Pentagon leaders, ending diversity initiatives and banning transgender individuals from the military.
paras.zh: 赫格斯在一段四分多钟的视频中捍卫了他对五角大楼的管理职责，视频中吹嘘解雇五角大楼高级领导人、终止多元化倡议以及禁止变性人参军。

paras.en: "You see, they attack me — they attack us — because we are effective. It's not going to work. We will not back down," Hegseth said to the camera.
paras.zh: “你看，他们攻击我——他们攻击我们——因为我们很有效。这是行不通的。我们不会退缩，”赫格斯对着镜头说道。

paras.en: Impeachment 'didn't work' against Trump: Hegseth
paras.zh: 赫格赛斯：弹劾特朗普“不起作用”

paras.en: Calling the impeachment effort a "sham," Hegseth said that Trump himself was impeached twice.
paras.zh: 赫格斯称弹劾努力是“骗局”，并表示特朗普本人曾两次被弹劾。

paras.en: "It's all about the politics of personal destruction. It didn't work against President Trump, and it won't work with me. You can rest assured of that," he said.
paras.zh: “这都是关于个人毁灭的政治。这对特朗普总统不起作用，对我也不起作用。你可以放心，”他说。

paras.en: Trump on Thursday praised Hegseth when asked whether he expected any staffing changes, saying his defence secretary had "done a fantastic job" and suggesting that the opposition to him was tied to his firing of generals.
paras.zh: 周四，当被问及是否预计会出现人事变动时，特朗普赞扬了赫格斯塞斯，称他的国防部长“做得非常出色”，并暗示对他的反对与他解雇将军有关。

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump on Thursday praised Hegseth when asked whether he expected any staffing changes, saying his defence secretary had 'done a fantastic job.' (Alex Brandon/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周四在被问及是否预计人事变动时称赞赫格斯塞斯，称他的国防部长“做得非常出色”。 （亚历克斯·布兰登/美联社）

paras.en: "We had so many generals. Everybody was a four-star general. I never saw anything like it. And many of those people were woke. I don't like a woke general. And so, he probably has opposition," Trump told reporters in the Oval Office.
paras.zh: “我们有这么多将军。每个人都是四星将军。我从来没有见过这样的事情。很多人都醒了。我不喜欢醒着的将军。所以，他可能会遭到反对，”特朗普在椭圆形办公室对记者说。

paras.en: Trump also praised Hegseth's role in U.S. military operations in Venezuela and Iran.
paras.zh: 特朗普还赞扬了赫格塞斯在美国对委内瑞拉和伊朗的军事行动中所发挥的作用。

paras.en: "Venezuela has been unbelievable ... and in Iran, we are there for seven months and we control everything that we've wanted to control," he said.
paras.zh: “委内瑞拉令人难以置信......而在伊朗，我们在那里呆了七个月，我们控制了我们想要控制的一切，”他说。

paras.en: Sources have said Trump could still replace Hegseth as Republicans assess their election losses.
paras.zh: 消息人士称，在共和党评估选举失利之际，特朗普仍可能取代赫格塞斯。

paras.en: On Wednesday, Vance publicly questioned whether the Iran war was worth it and said it cost Republicans control of Congress, in extraordinary remarks that raised questions about whether Trump might still go ahead with a threatened resumption of major combat operations against Iran.
paras.zh: 周三，万斯公开质疑伊朗战争是否值得，并表示这让共和党失去了对国会的控制权，这一非同寻常的言论引发了人们对特朗普是否仍可能继续威胁恢复针对伊朗的重大战斗行动的质疑。

paras.en: U.S. Vice President JD Vance has publicly questioned whether the Iran war was worth it and said it cost Republicans control of Congress in the recent U.S. midterm elections. (Tom Brenner/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 美国副总统万斯公开质疑伊朗战争是否值得，并表示这让共和党在最近的美国中期选举中失去了对国会的控制权。 （汤姆·布伦纳/美联社）

paras.en: One Trump adviser said Hegseth "could be on the chopping block" because of the Iran war.
paras.zh: 特朗普的一位顾问表示，由于伊朗战争，赫格塞斯“可能会被送上砧板”。

paras.en: The War Department has said Hegseth is "100 per cent committed" to leading the Pentagon until the end of Trump's term.
paras.zh: 美国陆军部表示，赫格斯“百分百致力于”领导五角大楼直至特朗普任期结束。

paras.en: Hegseth appealed to "patriotic" lawmakers to pass a funding request that aims to help the Pentagon pay for the Iran war and other spending priorities.
paras.zh: 赫格斯呼吁“爱国”立法者通过一项资金请求，旨在帮助五角大楼支付伊朗战争和其他支出优先事项的费用。

paras.en: "Regardless of how people feel about the war, which I believe is a courageous and historic effort that will ensure Iran never gets nuclear weapons, we need to continue, as President Trump did in his first term, to rebuild our military," Hegseth said.
paras.zh: 赫格塞斯说：“无论人们对这场战争有何看法，我相信这是一场勇敢的历史性努力，将确保伊朗永远不会获得核武器，但我们需要像特朗普总统在第一个任期内所做的那样，继续重建我们的军队。”

paras.en: Republican Sen. Thom Tillis told CBS news on Tuesday night that Hegseth has "a reckoning" coming and his strained relationship with lawmakers was undermining the Trump administration's push for a $1.5-trillion US defence spending package in Congress.
paras.zh: 共和党参议员汤姆·蒂利斯 (Thom Tillis) 周二晚对哥伦比亚广播公司 (CBS) 新闻表示，赫格斯塞斯即将面临“清算”，他与议员之间的紧张关系正在破坏特朗普政府在国会推动 1.5 万亿美元的美国国防开支计划的努力。

paras.en: Hegseth could also face scrutiny from Democrats over his Ukraine policy and U.S. military strikes on suspected drug trafficking boats in Latin American waters, which some Democrats say could amount to war crimes.
paras.zh: 赫格斯还可能因其乌克兰政策和美国对拉丁美洲水域涉嫌贩毒船只的军事打击而面临民主党的审查，一些民主党人称这可能构成战争罪。

paras.en: Representative Adam Smith, the Democrat who is expected to lead the House Armed Services Committee next year, promised vigorous oversight on everything from the Iran war to what he called the erosion of the "apolitical foundation of the armed forces."
paras.zh: 预计明年将领导众议院军事委员会的民主党众议员亚当·史密斯承诺对从伊朗战争到他所说的“武装部队非政治基础”的侵蚀等一切事务进行严格监督。

articles.title: Dolly Parton's manager moves to drop complaint against late singer's nephew

paras.en: Dolly Parton's manager moves to drop complaint against late singer's nephew
paras.zh: 多莉帕顿的经理采取行动放弃对已故歌手侄子的投诉

paras.en: Danny Nozell had secured a restraining order against Bryan Seaver, saying he threatened his aunt's estate
paras.zh: 丹尼·诺泽尔已获得针对布莱恩·西弗的限制令，称他威胁了他姨妈的财产

paras.en: Dolly Parton's longtime manager moved Thursday to drop a complaint that accused the late singer's nephew who acted as her head of security with threatening her estate and its employees.
paras.zh: 多莉·帕顿(Dolly Parton)的长期经纪人周四采取行动，撤销了一项指控，该指控指控这位已故歌手的侄子担任她的安全主管，威胁她的财产及其员工。

paras.en: The proposed dismissal and apparent settlement brought a sudden, unexpected and unexplained end to an ugly rift in the beloved country superstar's inner circle that began while she was sick with cancer and spilled into public view in the weeks after her Aug. 25 death.
paras.zh: 提议的解雇和表面上的和解为这位受人爱戴的乡村巨星核心圈子中的丑陋裂痕带来了突然的、意想不到的和无法解释的结束，这种裂痕始于她患癌症时，并在她 8 月 25 日去世后的几周内蔓延到公众视野。

paras.en: The manager, Danny Nozell, who runs She's Alive, an entity founded to manage and protect Parton's estate, had secured a temporary restraining order against Bryan Seaver and his security company, Squadron Augmented Protection Services, in September. Nozell was seeking to turn the order into a permanent injunction against Seaver.
paras.zh: 经理丹尼·诺泽尔 (Danny Nozell) 经营着“She's Alive”公司，该公司成立的目的是管理和保护帕顿的遗产。9 月，他获得了针对布莱恩·西弗 (Bryan Seaver) 及其安保公司 Squadron Augmented Protection Services 的临时限制令。诺泽尔试图将该命令变成针对西弗的永久禁令。

paras.en: A very brief filing in a Tennessee court Thursday gives no reason why the complaint is being withdrawn. It says only that a proposed order was being drafted for the judge's approval to dismiss the case without prejudice, meaning it can be refiled again. A court filing from a day earlier said the two sides had reached an agreement, but that gave no details either.
paras.zh: 周四向田纳西州法院提交的一份非常简短的文件没有给出撤回申诉的理由。它只是说，正在起草一项拟议命令，以供法官批准在不影响案件的情况下驳回此案，这意味着可以再次重新提起诉讼。一天前的一份法庭文件称，双方已达成协议，但也没有透露细节。

paras.en: The fight was about to become even more public with the first hearing on the matter that was slated for Tuesday, with the two sides set to argue over the proposed permanent injunction.
paras.zh: 随着定于周二就此事举行的首次听证会，这场斗争将变得更加公开，双方将就拟议的永久禁令进行争论。

paras.en: The Associated Press sent emails seeking comment from lawyers for She's Alive, Seaver and his company.
paras.zh: 美联社发送电子邮件寻求 She's Alive、西弗及其公司的律师发表评论。

paras.en: She's Alive terminated Seaver and SAPS in early September, and the following week petitioned for the restraining order against him, arguing that his "terrorizing conduct made their continued retention untenable."
paras.zh: She’s Alive 于 9 月初解雇了 Seaver 和 SAPS，并在接下来的一周申请了针对他的限制令，称他的“恐怖行为使他们的继续保留变得站不住脚”。

paras.en: The petition said that starting shortly before Parton's death and continuing after, Seaver made threats and aimed them directly at She's Alive's "personnel, counsel, and business partners. In writing, he vowed to ‘destroy the entire brand.'"
paras.zh: 请愿书称，从帕顿去世前不久开始，一直到帕顿去世后，西弗都对 She's Alive 的“人员、顾问和商业伙伴发出威胁，并直接针对她的人员、顾问和商业伙伴。他在书面中发誓要‘摧毁整个品牌’”。

paras.en: It says he "called himself ‘literally an international arms dealer and mercenary,'" and said everyone "needs to be worried about what I might do."
paras.zh: 声明称，他“称自己为‘名副其实的国际军火商和雇佣兵’”，并表示每个人“都需要担心我可能会做什么”。

paras.en: In granting the temporary order, Chancellor I'Ashea L. Myles cited Seaver's "claimed access to weapons, experience with violence, and intention to retaliate."
paras.zh: 在授予临时命令时，财政大臣伊阿谢·L·迈尔斯引用了西弗“声称获得武器、经历过暴力并打算进行报复”。

paras.en: Parton was a widely adored singer, songwriter, philanthropist and country music icon who rose from a log cabin in the Tennessee mountains to a stardom that spanned generations with songs including Jolene, Coat of Many Colors, 9 to 5 and I Will Always Love You.
paras.zh: 帕顿是一位广受喜爱的歌手、作曲家、慈善家和乡村音乐偶像，他从田纳西州山区的一间小木屋成长为代代相传的明星，歌曲包括《Jolene》、《Coat of Many Colors》、《朝九晚五》和《I Will Always Love You》。

paras.en: She also left behind a business empire, much of it based in her hometown, that employed many of her close friends and family.
paras.zh: 她还留下了一个商业帝国，其中大部分位于她的家乡，雇佣了她的许多亲密朋友和家人。

articles.title: Bomb threats disrupt several flights across Europe

paras.en: At least a dozen commercial flights made either unscheduled or high-alert landings in Austria, France, Italy, Belgium, Czechia, Spain, Serbia and Bulgaria, according to authorities in the various countries.
paras.zh: 据各国当局称，至少有十几架商业航班计划外或高度戒备地降落在奥地利、法国、意大利、比利时、捷克、西班牙、塞尔维亚和保加利亚。

paras.en: Planes made unscheduled landings in Evreux, France; in Vienna, Austria; and in Bulgaria. A flight from Finland landed in Rome as scheduled but with a military escort, and various others touched down at their scheduled destinations across the continent but amid security alerts.
paras.zh: 飞机意外降落在法国埃夫勒；在奥地利维也纳；和保加利亚。一架从芬兰起飞的航班在军事护航下按计划降落在罗马，其他几架飞机则在安全警报的情况下降落在欧洲大陆的预定目的地。

paras.en: The incident in France became public knowledge first, but the other similar reports soon followed.
paras.zh: 法国的事件首先成为公众所知，但其他类似的报道很快也随之而来。

paras.en: No initial signs of a genuine threat, EU says still 'too early' to say if cases linked
paras.zh: 欧盟表示，目前尚无真正威胁的初步迹象，目前判断案件是否存在关联还“为时过早”

paras.en: This comes after a series of bomb threats leveled against several European flights earlier this week, prompting similar unscheduled landings.
paras.zh: 此前，本周早些时候，多架欧洲航班收到了一系列炸弹威胁，导致类似的计划外降落。

paras.en: Tuesday's incidents turned out to be hoaxes, and preliminary information shows no sign of dangerous materials reported in Thursday's threats as yet.
paras.zh: 周二的事件被证明是恶作剧，初步信息显示，周四的威胁中尚未发现危险材料的迹象。

paras.en: The European Union Commissioner for Transport and Tourism, Apostolos Tzitzikostas, wrote online that any threats against civilians were unacceptable.
paras.zh: 欧盟运输和旅游专员阿波斯托洛斯·齐齐科斯塔斯(Apostolos Tzitzikostas)在网上写道，任何针对平民的威胁都是不可接受的。

paras.en: "It is too early to draw conclusions on whether the reported incidents are linked," Tzitzikostas said. "National investigations remain ongoing."
paras.zh: 齐齐科斯塔斯说：“现在就所报告的事件是否相互关联得出结论还为时过早。” “国家调查仍在进行中。”

paras.en: What happened in the subsequent alerts across Europe?
paras.zh: 随后欧洲各地发出的警报发生了什么？

paras.en: News of a series of diversions and bomb scares trickled out during the course of the day, particularly late in the morning:
paras.zh: 一天中，特别是在上午晚些时候，一系列转移和炸弹恐慌的消息不断传出：

paras.en: - Finland's Finnair carrier reported that two planes landed at their scheduled destinations but amid security scares.
paras.zh: - 芬兰芬兰航空公司报告称，两架飞机降落在预定目的地，但出于安全恐慌。

paras.en: - One Finnair flight from Helsinki to Rome landed with a military escort. Another plane from the Finnish capital, operated by Jettime, also landed in Vienna as scheduled.
paras.zh: - 一架从赫尔辛基飞往罗马的芬兰航空航班在军事护航下降落。由Jettime运营的另一架从芬兰首都起飞的飞机也如期降落在维也纳。

paras.en: - A Wizz Air flight from Milan to Warsaw made an unscheduled landing in Vienna.
paras.zh: - 一架从米兰飞往华沙的维兹航空航班在维也纳意外降落。

paras.en: - Bulgaria reported three aircraft making emergency landings because of bomb threats.
paras.zh: - 保加利亚报告三架飞机因炸弹威胁紧急迫降。

paras.en: - Three Ryanair flights to Sofia — from Copenhagen, Madrid and London Stansted — also all landed under high alert.
paras.zh: - 从哥本哈根、马德里和伦敦斯坦斯特德飞往索非亚的三架瑞安航空航班也都在高度戒备状态下降落。

paras.en: - Two of them touched down in Sofia as scheduled and one diverted to Plovdiv, the airport's CEO said.
paras.zh: - 机场首席执行官表示，其中两架飞机按计划降落在索非亚，一架改道飞往普罗夫迪夫。

paras.en: - Italian news outlets and the Reuters news agency reported, citing airport sources, that two planes — an Aegean Airlines flight from Thessaloniki and a Ryanair flight from Porto — landed at the Malpensa airport in Milan as scheduled after receiving bomb alerts on Thursday morning.
paras.zh: - 意大利新闻媒体和路透社援引机场消息人士的话说，两架飞机——一架从塞萨洛尼基起飞的爱琴海航空航班和一架从波尔图起飞的瑞安航空航班——在周四早上收到炸弹警报后如期降落在米兰马尔彭萨机场。

paras.en: - Police in Madrid said that three flights at the Spanish capital's airport were affected by what they called hoax threats, saying that security forces searched the area and ruled out any risk.
paras.zh: - 马德里警方表示，西班牙首都机场的三架航班受到了所谓的恶作剧威胁的影响，并表示安全部队搜查了该地区并排除了任何风险。

paras.en: - Police in the Czech Republic later said that they were preparing officials at Prague airport for four landings after threats of improvised explosive devices being on board.
paras.zh: - 捷克共和国警方后来表示，在飞机上受到简易爆炸装置威胁后，他们正在为布拉格机场的官员做好四次着陆的准备。

paras.en: - "We assess the relevance of the threats as low," Czech police said. "Nevertheless, we do not underestimate the threat, which is why all necessary security measures have been activated with the least possible impact on passengers and airport operations."
paras.zh: -“我们评估威胁的相关性较低，”捷克警方表示。 “尽管如此，我们并没有低估威胁，这就是为什么我们已经启动了所有必要的安全措施，以尽量减少对乘客和机场运营的影响。”

paras.en: - On Thursday afternoon, Air Serbia issued a statement saying a flight from Belgrade to Bucharest landed safely at its destination after receiving a bomb threat.
paras.zh: - 周四下午，塞尔维亚航空发表声明称，一架从贝尔格莱德飞往布加勒斯特的航班在收到炸弹威胁后安全降落在目的地。

paras.en: What do we know about the first incident outside Paris?
paras.zh: 我们对巴黎以外的第一起事件了解多少？

paras.en: An Airbus A320 plane has been diverted to the Evreux airbase to the west of Paris following a bomb threat.
paras.zh: 一架空客 A320 飞机因收到炸弹威胁而被转移到巴黎西部的埃夫勒空军基地。

paras.en: The office of French Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu announced the incident on Thursday, saying it was monitoring the situation "in real time."
paras.zh: 法国总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努办公室周四宣布了这一事件，称正在“实时”监控局势。

paras.en: The flight was headed from Dublin, Ireland, to the Italian capital of Rome.
paras.zh: 该航班从爱尔兰都柏林飞往意大利首都罗马。

paras.en: Tracking websites showed the plane, part of the Aer Lingus fleet, sharply deviating its course as it was around Paris' airspace and heading towards the more isolated airfield in Evreux.
paras.zh: 跟踪网站显示，这架属于爱尔兰航空机队的飞机在巴黎领空附近时急剧偏离航线，飞往埃夫勒更为偏僻的机场。

paras.en: France's air force said that it dispatched planes "as soon as the incident was reported."
paras.zh: 法国空军表示，“接到事件报告后”立即派出飞机。

paras.en: "The aircraft has been diverted and is being escorted to Evreux airfield," it said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“这架飞机已改道，正在护送前往埃夫勒机场。”

paras.en: Lecornu's office subsequently confirmed that the plane, part of the Aer Lingus fleet, had landed safely at the airfield.
paras.zh: 勒科尔努的办公室随后证实，这架属于爱尔兰航空机队的飞机已安全降落在机场。

paras.en: What happened during the earlier disruptions?
paras.zh: 早期中断期间发生了什么？

paras.en: The prior threats to commercial flights this week turned out to be hoaxes that nevertheless caused diversions and major security mobilizations.
paras.zh: 本周之前对商业航班的威胁最终被证明是恶作剧，但仍然导致了航班改道和重大安全动员。

paras.en: In one case, the Italian air force escorted a plane to its emergency landing.
paras.zh: 在一个案例中，意大利空军护送一架飞机紧急着陆。

paras.en: The threats targeted airlines including Poland's LOT, Scandinavian Airlines, Wizz Air and Ryanair.
paras.zh: 这些威胁针对的航空公司包括波兰航空公司 (LOT)、斯堪的纳维亚航空公司 (Scandinavian Airlines)、维兹航空公司 (Wizz Air) 和瑞安航空公司 (Ryanair)。

paras.en: While it's not yet clear if there is a link, these disruptions to commercial aviation also coincided with a series of apparent cyberattacks targeting freezer units in major supermarkets and even French blood banks.
paras.zh: 虽然尚不清楚是否存在联系，但这些对商业航空的干扰也与一系列针对大型超市甚至法国血库的冷冻室的明显网络攻击同时发生。

paras.en: All the cases remain nascent, but have the potential hallmarks of so-called hybrid attacks designed to cause maximum disruption with minimal effort and resources.
paras.zh: 所有案例都还处于萌芽状态，但具有所谓混合攻击的潜在特征，旨在以最少的努力和资源造成最大的破坏。

articles.title: North Korea tells EU to 'mind its own business' on human rights

paras.en: North Korea responded to the European Union's draft United Nations resolution on human rights in the country by telling the bloc to "mind its own business," state media reported Thursday.
paras.zh: 据官方媒体周四报道，朝鲜对欧盟关于该国人权的联合国决议草案作出回应，要求欧盟“管好自己的事”。

paras.en: Pyongyang has long been accused by the UN and human rights advocates of committing human rights violations.
paras.zh: 平壤长期以来一直被联合国和人权倡导者指责侵犯人权。

paras.en: North Korea's UN mission said in a statement carried by the official Korean Central News Agency that the move was a "farce" and a "politically motivated provocation."
paras.zh: 朝鲜驻联合国代表团在朝鲜中央通讯社发表的一份声明中表示，此举是一场“闹剧”和“出于政治动机的挑衅”。

paras.en: It said the resolution is "flagrantly distorting it's human rights policy," claiming that human rights are not "a monopoly of the West."
paras.zh: 它表示该决议“公然扭曲其人权政策”，并声称人权不是“西方的垄断”。

paras.en: Referring to the protests in Europe, the North Korean mission said: "Streets are filled with demonstrators from all walks of life demanding such elementary rights as the rights to existence."
paras.zh: 在谈到欧洲的抗议活动时，朝鲜代表团表示：“街道上挤满了来自各行各业的示威者，要求生存权等基本权利。”

paras.en: "The EU had better mind its own business, instead of hyping up the nonexistent 'human rights issues,'" it added.
paras.zh: 它补充说： “欧盟最好管好自己的事，而不是炒作不存在的'人权问题'。”

paras.en: South Korea to co-sponsor the resolution
paras.zh: 韩国将成为该决议的共同提案国

paras.en: The UN General Assembly has adopted a resolution condemning North Korea's human rights violations every year since 2005.
paras.zh: 自2005年以来，联合国大会每年都通过决议谴责朝鲜侵犯人权的行为。

paras.en: According to the South Korean Yonhap News Agency, Seoul has decided to co-sponsor the resolution proposed by the EU.
paras.zh: 据韩国联合通讯社报道，首尔已决定成为欧盟提出的决议的共同提案国。

paras.en: It is the fifth consecutive year that Seoul has done so, following a break from 2019 to 2021 under the liberal Moon Jae-in government.
paras.zh: 这是继 2019 年至 2021 年自由派文在寅政府领导下的中断之后，首尔连续第五年做到这一点。

paras.en: The draft text is expected to be adopted by the Third Committee of the UN General Assembly later this month, before being submitted to the UN General Assembly for final approval.
paras.zh: 该草案文本预计将于本月晚些时候由联合国大会第三委员会通过，然后提交联合国大会最终批准。

articles.title: What does Trump's midterm elections loss mean for strained US-India ties?

paras.en: With the US Democrats scoring a resounding midterm victory and taking control of both chambers of Congress, the Republican administration led by Donald Trump is set for a new level of scrutiny until the end of Trump's term.
paras.zh: 随着美国民主党在中期选举中取得压倒性胜利并控制参众两院，唐纳德·特朗普领导的共和党政府将在特朗普任期结束前受到新一轮的审视。

paras.en: Trump is likely to face pushback on his controversial foreign policy, which saw the US alienate most of its allies and get entangled in yet another unpopular war in the Middle East. At the same time, the Trump administration has also taken a slew of less conspicuous but still highly controversial moves on the global stage, including a series of confrontations with India.
paras.zh: 特朗普可能会因其备受争议的外交政策而面临阻力，该政策导致美国疏远了大多数盟友，并卷入了另一场不受欢迎的中东战争。与此同时，特朗普政府还在国际舞台上采取了一系列不那么引人注目但仍极具争议的举动，其中包括与印度的一系列对抗。

paras.en: The ties between New Delhi and Washington are still strained by a stalled trade agreement, restrictions on immigration, and disagreement over India buying Russian oil and weapons, despite the US granting an oil ban waiver in March 2026 and Trump waving some of the Russia sanctions in October.
paras.zh: 尽管美国于 2026 年 3 月授予石油禁令豁免，特朗普于 10 月放弃了部分对俄罗斯的制裁，但新德里和华盛顿之间的关系仍然因贸易协定停滞、移民限制以及印度购买俄罗斯石油和武器问题上的分歧而紧张。

paras.en: And while the new US Congress can choose to pressure Trump over issues such as tariffs and immigration, the president still wields significant authority on foreign policy.
paras.zh: 尽管新一届美国国会可以选择在关税和移民等问题上向特朗普施压，但总统在外交政策上仍然拥有重要权力。

paras.en: Congress likely to look into Trump's trade restrictions
paras.zh: 国会可能会调查特朗普的贸易限制

paras.en: The immediate test for Trump's India policy is trade. India and the US have yet to formalize the interim framework discussed by Trump and Prime Minister Narendra Modi in February, with the two nations still at odds over market access and other trade commitments.
paras.zh: 特朗普印度政策面临的直接考验是贸易。印度和美国尚未正式确定特朗普和总理纳伦德拉·莫迪二月份讨论的临时框架，两国在市场准入和其他贸易承诺方面仍存在分歧。

paras.en: Shanthie Mariet D'Souza, founder of the Mantraya Institute of Strategic Studies, expects the new Congress to apply "increased scrutiny of protectionist measures" pushed by the Trump administration.
paras.zh: 曼特拉亚战略研究所创始人尚蒂·玛丽特·迪索萨 (Shanthie Mariet D'Souza) 预计，新一届国会将“加强对特朗普政府推动的保护主义措施的审查”。

paras.en: The US lawmakers could push for "stronger trade oversight and clearer standards for environmental and labor issues," she told DW.
paras.zh: 她告诉德国之声，美国立法者可以推动“加强贸易监管，并在环境和劳工问题上制定更明确的标准”。

paras.en: For India, whose largest export market is the US, this could offer some breathing room.
paras.zh: 对于最大出口市场是美国的印度来说，这可能会提供一些喘息的空间。

paras.en: She also emphasized that "the fundamental pillars of the India-US strategic partnership are expected to remain strong" and "the long-term goal of deepening economic ties is likely to continue."
paras.zh: 她还强调，“印美战略伙伴关系的基本支柱预计将保持强劲”，“深化经济关系的长期目标可能会继续下去”。

paras.en: Immigration presents a different challenge. The administration's tightening of H-1B visa rules, including imposing a $100,000 (€88,761) payment for certain new petitions, has alarmed Indian professionals and tech companies that rely on the visa program to secure jobs in the US.
paras.zh: 移民带来了不同的挑战。政府收紧 H-1B 签证规定，包括对某些新申请征收 100,000 美元（88,761 欧元）的费用，这让依赖签证计划在美国找到工作的印度专业人士和科技公司感到震惊。

paras.en: A Democratic majority could increase scrutiny on that issue as well, but would not automatically reverse measures introduced by Trump's executive action.
paras.zh: 民主党占多数也可以加强对该问题的审查，但不会自动撤销特朗普行政行动所采取的措施。

paras.en: "Both parties have bigger issues to grapple with," said Rajkrishna Iyer, a California-licensed immigration lawyer. "For the last 25-plus years, Congress has done nothing for immigration," he added.
paras.zh: “双方都有更大的问题需要解决，”加州执业移民律师拉吉克里希纳·艾耶 (Rajkrishna Iyer) 说。 “在过去 25 多年里，国会没有为移民采取任何行动，”他补充道。

paras.en: Iyer believes that legal immigration itself is not a major priority for voters. Nevertheless, he sees the midterms' result as a message to Trump about his immigration policies.
paras.zh: 艾耶尔认为，合法移民本身并不是选民的主要优先事项。尽管如此，他认为中期选举的结果是向特朗普传达的有关其移民政策的信息。

paras.en: "A rational president would not spend time imposing further restrictions on legal immigration. But as we know, the president is not rational," Iyer said.
paras.zh: “一位理性的总统不会花时间对合法移民施加进一步的限制。但正如我们所知，总统并不理性，”艾耶说。

paras.en: The immigration lawyer believes that new, steep fee for some H-1B applications will be challenged in court.
paras.zh: 移民律师认为，一些 H-1B 申请新的高额费用将在法庭上受到质疑。

paras.en: "Most likely, the new rules will not come into effect. And if they do, federal courts are likely to strike them down because the fees are not reasonable," said Iyer.
paras.zh: “最有可能的是，新规则不会生效。如果生效，联邦法院很可能会驳回它们，因为费用不合理，”艾耶说。

paras.en: While the executive branch of government can raise fees to reflect administrative costs and inflation, Iyer argued that charges of this magnitude could deter people from pursuing legal immigration. "Only Congress can pass such legislation."
paras.zh: 虽然政府行政部门可以提高费用以反映行政成本和通货膨胀，但艾耶尔认为，如此大规模的收费可能会阻止人们寻求合法移民。 “只有国会才能通过这样的立法。”

paras.en: US still wants less dependence on Russia
paras.zh: 美国仍希望减少对俄罗斯的依赖

paras.en: The new balance of power in Washington could also trigger a new geopolitical reshuffle and a change of course on Russia. However, it is unclear if the Democrat-dominated Congress will force any changes in the dispute between New Delhi and Washington over India's purchasing Russian energy. During a congressional vote on Russian sanctions in September, a substantial number of Democrats joined Republican lawmakers to endorse trade restrictions against Moscow.
paras.zh: 华盛顿新的权力平衡也可能引发新的地缘政治洗牌和对俄罗斯方针的改变。然而，目前尚不清楚民主党主导的国会是否会迫使新德里和华盛顿之间关于印度购买俄罗斯能源的争端发生任何变化。在 9 月份国会就俄罗斯制裁进行投票期间，大量民主党议员与共和党议员一起支持针对莫斯科的贸易限制。

paras.en: "Regarding Russian oil, the administration is likely to maintain its preference for reducing dependence on Moscow, but it will approach this issue with diplomatic caution to avoid straining relations with New Delhi," D'Souza said.
paras.zh: “关于俄罗斯石油，政府可能会继续减少对莫斯科的依赖，但将以外交谨慎态度处理这个问题，以避免与新德里的关系紧张，”迪苏萨说。

paras.en: India angry over US supplying Pakistan with weapons
paras.zh: 印度对美国向巴基斯坦提供武器感到愤怒

paras.en: The war in Iran adds another dimension. Any new escalation could affect energy exports from the Middle East and make India more vulnerable due to its need for high oil imports.
paras.zh: 伊朗战争增加了另一个层面。任何新的升级都可能影响中东的能源出口，并使印度由于需要大量石油进口而更加脆弱。

paras.en: But Navtej Sarna, a former Indian ambassador to the US and Israel, urged cautions when discussing the future of US policy in the Middle East.
paras.zh: 但前印度驻美国和以色列大使纳夫泰伊·萨尔纳在讨论美国中东政策的未来时敦促谨慎行事。

paras.en: "It may be facile to try and parse these results for their immediate impact on specific areas of foreign policy. Much will depend on how Trump reacts," Sarna told DW.
paras.zh: 萨尔纳告诉德国之声：“尝试解析这些结果可能很容易，因为它们对外交政策特定领域的直接影响。很大程度上取决于特朗普的反应。”

paras.en: At the same time, Sarna expects Washington to become "a more contested place," with greater congressional pushback on issues that divide India and the US.
paras.zh: 与此同时，萨尔纳预计华盛顿将成为“一个更具争议性的地方”，国会在印度和美国分歧的问题上将面临更大的阻力。

paras.en: "If that injects some balance and stability and restores institutional linkages it's good for the long-term future of our relationship," he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“如果这能带来一定的平衡和稳定，并恢复制度联系，这对我们关系的长远未来有利。”

paras.en: Security cooperation is another stumbling block. New Delhi is still by far the biggest buyer of Russia's arms exports, which irritates Washington. At the same time, India has objected to US supplying weapons to Pakistan, including the $686 million sale of advanced military tech for Pakistan's F-16 jets.
paras.zh: 安全合作是另一个绊脚石。迄今为止，新德里仍然是俄罗斯武器出口的最大买家，这激怒了华盛顿。与此同时，印度反对美国向巴基斯坦提供武器，包括向巴基斯坦出售价值6.86亿美元的F-16战斗机先进军事技术。

paras.en: "Washington's military support for Pakistan remains a complex issue. However, ongoing regional adjustments and US concerns about stability in the region will probably prevent any significant policy changes," said D'Souza.
paras.zh: “华盛顿对巴基斯坦的军事支持仍然是一个复杂的问题。然而，持续的地区调整和美国对该地区稳定的担忧可能会阻止任何重大的政策变化，”迪苏扎说。

paras.en: Trump could 'double down' on New Delhi policy
paras.zh: 特朗普可能会“加倍”新德里政策

paras.en: The broader question is whether the election produces a more predictable Washington or a more confrontational Donald Trump.
paras.zh: 更广泛的问题是，这次选举是否会产生一个更可预测的华盛顿，还是一个更具对抗性的唐纳德·特朗普。

paras.en: A weakened president could be more inclined to seek compromises at home. But Trump could also respond to congressional resistance by taking a harder line elsewhere.
paras.zh: 一位被削弱的总统可能更倾向于在国内寻求妥协。但特朗普也可以通过在其他地方采取更强硬的路线来回应国会的阻力。

paras.en: "We hope the electoral setback will prompt Trump to undertake a more considered review of his earlier actions," Amitabh Mattoo, dean of the School of International Studies at Jawaharlal Nehru University, told DW.
paras.zh: 贾瓦哈拉尔·尼赫鲁大学国际研究学院院长阿米塔布·马图对德国之声表示：“我们希望选举受挫能够促使特朗普对其之前的行为进行更加深思熟虑的审查。”

paras.en: But he also warns that it too early to assess the implications for India-US relations.
paras.zh: 但他也警告说，现在评估这对印美关系的影响还为时过早。

paras.en: "Rather than moderating his approach, the president could double down and adopt an even harder line towards New Delhi if he comes to believe that Indians, particularly sections of the diaspora, played a role, directly or indirectly, in his party's defeat."
paras.zh: “如果总统开始相信印度人，特别是海外侨民，直接或间接地在他的政党的失败中发挥了作用，而不是缓和他的态度，他可以加倍努力，对新德里采取更强硬的路线。”

paras.en: Harsh Pant of the Observer Research said that the US president retains considerable leverage over foreign policy despite the Republican setback, and that the India-US partnership has traditionally enjoyed bipartisan support.
paras.zh: 观察家研究公司的哈什·潘特表示，尽管共和党遭遇挫折，美国总统在外交政策上仍然拥有相当大的影响力，而且印美伙伴关系传统上得到了两党的支持。

paras.en: "I don't think India will be one of those issues" on which the White House and Congress are likely to clash, Pant told DW.
paras.zh: 潘特告诉德国之声，“我认为印度不会成为白宫和国会可能发生冲突的问题之一”。

paras.en: But the experience of the past two years, he argues, reinforces the need for India to reduce its dependence on any single partner.
paras.zh: 但他认为，过去两年的经历强化了印度减少对任何单一合作伙伴依赖的必要性。

paras.en: "The need for diversification of partnerships, the need to be self-reliant in certain critical sectors, the need to have alternative supply chains — all of those issues remain where they are. The US midterms do not really change the calculus," he said.
paras.zh: “合作伙伴关系多元化的必要性、某些关键领域自力更生的必要性、拥有替代供应链的必要性——所有这些问题都仍然存在。美国中期选举并没有真正改变现状，”他说。

articles.title: US Justice Department sues Penn State over undocumented students’ tuition

paras.en: The United States Department of Justice has sued Pennsylvania State University, accusing the institution of violating federal law by offering in-state tuition rates to undocumented students while denying the same reduced rates to all US citizens.
paras.zh: 美国司法部起诉宾夕法尼亚州立大学，指控该机构向无证学生提供州内学费，同时拒绝向所有美国公民提供同样的折扣，违反了联邦法律。

paras.en: The lawsuit, filed on Thursday, argues that the university’s tuition policy discriminates against citizens.
paras.zh: 该诉讼于周四提起，称该大学的学费政策歧视公民。

paras.en: Currently, undocumented students can qualify for in-state tuition if they meet Penn State’s residency standards.
paras.zh: 目前，无证学生如果符合宾夕法尼亚州立大学的居住标准，就有资格获得州内学费。

paras.en: But prosecutors have rejected that policy, saying it violates a federal law that bars “preferential treatment” in higher education for undocumented immigrants, unless the same benefits are available to US citizens.
paras.zh: 但检察官拒绝了这项政策，称它违反了一项联邦法律，该法律禁止对无证移民在高等教育中给予“优惠待遇”，除非美国公民也能获得同样的福利。

paras.en: In the US, public universities typically charge lower tuition to students who are residents of the state where the institution is located, while students from other states pay higher rates.
paras.zh: 在美国，公立大学通常向所在州居民的学生收取较低的学费，而来自其他州的学生则支付较高的学费。

paras.en: Proponents of such policies say in-state tuition helps prevent “brain drain”, wherein students might leave the state to attend universities elsewhere. They also reward residents of the state, who contribute taxes to the education system.
paras.zh: 此类政策的支持者表示，州内学费有助于防止“人才流失”，即学生可能离开本州去其他地方上大学。他们还奖励为教育系统缴税的州居民。

paras.en: Advocates argue the same benefits should be directed towards undocumented students, who are often brought to the country as minors. Making undocumented students eligible for in-state tuition can also reduce the barriers they face to education.
paras.zh: 倡导者认为，同样的福利应该针对无证学生，他们通常是作为未成年人被带到该国的。让无证学生有资格获得州内学费也可以减少他们面临的教育障碍。

paras.en: But the Justice Department is seeking a court order preventing Penn State from continuing to offer in-state tuition rates to undocumented students, including those living in Pennsylvania, regardless of their immigration status.
paras.zh: 但司法部正在寻求法院命令，阻止宾夕法尼亚州立大学继续向无证学生（包括居住在宾夕法尼亚州的学生）提供州内学费，无论其移民身份如何。

paras.en: It is also seeking to block the university from adopting future tuition policies that give undocumented students “preferential treatment” over US citizens.
paras.zh: 它还试图阻止大学采取未来的学费政策，给予无证学生比美国公民“优惠待遇”。

paras.en: “Congress made a deliberate policy choice that states and their public institutions may not grant tuition benefits to illegal aliens unless those same benefits are made to all US citizens,” Brett Shumate, assistant attorney general of the Justice Department’s Civil Division, said in a statement.
paras.zh: “国会经过深思熟虑的政策选择，各州及其公共机构不得向非法外国人提供学费福利，除非向所有美国公民提供同样的福利，”司法部民事部门助理总检察长布雷特·舒马特在一份声明中表示。

paras.en: The lawsuit is part of a broader campaign under President Donald Trump to challenge state policies granting reduced tuition to undocumented students.
paras.zh: 该诉讼是唐纳德·特朗普总统领导下的更广泛运动的一部分，旨在挑战向无证学生减免学费的国家政策。

paras.en: Since returning to office for a second term in 2025, Trump has sought to clamp down on undocumented immigration, promising to lead the largest deportation effort in US history.
paras.zh: 自 2025 年重返总统连任以来，特朗普一直寻求打击无证移民，并承诺领导美国历史上最大规模的驱逐行动。

paras.en: The Justice Department said Thursday’s filing brings the total number of lawsuits it has brought challenging such policies to 27. It also said six cases in Texas, Kentucky, Oklahoma, Nebraska, Illinois and Kansas resulted in court orders permanently blocking similar tuition policies.
paras.zh: 司法部表示，周四提交的文件使其对此类政策提出质疑的诉讼总数达到 27 起。司法部还表示，德克萨斯州、肯塔基州、俄克拉荷马州、内布拉斯加州、伊利诺伊州和堪萨斯州的 6 起案件导致法院下令永久阻止类似的学费政策。

paras.en: In Thursday’s lawsuit, prosecutors called such policies unconstitutional. They also argued that laws like the 1996 Personal Responsibility and Work Opportunity Reconciliation Act ban “public benefits from serving as an incentive” for undocumented immigration.
paras.zh: 在周四的诉讼中，检察官称此类政策违宪。他们还认为，1996 年《个人责任和工作机会协调法案》等法律禁止“公共福利作为无证移民的激励措施”。

paras.en: “Federal law prohibits illegal aliens from being eligible to receive postsecondary education benefits based on residence within a state if such benefits are denied to US citizens residing in other states,” the lawsuit said.
paras.zh: 诉讼称：“如果居住在其他州的美国公民无法获得此类福利，联邦法律禁止非法外国人有资格获得基于在该州居住的高等教育福利。”

paras.en: “There are no exceptions. Yet, Pennsylvania State University has ignored this congressional prohibition.”
paras.zh: “没有例外。然而，宾夕法尼亚州立大学却无视国会的这项禁令。”

paras.en: According to Penn State’s current residency requirements, non-citizen applicants must have attended an accredited Pennsylvania high school for at least four years and graduated from one to qualify for in-state tuition.
paras.zh: 根据宾夕法尼亚州立大学目前的居住要求，非公民申请者必须在宾夕法尼亚州认可的高中就读至少四年并从中毕业，才有资格获得州内学费。

paras.en: Penn State said it was aware of the complaint and was reviewing it.
paras.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州立大学表示已了解该投诉并正在对其进行审查。

articles.title: Why is Iran exempting India, China, Qatar, Iraq from Hormuz restrictions?

paras.en: Iran has exempted ships from India, China, Iraq and Qatar from its Strait of Hormuz restrictions, a senior Iranian lawmaker said on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 伊朗一位高级议员周二表示，伊朗已免除来自印度、中国、伊拉克和卡塔尔的船只在霍尔木兹海峡的限制。

paras.en: “Ships from these countries pass freely, and the Americans do not intercept them either,” Amir Hayat Moqaddam, deputy chairman of the Iranian parliament’s National Security and Foreign Policy Committee, told the Iranian Students’ News Agency (ISNA).
paras.zh: 伊朗议会国家安全和外交政策委员会副主席阿米尔·哈亚特·穆卡达姆对伊朗学生通讯社（ISNA）表示：“这些国家的船只可以自由通过，美国人也不会拦截它们。”

paras.en: Iran effectively shut the strait early in the US-Israel war on Iran, which began on February 28, and the United States reimposed a naval blockade on Iran’s southern ports in July.
paras.zh: 2月28日开始的美以战争初期，伊朗实际上封锁了该海峡，美国于7月重新对伊朗南部港口实施海上封锁。

paras.en: So why have these four countries been granted passage through the critical strait, and can their ships really sail freely while the blockade remains in place?
paras.zh: 那么，为什么这四个国家能够获准通过这一关键海峡，并且在封锁期间，它们的船只真的能自由航行呢？

paras.en: What does Iran get in return for letting ships pass?
paras.zh: 伊朗让船只通过能得到什么回报？

paras.en: It will receive medicine from India and political backing from China, according to Hayat Moqaddam. Iran already receives diplomatic support from Qatar, which is leading mediation efforts to end the US-Israel war on Iran.
paras.zh: 哈亚特·莫卡达姆表示，它将获得印度的药品和中国的政治支持。伊朗已经获得卡塔尔的外交支持，卡塔尔正在主导调解努力，以结束美以对伊朗的战争。

paras.en: Hayat Moqaddam said Tehran will also collect transit fees from Indian and Chinese ships, while Qatari vessels pass free. He did not say whether Iraqi ships will pay a toll.
paras.zh: 哈亚特·莫卡达姆表示，德黑兰还将向印度和中国船只收取过境费，而卡塔尔船只则免费通行。他没有透露伊拉克船只是否会支付通行费。

paras.en: “Whatever the lawmaker says is the rationale – the big question is if it works and, if yes, to what extent?” Rouzbeh Parsi, an Iran analyst and affiliated researcher at Lund University’s Department of History and Human Rights Studies, told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: “无论立法者说什么都是其理由——最大的问题是它是否有效，如果有效，有效程度如何？”伊朗分析师、隆德大学历史和人权研究系附属研究员鲁兹贝·帕西 (Rouzbeh Parsi) 告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: “Iran has been under sanctions for a very long time, so bartering and quid pro quos in trade are nothing new,” he said. The difference now, he added, is that “it’s about poking holes in an embargo and getting crucial goods/services in and out”.
paras.zh: “伊朗长期以来一直受到制裁，因此贸易中的易货贸易和交换条件并不是什么新鲜事，”他说。他补充说，现在的不同之处在于，“这是为了戳破禁运的漏洞，让重要的商品/服务进出”。

paras.en: Nader Hashemi, an associate professor of Middle East politics at Georgetown University, said that “most likely Iran is charging a transit fee or a percentage of the cargo value to allow those ships to go through without being harassed”.
paras.zh: 乔治城大学中东政治副教授纳德·哈希米表示，“伊朗很可能会收取过境费或货物价值的一定比例，以允许这些船只通过而不会受到骚扰”。

paras.en: “It’s a clever move by Tehran for several reasons,” Wolfgang Pusztai, a security and defence analyst and Austria’s former defence attache to Libya, told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: “出于多种原因，这是德黑兰的明智之举，”安全与国防分析师、奥地利前驻利比亚武官沃尔夫冈·普兹泰告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: “If successful, this move will generate significant revenue for Iran, as China is by far the largest purchaser of Iranian crude oil, buying nearly 90 percent of Iran’s total oil exports,” he said.
paras.zh: 他表示：“如果成功，此举将为伊朗带来可观的收入，因为中国是迄今为止伊朗原油的最大买家，购买了伊朗石油出口总量的近90%。”

paras.en: By including Qatar, with its many liquefied natural gas (LNG) buyers, and India, Iran is also “trying to undermine acceptance” of Washington’s strategy in the conflict, especially as it charges Qatar no tolls, he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，通过将拥有众多液化天然气（LNG）买家的卡塔尔和印度纳入其中，伊朗也“试图破坏人们对华盛顿在冲突中的战略的接受”，特别是因为它不向卡塔尔收取通行费。

paras.en: Why does it matter to these four countries?
paras.zh: 为什么这对这四个国家很重要？

paras.en: All four are highly dependent on the Strait of Hormuz for exports.
paras.zh: 这四个国家都高度依赖霍尔木兹海峡的出口。

paras.en: Of the 10.23 million barrels a day of Gulf crude that passed through the strait in October, about 42 percent went to China and 13 percent to India, Muyu Xu, a senior crude oil analyst at the analytics firm Kpler, told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 分析公司 Kpler 的高级原油分析师 Muyu Xu 告诉半岛电视台，10 月份每天通过该海峡的 1023 万桶海湾原油中，约 42% 运往中国，13% 运往印度。

paras.en: “China is the country most able to cross US interests. The question is whether Beijing considers it worth the potential political cost,” Parsi said.
paras.zh: “中国是最有能力违背美国利益的国家。问题是北京是否认为值得为此付出潜在的政治代价，”帕西说。

paras.en: Asia is particularly reliant on Gulf oil and gas usually shipped out via Hormuz. Countries there have much to offer in return for allowing ships to pass.
paras.zh: 亚洲尤其依赖海湾石油和天然气，通常通过霍尔木兹海峡运出。那里的国家可以提供很多条件来换取允许船只通过的条件。

paras.en: “For India, the shutdown of oil from the Gulf has been a great loss – and it is a big producer of the pharmaceuticals that Iran cannot manufacture itself,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“对于印度来说，海湾石油的关闭是一个巨大的损失，而且印度是伊朗无法自行生产的药品的主要生产国。”

paras.en: Qatar, which is mediating between Washington and Tehran, shipped no LNG through the strait in August, but managed 1.8 million tonnes in October, Xu said.
paras.zh: 徐说，在华盛顿和德黑兰之间进行调解的卡塔尔8月份没有通过该海峡运输液化天然气，但10月份管理了180万吨液化天然气。

paras.en: Its crude transits fell over the same period, from 517,000 barrels a day to 193,000, while Iraq’s rose from 1.69 million to 2.65 million.
paras.zh: 同期，其原油运输量从每天 517,000 桶下降到 193,000 桶，而伊拉克的原油运输量从 169 万桶增加到 265 万桶。

paras.en: Kpler has been unable to trace the origin of up to two million barrels a day of Middle Eastern crude, so both countries’ flows may be higher, Xu said.
paras.zh: 徐说，克普勒无法追踪每天多达 200 万桶中东原油的来源，因此两国的流量可能会更高。

paras.en: “India and Qatar have closer relationships with DC they need to maintain – while both of them also feel let down by Trump,” Parsi said, adding, “For Qatar, maintaining a relationship with Iran is also vital since it’s an unavoidable neighbour.”
paras.zh: 帕西说：“印度和卡塔尔与华盛顿有着他们需要维持的更密切的关系，而他们都对特朗普感到失望。”他补充道，“对于卡塔尔来说，与伊朗保持关系也至关重要，因为它是一个不可避免的邻居。”

paras.en: “So for all of them, there are upsides for these exemptions from Iranian restrictions but also political dangers,” he said.
paras.zh: “因此，对于所有这些国家来说，伊朗限制的豁免都有好处，但也存在政治危险，”他说。

paras.en: Iran began letting some vessels from countries it considers friendly pass within weeks of the war starting. And in April, its military command said “brotherly” Iraq was exempt.
paras.zh: 战争爆发后几周内，伊朗开始允许其认为友好国家的一些船只通过。今年四月，其军事指挥部表示，“兄弟”的伊拉克可以豁免。

paras.en: With the Iraqi exemption, Iran “probably intends to support the economic recovery” of its western neighbour, a fellow Shia-majority country, Pusztai said.
paras.zh: 普斯泰说，有了伊拉克的豁免，伊朗“可能打算支持”其西方邻国（同为什叶派多数国家）的经济复苏。

paras.en: Will ships be able to get past the US blockade?
paras.zh: 船只能否突破美国的封锁？

paras.en: US Central Command (CENTCOM) has said the blockade applies to “all vessels of all nations entering or leaving coastal areas or ports in Iran”, while vessels avoiding Iranian ports are not affected.
paras.zh: 美国中央司令部（CENTCOM）表示，封锁适用于“所有国家进入或离开伊朗沿海地区或港口的所有船只”，而避开伊朗港口的船只不受影响。

paras.en: It has also said humanitarian shipments, including “food and medical supplies essential for the survival of the civilian populations”, can pass after inspection.
paras.zh: 它还表示，人道主义货物，包括“平民生存所必需的食品和医疗用品”，可以在检查后通过。

paras.en: But Hayat Moqaddam did not appear to limit the exemptions to ships trading with other Gulf states, Pusztai noted. “If this is really the case, this would also have a significant impact on the other Gulf states, including Saudi Arabia,” he said.
paras.zh: 但普兹泰指出，哈亚特·穆卡达姆似乎并未限制与其他海湾国家进行贸易的船舶的豁免。 “如果情况确实如此，这也将对包括沙特阿拉伯在内的其他海湾国家产生重大影响，”他说。

paras.en: “This could make the continuation of the American naval blockade more difficult and less effective, assuming Washington accepts this Iranian move,” he said. The main change, he added, is that the exemption “would also cover Chinese/Indian ships from/to Iran”, if the US accepts it.
paras.zh: 他说：“如果华盛顿接受伊朗的这一举动，这可能会使美国继续实施海上封锁变得更加困难和无效。”他补充说，主要的变化是，如果美国接受的话，豁免“也将涵盖往返伊朗的中国/印度船只”。

paras.en: It is also unclear whether “ships of these countries” means the flag a vessel flies, its owner, its operator or some other link, Pusztai said.
paras.zh: 普斯泰表示，目前还不清楚“这些国家的船舶”是否指船舶所悬挂的旗帜、船主、运营商或其他一些联系。

paras.en: Ending the blockade is one of Tehran’s demands before it will commit to broader peace talks with the US, which will include discussions about Iran’s nuclear programme. Qatar-mediated talks currently centre on an Iranian proposal to reopen the strait if the US meets seven conditions, including this and lifting sanctions.
paras.zh: 结束封锁是德黑兰的要求之一，然后才承诺与美国进行更广泛的和平谈判，其中将包括有关伊朗核计划的讨论。目前，卡塔尔斡旋的谈判重点是伊朗提议，如果美国满足七个条件，包括解除制裁，伊朗将重新开放海峡。

paras.en: “It seems to be that Iran tries to separate the questions of free passage through the Strait of Hormuz and oil exports from the nuclear question,” Pusztai said, adding, “The American reaction will show if this is successful.”
paras.zh: 普斯泰说：“伊朗似乎试图将霍尔木兹海峡自由通行和石油出口问题与核问题分开。”他补充道，“美国的反应将表明这是否成功。”

paras.en: Will this make a difference to oil markets?
paras.zh: 这会对石油市场产生影响吗？

paras.en: “I think they make only limited difference at present,” Chris Beauchamp, chief market analyst at IG Group, told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: IG 集团首席市场分析师克里斯·博尚 (Chris Beauchamp) 告诉半岛电视台：“我认为目前它们的作用有限。”

paras.en: “Markets are back to pricing in a peace deal, but if conflict flares up at full tilt, then Iranian commanders may not have time to distinguish their targets,” he said, adding: “At present, the focus remains squarely on the prospects of a broader deal.”
paras.zh: 他表示：“市场重新开始对和平协议进行定价，但如果冲突全面爆发，那么伊朗指挥官可能没有时间区分他们的目标。”他补充道：“目前，焦点仍然集中在更广泛协议的前景上。”

paras.en: An exemption has not guaranteed safety. On October 30, the Qatari LNG carrier Al Mayeda was struck by “unidentified objects” in the Gulf, said its owner, Qatar Gas Transport Company.
paras.zh: 豁免并不能保证安全。卡塔尔天然气运输公司卡塔尔天然气运输公司表示，10 月 30 日，卡塔尔液化天然气运输船 Al Mayeda 在海湾被“不明物体”击中。

paras.en: More than 120 commercial ships have been hit in the region since the war began, with October being the worst month, according to data from the International Maritime Organization and United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations.
paras.zh: 根据国际海事组织和英国海事贸易运营部的数据，自战争开始以来，该地区已有 120 多艘商船遭到袭击，其中 10 月是最严重的月份。

articles.title: Who is Kozo Tashima, the Japanese official running for FIFA presidency?

paras.en: Kozo Tashima first started playing football after watching the 1964 Tokyo Olympics, and since then he has dedicated his life to developing the sport’s growth in Japan.
paras.zh: 田岛幸三在观看 1964 年东京奥运会后开始踢足球，从那时起，他就致力于推动这项运动在日本的发展。

paras.en: The 68-year-old is set to become the first person from Japan to run for the FIFA presidency after announcing he would stand against Gianni Infantino in football’s governing body’s election in March.
paras.zh: 这位 68 岁的老人在 3 月份宣布将在足球管理机构选举中与詹尼·因凡蒂诺 (Gianni Infantino) 竞争后，将成为第一位竞选国际足联主席的日本人。

paras.en: Tashima has served as a football player, coach and bureaucrat and has a reputation for being a safe pair of hands.
paras.zh: 田岛曾担任过足球运动员、教练和官员，并以安全可靠而闻名。

paras.en: He rarely makes headlines, and one of the few times he appeared outside the sport pages was when he became one of the first public figures in Japan to contract coronavirus in March 2020.
paras.zh: 他很少成为头条新闻，他在体育版面之外出现的为数不多的一次是他在 2020 年 3 月成为日本第一批感染冠状病毒的公众人物之一。

paras.en: He spent time studying at the German Sport University Cologne and said the experience changed the way he saw sport’s purpose in society.
paras.zh: 他在德国科隆体育大学学习，并表示这段经历改变了他对体育社会意义的看法。

paras.en: He says his decision to run for the FIFA presidency was based on a belief that “in this age of business and money, sport must firmly uphold its integrity”.
paras.zh: 他表示，他竞选国际足联主席的决定是基于这样的信念：“在这个商业和金钱的时代，体育必须坚定地维护其诚信”。

paras.en: “The worst thing would be if he [Infantino] were to continue without an election,” he told reporters after announcing his candidacy.
paras.zh: “最糟糕的事情是，如果他（因凡蒂诺）不参加选举就继续执政，”他在宣布参选后告诉记者。

paras.en: “I feel this is a test of whether FIFA has the ability to cleanse itself.”
paras.zh: “我觉得这是对国际足联是否有能力自我净化的考验。”

paras.en: Tashima was born in southern Kumamoto and captained his team to the title in Japan’s prestigious national high school championship.
paras.zh: 田岛出生于熊本南部，作为队长带领球队在日本著名的全国高中锦标赛中夺得冠军。

paras.en: With no professional football in the country at the time, he had ambitions of becoming a PE teacher and enrolled at a university, where he was called up to play for Japan’s full national team.
paras.zh: 当时日本还没有职业足球，他立志成为一名体育老师，并考入了一所大学，并被征召为日本国家队效力。

paras.en: He joined a club in Japan’s amateur league after graduating but soon retired as a player and went to Germany to study to become a coach.
paras.zh: 毕业后他加入了日本业余联赛的俱乐部，但很快就退役并前往德国学习成为一名教练。

paras.en: He described his “profound shock” at the players’ superior skills and the way football was viewed there.
paras.zh: 他描述了他对球员们高超的球技和人们看待足球的方式的“深深的震惊”。

paras.en: “Even back in 1980, the training in Germany was hugely scientific and systematic,” he said.
paras.zh: “早在 1980 年，德国的培训就非常科学和系统，”他说。

paras.en: “Everything seemed like a different world from Japan, and it was a big culture shock for me.”
paras.zh: “一切似乎都与日本不同，这对我来说是一个巨大的文化冲击。”

paras.en: Tashima returned home determined to use what he had learned in Germany and help develop Japanese football.
paras.zh: 田岛回国后决心运用他在德国学到的知识来帮助发展日本足球。

paras.en: He coached a university team before joining the Japan Football Association (JFA), where he worked on development programmes and coached the country’s national teams at various youth levels.
paras.zh: 在加入日本足球协会 (JFA) 之前，他曾执教过一支大学球队，负责发展项目并执教该国各个青年级别的国家队。

paras.en: He rose through the JFA ranks and was elected president in 2016, while also serving on the Asian Football Confederation executive committee and the FIFA Council.
paras.zh: 他在 JFA 的地位不断提升，并于 2016 年当选主席，同时还在亚洲足球联合会执行委员会和国际足联理事会任职。

paras.en: His reign as JFA chief saw him fire Japan coach Vahid Halilhodzic two months before the 2018 World Cup in Russia.
paras.zh: 在担任日本足协主席期间，他在 2018 年俄罗斯世界杯举行前两个月解雇了日本队主教练瓦希德·哈利霍季奇。

paras.en: Halilhodzic, who was unpopular with the players, was replaced by Akira Nishino, and Japan reached the last 16, where they were eliminated by Belgium.
paras.zh: 不受球员欢迎的哈利霍季奇被西野彰取代，日本队进入16强，但被比利时队淘汰。

paras.en: “Some people told me that I wasn’t the one who hired Halilhodzic so it wouldn’t be my fault if the team lost,” Tashima said.
paras.zh: “有些人告诉我，我不是雇佣哈利霍季奇的人，所以如果球队输了，那也不是我的错，”田岛说。

paras.en: “But as president, all the responsibility lay with me.”
paras.zh: “但作为总统，所有责任都在我身上。”

paras.en: Tashima stepped down as JFA chief in 2024 and was named honorary president.
paras.zh: 田岛于 2024 年辞去 JFA 主席职务，并被任命为名誉主席。

paras.en: He said he had decided to run for the FIFA presidency to “contribute to the further development of world football”.
paras.zh: 他表示，他决定竞选国际足联主席，以“为世界足球的进一步发展做出贡献”。

paras.en: Tashima said he was troubled by FIFA’s shock decision to lift a ban for United States player Folarin Balogun at this year’s World Cup, following an intervention by US President Donald Trump.
paras.zh: 田岛表示，在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的干预下，国际足联做出了解除对美国球员福拉林·巴洛贡参加今年世界杯的禁令的令人震惊的决定，这让他感到不安。

paras.en: He said he also had a problem with the travel restrictions placed on Iran’s World Cup team by American authorities.
paras.zh: 他说，他还对美国当局对伊朗世界杯球队实施的旅行限制感到不满。

paras.en: Tashima, who has the JFA’s backing, said his presidency bid was “not about winning or losing”.
paras.zh: 得到日本足协支持的田岛表示，他的总统竞选“无关输赢”。

paras.en: “What matters is sharing with the world the integrity that Japan’s football has built over the years,” he said.
paras.zh: “重要的是与世界分享日本足球多年来建立的诚信，”他说。

articles.title: Japan faces diplomatic dilemma amid joint pressure from nuclear neighbors
articles.author: Anthony Kuhn

paras.en: Japan faces diplomatic dilemma amid joint pressure from nuclear neighbors
paras.zh: 日本面临核邻国共同压力的外交困境

paras.en: As the Ukraine war grinds on, ties between Russia and neighboring Japan are at their worst in decades. Tokyo wants more support from Washington, but some Japanese are concerned they may not get it.
paras.zh: 随着乌克兰战争的持续，俄罗斯与邻国日本之间的关系正处于几十年来最糟糕的水平。东京希望得到华盛顿的更多支持，但一些日本人担心他们可能得不到华盛顿的支持。

paras.en: And now to Russia's war in Ukraine. This war has raised tensions not only in Europe but also in Asia. Ties between Russia and neighboring Japan are at their worst in decades. Tokyo would like more support from Washington, but as NPR's Anthony Kuhn reports, some Japanese people are concerned they may not get it.
paras.zh: 现在谈谈俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争。这场战争不仅加剧了欧洲的紧张局势，也加剧了亚洲的紧张局势。俄罗斯与邻国日本之间的关系处于几十年来最糟糕的水平。东京希望得到华盛顿的更多支持，但正如美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 安东尼·库恩 (Anthony Kuhn) 报道的那样，一些日本人担心他们可能无法得到支持。

paras.en: ANTHONY KUHN, BYLINE: In a video released by Russia's federal security bureau, FSB agents charge into a hotel room on Sakhalin Island in Russia's Far East on October 13.
paras.zh: 安东尼·库恩（ ANTHONY KUHN ） ，署名：在俄罗斯联邦安全局发布的一段视频中，联邦安全局特工于10月13日进入俄罗斯远东萨哈林岛的一间酒店房间。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED FSB AGENT: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: 身份不明的 FSB 特工：（非英语语言）。

paras.en: YUKI IMAI: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: 今井由纪：（非英语口语）。

paras.en: KUHN: The agents pin Japanese journalist Yuki Imai to the ground and handcuff him. They question him and take him to Moscow to face trial on charges of espionage. Japan's government denies the charges. The FSB says Imai was reporting on soldiers from Russia's Far East who were deployed to Ukraine. Shinji Hyodo, a Russia expert at the National Institute for Defense Studies in Tokyo, argues that the journalist was just doing his job.
paras.zh: 库恩：特工将日本记者今井由纪按在地上，并给他戴上手铐。他们审问了他，并将他带到莫斯科接受间谍指控的审判。日本政府否认这些指控。俄罗斯联邦安全局表示，今井正在报道部署到乌克兰的俄罗斯远东士兵的情况。东京国家防卫研究所的俄罗斯专家 Shinji Hyodo 认为，这名记者只是在做他的工作。

paras.en: SHINJI HYODO: (Through interpreter) I believe the Russian side intends to use this as a political bargaining chip to exert pressure on Japan.
paras.zh: 兵户真司：（通过翻译）我认为俄罗斯方面有意以此为政治筹码向日本施压。

paras.en: KUHN: Hyodo says that underlying the current tensions are Japan's sanctions on Russia for its invasion of Ukraine. Russia now sees Japan as hostile, and bilateral relations have gone into a tailspin.
paras.zh: 库恩：兵藤说，当前紧张局势的根本原因是日本对俄罗斯入侵乌克兰的制裁。俄罗斯现在将日本视为敌对国家，双边关系陷入混乱。

paras.en: HYODO: (Through interpreter) I think it's fair to say that Japan is currently facing its greatest diplomatic challenge since the end of the war. This is no longer just a bilateral issue between Japan and Russia.
paras.zh: 兵道：（通过翻译）我认为可以公平地说，日本目前面临着战后以来最大的外交挑战。这不再只是日本和俄罗斯之间的双边问题。

paras.en: KUHN: There's also what Hyodo calls the China factor. China has been putting pressure on Japan since last year, when Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said that a Chinese blockade of Taiwan could justify a Japanese military response. Russia relies on China's support in its war on Ukraine, and it's joined China in pressuring Japan. Another factor is a long-running territorial dispute between Russia and Japan.
paras.zh: 库恩：还有兵藤所说的中国因素。自去年以来，中国一直在向日本施加压力，当时日本首相高市早苗表示，中国对台湾的封锁可以证明日本有理由采取军事回应。俄罗斯在对乌克兰的战争中依赖中国的支持，并与中国一起向日本施压。另一个因素是俄罗斯和日本之间长期存在的领土争端。

paras.en: KUHN: In August, Russian President Vladimir Putin visited a seafood factory, hospital and school on his first visit to one of four disputed islands called the Southern Kurils by Russia and the Northern Territories by Japan. The Soviet Union seized the islands at the end of World War II. They never signed a permanent peace treaty because of the dispute and because the U.S. warned them not to. This episode was called the Dulles intervention. James Brown, an expert on Japan-Russia relations at Temple University in Tokyo, explains.
paras.zh: 库恩：八月，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京首次访问俄罗斯称为南千岛群岛、日本称为北方四岛的四个有争议岛屿之一，参观了一家海鲜工厂、医院和学校。第二次世界大战结束时，苏联占领了这些岛屿。由于争端以及美国警告他们不要这样做，他们从未签署永久和平条约。这一事件被称为杜勒斯干预。东京天普大学日俄关系专家詹姆斯·布朗解释道。

paras.en: JAMES BROWN: This was the suggestion from John Foster Dulles, the secretary of state, in 1956 that if Japan were to make an agreement with the Soviet Union, settling the territorial dispute, well, then perhaps the United States would remain forevermore in holding, administering Okinawa.
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·布朗：这是美国国务卿约翰·福斯特·杜勒斯在 1956 年提出的建议，如果日本与苏联达成协议，解决领土争端，那么也许美国将永远保留并管理冲绳。

paras.en: KUHN: So the Soviet Union kept the islands, and the U.S. returned to Japan the island of Okinawa, which remains a key U.S. military hub in Asia. Brown says Japan's media generally don't mention the U.S.'s role in the territorial dispute so as not to offend its only ally as it faces three nuclear powers - Russia, China and North Korea.
paras.zh: 库恩：所以苏联保留了这些岛屿，而美国则将冲绳岛归还给日本，冲绳岛仍然是美国在亚洲的重要军事枢纽。布朗表示，日本媒体一般不会提及美国在领土争端中所扮演的角色，以免冒犯日本唯一的盟友，因为日本面临俄罗斯、中国和朝鲜这三个核大国。

paras.en: BROWN: Japan's situation is essentially they have no Plan B, which means that they have to rely on the United States. They have to flatter the Trump administration. They have to do everything possible to avoid abandonment.
paras.zh: 布朗：日本的情况本质上是他们没有B计划，这意味着他们必须依赖美国。他们必须奉承特朗普政府。他们必须尽一切可能避免被遗弃。

paras.en: KUHN: The U.S. has criticized Russia's arrest of the Japanese journalist, but Shinji Hyodo says that the U.S. generally doesn't seem very interested in Japan's conflict with Russia. And he says Japan is concerned about the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen, China, this month.
paras.zh: 库恩：美国批评了俄罗斯逮捕日本记者的行为，但兵藤慎二表示，美国总体上似乎对日俄冲突不太感兴趣。他还表示，日本对本月在中国深圳举行的亚太经济合作组织峰会感到担忧。

paras.en: HYODO: (Through interpreter) There is a possibility that a trilateral summit involving the leaders of the U.S., China and Russia could take place, potentially leading to the U.S. being swayed toward the positions held by China and Russia.
paras.zh: 兵道：（通过翻译）有可能举行由美国、中国和俄罗斯领导人参加的三边峰会，这可能会导致美国倾向于中国和俄罗斯的立场。

paras.en: KUHN: It's unclear whether Japan's Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi will meet with either Russian or Chinese leaders at the summit. Anthony Kuhn, NPR News, Seoul.
paras.zh: 库恩：目前还不清楚日本首相高市早苗是否会在峰会上会见俄罗斯或中国领导人。安东尼·库恩，NPR 新闻，首尔。
