paras.en: Technicians can follow links within Alldata to related testing, removal and installation procedures, illustrations and service precautions.
paras.zh: 技术人员可以通过 Alldata 中的链接查看相关测试、拆卸和安装程序、插图和服务预防措施。

paras.en: The integration carries vehicle and fault-code information into the repair-information workflow, reducing the need for separate searches. It also helps technicians move from diagnosis to repair.
paras.zh: 该集成将车辆和故障代码信息纳入维修信息工作流程，从而减少单独搜索的需要。它还可以帮助技术人员从诊断转向修复。

paras.en: The integration also provides access to Alldata Diagnostic Intelligence, Alldata’s newest solution. It combines OEM repair information, real-world repair intelligence and AI-assisted insights in one diagnostic workflow, according to the company.
paras.zh: 该集成还提供对 Alldata 最新解决方案 Alldata Diagnostic Intelligence 的访问。据该公司称，它将 OEM 维修信息、现实世界的维修智能和人工智能辅助的见解结合在一个诊断工作流程中。

articles.title: NexaMotion Group on ‘Creating More Room for Greater Expertise’
articles.author: Jason Morgan

paras.en: More than 100 NexaMotion Group employees are actively using AI, NMG’s CEO Neil Sethi said. Much of that use begins with analytics. CRM information that once required employees to work through large amounts of data manually can now be summarized and analyzed quickly.
paras.zh: NMG 首席执行官 Neil Sethi 表示，超过 100 名 NexaMotion Group 员工正在积极使用人工智能。其中大部分用途都是从分析开始的。曾经需要员工手动处理大量数据的 CRM 信息现在可以快速汇总和分析。

paras.en: “We’re trying to allow our team members to really get the busy work out of their day-to-day lives and really put their intellectual horsepower to work more and more,” he said. “Which is really great for us because they’re really the asset that we have.”
paras.zh: “我们正在努力让我们的团队成员真正从日常生活中摆脱繁忙的工作，并真正将他们的智力更多地投入到工作中，”他说。 “这对我们来说真的很棒，因为它们确实是我们拥有的资产。”

paras.en: Naresh Kopparapu, NexaMotion Group’s chief information officer, grounds those projects in measurable business problems.
paras.zh: NexaMotion 集团首席信息官 Naresh Kopparapu 将这些项目建立在可衡量的业务问题之上。

paras.en: “We are looking at solving the customer’s problems. We have to put an AI where there’s a real cash flow or a real customer problem and see how we measure AI is able to help us with,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们正在考虑解决客户的问题。我们必须将人工智能放在有真正现金流或真正客户问题的地方，然后看看我们如何衡量人工智能能够帮助我们解决问题，”他说。

paras.en: Sales and service calls are one example. NexaMotion can summarize and score interactions, giving leaders visibility across a volume of calls they could never review individually.
paras.zh: 销售和服务电话就是一个例子。 NexaMotion 可以对交互进行总结和评分，让领导者能够了解他们无法单独查看的大量通话。

paras.en: “It gives the leadership information so that they can coach at scale because it used to be very difficult to go down that level,” Kopparapu said. “With all the tools that we have, we can summarize, we can create insights with the data that we generate. It’s not sitting in a database or a spreadsheet anymore.”
paras.zh: “它为领导层提供了信息，以便他们能够进行大规模指导，因为过去很难降到这个级别，”科帕拉普说。 “总结一下，利用我们拥有的所有工具，我们可以利用生成的数据创建见解。它不再存在于数据库或电子表格中。”

paras.en: That visibility supports a customer relationship that can operate across multiple forms of communication. Some shops prefer digital ordering and primarily want accurate availability and a dependable ETA for deliveries. Others want to call the person they have dealt with for years.
paras.zh: 这种可见性支持可以跨多种通信形式运作的客户关系。一些商店更喜欢数字订购，主要希望获得准确的供货情况和可靠的预计交货时间。其他人则想给已经打交道多年的人打电话。

paras.en: Billy Gwinn, executive vice president, NexaMotion Group operations and general repair sales, sees Transend eventually supporting that broader customer experience across both transmission and general repair with programs like the aforementioned Platinum Program.
paras.zh: NexaMotion 集团运营和一般维修销售执行副总裁 Billy Gwinn 认为 Transend 最终会通过上述白金计划等计划支持变速箱和一般维修方面更广泛的客户体验。

paras.en: “A customer may want to pay a dollar more to get the part in a timely manner versus having to wait two hours because then they have to deal with their customer who’s waiting for a part,” Gwinn said. “Ultimately Transend is the platform of the future.”
paras.zh: 格温说：“客户可能希望多付一美元才能及时获得零件，而不是等待两个小时，因为那样他们就必须与正在等待零件的客户打交道。” “最终 Transend 是未来的平台。”

paras.en: Kevin Rozsa, executive vice president of NMG mergers and acquisitions and Transtar sales, sees the same opportunity on the Transtar side. Customers who become more comfortable identifying and ordering straightforward parts through Transend give NexaMotion’s telephonic sales team additional room for consultative conversations.
paras.zh: NMG 并购和 Transtar 销售执行副总裁 Kevin Rozsa 在 Transtar 方面也看到了同样的机会。通过 Transend 更轻松地识别和订购简单零件的客户为 NexaMotion 的电话销售团队提供了更多的咨询对话空间。

paras.en: “Every time a customer places an order on Transend, our sales reps are automatically notified of that order and what it is,” Rozsa said. “Our reps can then review that and then reach out to the customer and say, ‘For this application have you considered these other items? Because these are important items to use in a complete rebuild.’”
paras.zh: “每次客户在 Transend 下订单时，我们的销售代表都会自动收到该订单及其内容的通知，”Rozsa 说。 “然后我们的代表可以对此进行审查，然后联系客户并询问，‘对于此应用程序，您考虑过这些其他项目吗？因为这些是在完整重建中使用的重要项目。’”

paras.en: Sethi sees that idea expanding much further as AI becomes better at connecting large datasets. Diagnostics, repair information, procurement, sourcing and planning all produce information. Connecting those systems could give participants throughout the supply chain a clearer view of what is happening and what actions to take.
paras.zh: Sethi 认为，随着人工智能在连接大型数据集方面变得更好，这一想法将得到进一步扩展。诊断、维修信息、采购、采购和规划都会产生信息。连接这些系统可以让整个供应链的参与者更清楚地了解正在发生的事情以及要采取的行动。

paras.en: “A lot of the data was already analyzed before the meeting,” Sethi said, describing a recent conversation with a key partner. “Now we’re talking about affecting the interworking relationship. So, they could take their datasets that have given them information and ours to, like, make change happen.”
paras.zh: “在会议之前已经分析了很多数据，”塞西在描述最近与一位重要合作伙伴的对话时说道。 “现在我们正在讨论影响互通关系。因此，他们可以利用为他们提供信息的数据集和我们的数据集来实现变革。”

paras.en: The people in the room still determine where to go next.
paras.zh: 房间里的人仍然决定下一步该去哪里。

paras.en: “We’re going to have to use our intelligence, our knowledge, our expertise and trust,” Sethi said. “Trust is not going to be AI driven.”
paras.zh: “我们必须利用我们的智慧、知识、专业知识和信任，”塞西说。 “信任不会由人工智能驱动。”

paras.en: For all of NexaMotion’s investment in systems capable of seeing across thousands of products and customer interactions, Sethi continues to look for information at its most immediate source: The shop.
paras.zh: 尽管 NexaMotion 对能够查看数千种产品和客户互动的系统进行了所有投资，但 Sethi 仍继续从最直接的来源寻找信息：商店。

paras.en: “I think any executive leadership team can get really entrapped in conference rooms. Literally, all day, every day, forever,” Sethi said. “At NMG we want to be in the field with the shops, understanding what they’re doing, understanding what they’re seeing.”
paras.zh: “我认为任何执行领导团队都可能真正陷入会议室。毫不夸张地说，整天、每一天、永远，”塞西说。 “在 NMG，我们希望与商店一起深入现场，了解他们在做什么，了解他们所看到的内容。”

paras.en: Technology gives NexaMotion more ways to see that future taking shape. The work comes in translating those signals and the intel they produce into something useful for the technician, the customer, the employee and, ultimately, the repair and parts requirements in front of them.
paras.zh: 技术为 NexaMotion 提供了更多方式来实现未来。我们的工作是将这些信号及其产生的情报转化为对技术人员、客户、员工以及最终对他们面前的维修和零件需求有用的东西。

paras.en: Pictured: The NMG team (left to right): Neil Sethi, Scott Weinstein, Kevin Rozsa, Billy Gwinn, Tim Cox, Naresh Kopparapu.
paras.zh: 图为：NMG 团队（从左到右）：Neil Sethi、Scott Weinstein、Kevin Rozsa、Billy Gwinn、Tim Cox、Naresh Kopparapu。

paras.en: Please note: This article concludes the 3-part NexaMotion Group article series.
paras.zh: 请注意：本文是由 3 部分组成的 NexaMotion Group 文章系列的总结。

paras.en: Part 1, NexaMotion Group on ‘Making Smarter Connections,’ can be found here.
paras.zh: 第 1 部分，NexaMotion Group 关于“打造更智能的连接”，可在此处找到。

paras.en: Part 2, NexaMotion Group on ‘Turning Information Into Better Decisions,’ can be viewed here.
paras.zh: 您可以在此处查看 NexaMotion Group 关于“将信息转化为更好的决策”的第 2 部分。

articles.title: Advance Auto Parts Opens New Store in Newnan, Ga.
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Advance Auto Parts opened its newest store in Newnan, expanding access to parts, tools and expertise for local drivers and automotive professionals. The company marked the opening of the store at 216 Bullsboro Dr. with a ribbon-cutting ceremony alongside local officials and representatives from West Georgia Technical College who were on site to accept a donation for the school’s automotive technology program.
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 在纽南开设了最新的商店，为当地驾驶员和汽车专业人士提供更多零件、工具和专业知识。该公司为庆祝位于 Bullsboro Dr. 216 号的商店开业，举行了剪彩仪式，当地官员和西乔治亚技术学院的代表在现场接受了学校汽车技术项目的捐款。

paras.en: The donation will help students gain hands-on experience, training and career opportunities through the College’s automotive technology programs. Skilled automotive technicians continue to be in high demand, with approximately 70,000 openings projected annually through 2034, according to U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.
paras.zh: 此次捐赠将帮助学生通过学院的汽车技术项目获得实践经验、培训和职业机会。根据美国劳工统计局的数据，熟练的汽车技术人员的需求量仍然很高，预计到 2034 年，每年大约有 70,000 个职位空缺。

paras.en: “We’re excited to open our newest store in Newnan and continue serving customers across the area,” said Mike Fogarty, Rregional vice president, Advance Auto Parts. “This location helps us better support local drivers and professional customers with convenient access to the parts, and products they rely on. We’re also proud to support students at West Georgia Technical College and strengthen our connection to the Newnan community.”
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 区域副总裁 Mike Fogarty 表示：“我们很高兴在纽南开设最新的商店，并继续为该地区的客户提供服务。” “这个地点帮助我们更好地支持当地司机和专业客户，方便地获取他们所依赖的零件和产品。我们也很自豪能够为西乔治亚技术学院的学生提供支持，并加强我们与纽南社区的联系。”

paras.en: “Community support plays an important role in career and technical education,” said Brittney Wells, executive director of institutional advancement at West Georgia Technical College. “We are grateful to Advance Auto Parts for this contribution, which helps support our students as they gain practical experience and explore opportunities in the automotive industry.”
paras.zh: “社区支持在职业和技术教育中发挥着重要作用，”西乔治亚技术学院机构发展执行主任布里特尼·韦尔斯说。 “我们感谢 Advance Auto Parts 的这一贡献，这有助于支持我们的学生获得实践经验并探索汽车行业的机会。”

paras.en: The new store also serves as a market hub – a centralized facility designed to improve parts availability and same-day fulfillment across a network of stores, enhancing hard parts coverage for professional customers.
paras.zh: 新商店还充当市场中心——一个集中设施，旨在提高整个商店网络的零件可用性和当日履行能力，从而提高专业客户的硬件零件覆盖率。

articles.title: GSP Launches All-New, Core-Free Brake Caliper Line
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: GSP North America announced the GSP ADVANTEDGE Brake Caliper program, an all-new caliper range that frees distributors from the cost and hassle of managing cores. It’s on display at AAPEX, booth #F14611.
paras.zh: GSP North America 宣布了 GSP ADVANTEDGE 制动卡钳计划，这是一个全新的卡钳系列，可让经销商免于管理核心的成本和麻烦。它在 AAPEX 上展出，展位号：F14611。

paras.en: Every caliper is entirely new, distributors no longer need to handle, store, sort and ship cores back to the supplier, GSP said.
paras.zh: GSP 表示，每个卡钳都是全新的，经销商不再需要处理、存储、分类并将卡钳运回供应商。

paras.en: Every unit is built from the ground up with OE-matched components:
paras.zh: 每个单元均采用与原厂设备匹配的组件从头开始构建：

paras.en: - Precision-cast ductile iron or aluminum bodies and carrier brackets, with precision-machined surfaces and threads
paras.zh: - 精密铸造球墨铸铁或铝主体和托架，具有精密加工的表面和螺纹

paras.en: - OE-specified phenolic or steel pistons to match each braking system
paras.zh: - OE 指定的酚醛或钢活塞，以匹配每个制动系统

paras.en: - OE-grade EPDM seals and boots that hold piston pressure and keep contaminants out
paras.zh: - OE 级 EPDM 密封件和防尘套可保持活塞压力并防止污染物进入

paras.en: - Installation hardware included: copper washers, new banjo bolt and abutment clips
paras.zh: - 安装硬件包括：铜垫圈、新的班卓琴螺栓和基台夹

paras.en: - 100% end-of-line pressure and leak validated before leaving the factory
paras.zh: - 出厂前经过 100% 终端压力和泄漏验证

paras.en: The initial range covers more than 80% of category demand and is expected to reach 95% within 12 months of its formal launch at AAPEX.
paras.zh: 最初的产品系列覆盖了80%以上的品类需求，预计在AAPEX正式推出后12个月内将达到95%。

paras.en: The range is produced at GSP’s new manufacturing facility in Malaysia. GSP’s distribution partners can expect the same high-level quality and execution they have experienced in all GSP lines, the company said.
paras.zh: 该系列产品在 GSP 位于马来西亚的新制造工厂生产。该公司表示，GSP 的分销合作伙伴可以期待与所有 GSP 系列产品相同的高水平质量和执行力。

paras.en: “The GSP ADVANTEDGE Brake Caliper program is designed to improve distributors’ operational performance, increase bay throughput through enhanced quality and, ultimately, give customers restored and reliable braking performance,” said Tom Galla, director of new products for GSP North America.
paras.zh: GSP 北美新产品总监 Tom Galla 表示：“GSP ADVANTEDGE 制动卡钳计划旨在提高经销商的运营绩效，通过提高质量来增加海湾吞吐量，并最终为客户提供恢复且可靠的制动性能。”

articles.title: AWDA Names Richard and Lisa Beirne 2026 Outstanding Leader
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: The Aftermarket Warehouse Distributors Association (AWDA), a community of the Auto Care Association, celebrated the recipients of its 2026 AWDA Industry Awards during the AWDA General Session on Nov. 1 in Las Vegas, Nevada. The annual awards take place during the AWDA Annual Business Conference and recognize individuals who exemplify leadership, innovation, education and service to the automotive aftermarket.
paras.zh: 汽车护理协会下属的售后仓库分销商协会 (AWDA) 于 11 月 1 日在内华达州拉斯维加斯举行的 AWDA 全体会议上庆祝了 2026 年 AWDA 行业奖的获得者。该年度奖项在 AWDA 年度商务会议期间颁发，旨在表彰在汽车售后市场发挥领导力、创新、教育和服务作用的个人。

paras.en: AWDA presented its 2026 Outstanding Leadership Award in honor of Jack Creamer to Richard and Lisa Beirne of Auto Parts Headquarters.
paras.zh: AWDA 向汽车零部件总部的 Richard Beirne 和 Lisa Beirne 颁发了 2026 年杰出领导奖，以表彰 Jack Creamer。

paras.en: Formerly known as the “Leader of the Year,” the award honors an aftermarket professional who has contributed to the industry in a unique and significant way. It is named for former AWDA President Jack Creamer. The award was presented by 2025 recipient Don Bickle, former AWDA Treasurer.
paras.zh: 该奖项以前被称为“年度领袖”，旨在表彰以独特而重大的方式为该行业做出贡献的售后市场专业人士。它以 AWDA 前主席 Jack Creamer 的名字命名。该奖项由 2025 年获奖者、前 AWDA 财务主管 Don Bickle 颁发。

paras.en: Richard’s aftermarket career spans nearly six decades, beginning in 1968 as a delivery driver. With Lisa’s steadfast partnership, he led United Auto Supply as president and CEO, guided its successful partnership with Automotive Parts Headquarters (APH), and built a reputation for valuing employees, customers and supplier partners. Today, he serves as a senior advisor for APH, while he and Lisa continue supporting APH and Auto Value expansion efforts throughout the Midwest.
paras.zh: Richard 的售后职业生涯长达近 60 年，从 1968 年担任送货司机开始。在 Lisa 坚定的合作伙伴关系下，他作为总裁兼首席执行官领导了 United Auto Supply，指导其与汽车零部件总部 (APH) 的成功合作，并建立了重视员工、客户和供应商合作伙伴的声誉。如今，他担任 APH 的高级顾问，同时他和 Lisa 继续支持 APH 和汽车价值在中西部地区的扩张工作。

paras.en: Richard’s decades of AWDA service include roles as board member, treasurer, chairman, treasurer emeritus and lifetime board member. He also helped lead AWDA’s merger with the Automotive Aftermarket Industry Association. Richard and Lisa have participated in Auto Care Association Leadership Meetings, Capitol Hill advocacy and Right to Repair initiatives, while consistently supporting the Auto Care Political Action Committee.
paras.zh: Richard 在 AWDA 服务了数十年，担任过董事会成员、财务主管、董事长、名誉财务主管和终身董事会成员。他还帮助领导了 AWDA 与汽车售后市场行业协会的合并。理查德和丽莎参加了汽车护理协会领导会议、国会山倡导和维修权倡议，同时一贯支持汽车护理政治行动委员会。

paras.en: The Beirnes’ investment in the next generation is equally significant. Richard serves on the University of the Aftermarket Foundation Board of Trustees and has supported its scholarship and contributions work. Richard and Lisa became Lifetime Trustees in 2019 and, in 2025, were the first individuals named Gold Lifetime Trustees, recognizing cumulative contributions exceeding $250,000.
paras.zh: 贝尔恩斯家族对下一代的投资同样重要。理查德在售后市场大学基金会董事会任职，并支持其奖学金和捐款工作。 Richard 和 Lisa 于 2019 年成为终身受托人，并于 2025 年成为第一批被命名为“黄金终身受托人”的个人，表彰累计捐款超过 25 万美元。

articles.title: Eric Johnson Receives 2026 AWDA Pursuit of Excellence Award
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: The Aftermarket Warehouse Distributors Association (AWDA), a community of the Auto Care Association, presented its 2026 Pursuit of Excellence Award to Eric Johnson, President and CEO of Arnold Motor Supply and The Merrill Company in Spencer, Iowa. The award was presented by AWDA Secretary Cliff Hovis at the association’s 2026 Annual Conference on November in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: 汽车护理协会下属的售后仓库分销商协会 (AWDA) 向位于爱荷华州斯宾塞的 Arnold Motor Supply 和 Merrill Company 总裁兼首席执行官 Eric Johnson 颁发了 2026 年追求卓越奖。该奖项由 AWDA 秘书 Cliff Hovis 在 11 月于拉斯维加斯举行的协会 2026 年年会上颁发。

paras.en: Established in 1983, the award recognizes an AWDA member for special achievement and for setting high standards in business, volunteer service or advocacy. AWDA Secretary Cliff Hovis presented the award.
paras.zh: 该奖项设立于 1983 年，旨在表彰 AWDA 成员在商业、志愿服务或宣传方面取得的特殊成就和制定的高标准。 AWDA 秘书长克利夫·霍维斯颁发了该奖项。

paras.en: As president and managing partner of Arnold Motor Supply, Eric Johnson has combined technological advancement with a customer- and employee-first culture. He championed investments in e-commerce, digital tools, data-driven operations and cybersecurity education to strengthen customer engagement, operational efficiency and employee readiness.
paras.zh: 作为 Arnold Motor Supply 的总裁兼管理合伙人，Eric Johnson 将技术进步与客户和员工至上的文化结合起来。他倡导对电子商务、数字工具、数据驱动的运营和网络安全教育进行投资，以加强客户参与度、运营效率和员工准备程度。

paras.en: Johnson has also built a culture of continuous learning through training for employees, managers and sales teams. The company’s annual Roadshow brings together more than 130 vendors and over 1,500 attendees for hands-on training, product education and collaboration.
paras.zh: 约翰逊还通过对员工、经理和销售团队的培训建立了持续学习的文化。该公司的年度路演汇聚了 130 多家供应商和 1,500 多名与会者，进行实践培训、产品教育和协作。

paras.en: Beyond Arnold Motor Supply, Eric serves on the Board of Directors of the Aftermarket Auto Parts Alliance, Inc., and supports Alliance University, Northwood University’s University of the Aftermarket and other professional development programs. His contributions were recognized with the 2025 Mort Schwartz Excellence in Education Award. He has also supported charitable initiatives, including the company’s annual golf outing benefiting Tori’s Angels, and provided steady, employee-focused leadership during historic flooding affecting the company and its communities.
paras.zh: 除了 Arnold Motor Supply 之外，Eric 还担任售后汽车零部件联盟 (Aftermarket Auto Parts Alliance, Inc.) 的董事会成员，并支持联盟大学 (Alliance University)、诺斯伍德大学 (Northwood University) 的售后市场大学和其他专业发展项目。他的贡献获得了 2025 年 Mort Schwartz 卓越教育奖的认可。他还支持慈善活动，包括公司每年一度为托里天使 (Tori’s Angels) 举办的高尔夫郊游活动，并在影响公司及其社区的历史性洪水期间提供稳定、以员工为中心的领导。

articles.title: Bennie Skelton Named 2026 WIX Filters Counter Pro of the Year
articles.author: Jason Morgan

paras.en: WIX Filters and Counterman have named Bennie Skelton of Crow-Burlingame’s Bumper to Bumper store in Neosho, Missouri, the 2026 Counter Professional of the Year. Skelton brings more than four decades of parts experience to the counter, building customer relationships that now extend across generations. His career reflects a commitment to helping customers and a determination to overcome challenges.
paras.zh: WIX Filters 和 Counterman 任命密苏里州 Neosho 的 Crow-Burlingame Bumper to Bumper 商店的 Bennie Skelton 为 2026 年度柜台专业人士。 Skelton 将四十多年的零件经验带到了柜台，建立了跨越几代人的客户关系。他的职业生涯体现了帮助客户的承诺和克服挑战的决心。

paras.en: Skelton entered the parts field in 1980 when he enlisted in the U.S. Air Force. During 12 years of service, he learned to identify parts using microfiche and paper catalogs, measure engine components and supervise military and civilian personnel. While stationed in California, he worked weekends at an auto parts story after leaving the Air Force in 1992. Skelton joined Crow-Burlingame in 2009.
paras.zh: Skelton 于 1980 年加入美国空军，进入零部件领域。在 12 年的服役生涯中，他学会了使用缩微胶片和纸质目录来识别零件、测量发动机部件以及监督军事和文职人员。 1992 年离开空军后，他在加利福尼亚州驻扎期间，周末在一家汽车零部件公司工作。Skelton 于 2009 年加入 Crow-Burlingame。

paras.en: “Bennie has great customer service and has a lifetime of knowledge,” said Darren Brewer, manager of the Neosho store. “I don’t have to tell him to do something when he sees it needs to be done, he does it. He’s the best man I’ve ever worked with. ”
paras.zh: Neosho 商店经理达伦·布鲁尔 (Darren Brewer) 表示：“Bennie 拥有出色的客户服务和终生的知识。” “当他认为需要做某事时，我不必告诉他做某事，他就会去做。他是我共事过的最好的人。”

paras.en: Brewer credits Skelton with helping strengthen the store’s financial performance and praised his initiative, sales ability and perseverance.
paras.zh: 布鲁尔称赞斯克尔顿帮助加强了商店的财务业绩，并赞扬了他的主动性、销售能力和毅力。

paras.en: In 2012, Skelton suffered a major stroke that affected his speech and the use of his right side. He spent months relearning how to walk and talk, adapting to perform tasks left-handed. Today, he continues building hydraulic hoses, pulling parts and completing paperwork while serving the customers he knows so well.
paras.zh: 2012年，斯克尔顿遭遇严重中风，影响了他的言语和右侧肢体的使用。他花了几个月的时间重新学习如何走路和说话，以适应用左手执行任务。如今，他继续制造液压软管、拉动零件并完成文书工作，同时为他熟悉的客户提供服务。

paras.en: Established in 1986, Counter Professional of the Year recognizes excellence among automotive aftermarket parts professionals. WIX Filters has sponsored the program since 2006.
paras.zh: Counter Professional of the Year 成立于 1986 年，旨在表彰汽车售后市场零部件专业人士的卓越表现。 WIX Filters 自 2006 年以来一直赞助该计划。

articles.title: 1,600-year-old burial holds remains of man infected with a 'very rare' strain of leprosy in Germany
articles.author: Kristina Killgrove

paras.en: Archaeologists investigating the genomes of a dozen people buried in an abandoned Roman-era settlement in northwestern Germany have discovered a surprising organism lurking in one man's remains: a rare strain of Mycobacterium leprae, which causes leprosy.
paras.zh: 考古学家对埋在德国西北部罗马时代废弃定居点的十几个人的基因组进行了调查，发现一名男子的遗骸中潜藏着一种令人惊讶的生物体：一种罕见的麻风分枝杆菌菌株，它会导致麻风病。

paras.en: This strain of leprosy has never been seen in this part of Europe before, which hints that the individual had traveled and interacted with people from across the Roman world. The man was buried in a wooden boat surrounded by unusual objects, indicating he was a high-status person, according to a research study.
paras.zh: 这种麻风病菌株以前从未在欧洲的这一地区出现过，这表明该人曾与来自罗马世界各地的人们旅行并互动。一项研究显示，这名男子被埋在一艘木船上，周围摆满了不寻常的物品，表明他是一个地位很高的人。

paras.en: "The results were particularly striking in the case of one individual," study co-author Ben Krause-Kyora, an archaeologist at the Institute of Clinical Molecular Biology (IKMB) at Kiel University in Germany, said in a Nov. 3 statement. "He could, for example, have been a mercenary in the Roman army who later settled between the Elbe and the Weser [rivers]."
paras.zh: 该研究的共同作者、德国基尔大学临床分子生物学研究所 (IKMB) 的考古学家 Ben Krause-Kyora 在 11 月 3 日的一份声明中表示：“对于一个人来说，结果尤其引人注目。” “例如，他可能是罗马军队中的一名雇佣兵，后来定居在易北河和威悉河之间。”

paras.en: In the study, published online Oct. 15 in the journal iScience, Krause-Kyora and colleagues analyzed the genomes of people buried at the coastal settlement of Fallward. The settlement originated in the first century B.C. but gradually declined and became a cemetery by the fifth century A.D. Among the 200 cremation burials and 60 inhumation burials originally excavated in the 1990s was a distinctive grave made from a wooden boat.
paras.zh: 在 10 月 15 日在线发表在《iScience》杂志上的这项研究中，Krause-Kyora 和同事分析了埋在福尔沃德沿海定居点的人们的基因组。该定居点起源于公元前一世纪。但到公元五世纪逐渐衰落，成为墓地。在200年代最初发掘的200座火葬墓和60座土葬墓中，有一个独特的木船坟墓。

paras.en: The oak boat was over 13 feet (4 meters) long and sealed with a roof-like structure, the researchers said. It held the skeleton of a man who was about 50 years old when he died some time between A.D. 425 and 450. His grave goods included a small box shaped like a water bird, an ornate chair or throne carved out of alder wood, a bronze basin and a maple stool with a hunting scene and a runic inscription. The maritime artifacts coupled with the man's well-developed upper arm bones suggest he may have worked as a fisherman or boatman just before he died, the researchers wrote.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，这艘橡木船长超过 13 英尺（4 米），并用屋顶状结构密封。里面装着一具大约 50 岁男子的骨架，他死于公元 425 年至 450 年之间的某个时间。他的陪葬品包括一个水鸟形状的小盒子、一张用桤木雕刻而成的华丽椅子或王座、一个青铜盆和一张带有狩猎场景和符文铭文的枫木凳子。研究人员写道，这些海事文物加上该男子发育良好的上臂骨骼表明，他在去世前可能曾担任过渔民或船夫。

paras.en: "The grave goods placed in the tomb aroused particular scientific interest," study co-author Hauke Jöns, an archaeologist at the Lower Saxony Institute for Historical Coastal Research, said in the statement. "The man possessed a late Roman military belt, which suggested that the deceased had had connections across great distances."
paras.zh: 该研究的共同作者、下萨克森历史沿海研究所的考古学家豪克·琼斯在声明中表示：“墓中的随葬品引起了特别的科学兴趣。” “该男子拥有一条晚期罗马军用腰带，这表明死者与远方有联系。”

paras.en: To learn more about this unusual burial and to determine where the man was from, researchers analyzed his DNA.
paras.zh: 为了更多地了解这个不寻常的墓葬并确定该男子来自哪里，研究人员分析了他的 DNA。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: "Genetic analyses confirm that a man buried at Fallward originated from the Danube region," study first author Daniel Myburgh, an ancient DNA researcher at IKMB, said in the statement. "He was also infected with a very rare leprosy pathogen."
paras.zh: 研究第一作者、IKMB 古代 DNA 研究员 Daniel Myburgh 在声明中表示：“基因分析证实，埋葬在 Fallward 的一名男子来自多瑙河地区。” “他还感染了一种非常罕见的麻风病病原体。”

paras.en: The researchers found the DNA of the bacterium M. leprae in one of the man's teeth and in a foot bone. Because the leprosy DNA was so well preserved, the researchers were able to narrow down the strain that had infected him. This strain of leprosy may have evolved in Egypt around the fourth to second centuries B.C. and had never before been found in Central or Northern Europe, according to the statement.
paras.zh: 研究人员在该男子的一颗牙齿和一根脚骨中发现了麻风分枝杆菌的 DNA。由于麻风病 DNA 保存得如此完好，研究人员能够缩小感染他的菌株范围。这种麻风病株可能是在公元前四世纪至二世纪左右在埃及进化而来的。声明称，此前从未在中欧或北欧发现过。

paras.en: But the man showed no signs of leprosy lesions in his skeleton, the researchers said. Leprosy first attacks the nerves and skin, but it can eventually eat away at the bones of the skeleton, particularly affecting the nose, jaw, hands and feet.
paras.zh: 但研究人员表示，这名男子的骨骼中没有显示出麻风病病变的迹象。麻风病首先攻击神经和皮肤，但最终会侵蚀骨骼，特别是影响鼻子、下巴、手和脚。

paras.en: "Leprosy is a chronic disease," study co-author Almut Nebel, a biologist at IKMB, said in the statement. "Either he was affected by an asymptomatic form of the disease, or the disease had so far only affected soft tissues. He may have travelled long distances whilst carrying the disease."
paras.zh: “麻风病是一种慢性疾病，”研究合著者、IKMB 生物学家阿尔穆特·内贝尔在声明中说。 “要么他受到了无症状疾病的影响，要么这种疾病迄今为止只影响了软组织。他可能在携带这种疾病的情况下长途旅行。”

paras.en: While the researchers don't know exactly what happened in this man's life, they suggested he might have been a mercenary who served in the Roman army and later retired to northwest Germany, becoming a high-status member of the community who was honored with an alder-wood "throne" in his burial. But he also may have acquired the Roman belt through trade, inheritance or as a war trophy, the researchers wrote.
paras.zh: 虽然研究人员并不确切知道这个人的一生中发生了什么，但他们认为他可能是一名在罗马军队服役的雇佣兵，后来退休到德国西北部，成为社区中地位较高的成员，并在他的葬礼上获得了桤木“王座”。但研究人员写道，他也可能通过贸易、继承或作为战利品获得了罗马腰带。

paras.en: Either way, the man's skeleton and his grave goods suggest that northwest Germany had long-distance connections in Europe even after the fall of the Roman Empire, according to the statement.
paras.zh: 声明称，无论如何，该男子的骨架和他的随葬品表明，即使在罗马帝国灭亡之后，德国西北部仍然与欧洲保持着长途联系。

paras.en: Myburgh, D. A., da Silva, N. A., Romeyer-Dherbey, J. H., Grefen-Peters, S., Jöns, H., Peek, C., Nebel, A., & Krause-Kyora, B. (2026). Paleogenomics reveals leprosy at the late antique burial site of Fallward in northern Germany. iScience, 29(11), 117877. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.isci.2026.117877
paras.zh: Myburgh, D. A.、da Silva, N. A.、Romeyer-Dherbey, J. H.、Grefen-Peters, S.、Jöns, H.、Peek, C.、Nebel, A. 和 Krause-Kyora, B. (2026)。古基因组学揭示了德国北部法尔沃德晚期古董墓地的麻风病。 iScience，29(11), 117877。 https://doi.org/10.1016/j.isci.2026.117877

paras.en: What do you know about the bones in your body? Test your knowledge with our human skeleton quiz.
paras.zh: 你对身体的骨骼了解多少？通过我们的人体骨骼测验来测试您的知识。

paras.en: Kristina Killgrove is a staff writer at Live Science with a focus on archaeology and paleoanthropology news. Her articles have also appeared in venues such as Forbes, Smithsonian, and Mental Floss. Kristina holds a Ph.D. in biological anthropology and an M.A. in classical archaeology from the University of North Carolina, as well as a B.A. in Latin from the University of Virginia, and she was formerly a university professor and researcher. She has received awards from the Society for American Archaeology and the American Anthropological Association for her science writing.
paras.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·基尔格罗夫 (Kristina Killgrove) 是《Live Science》的特约撰稿人，专注于考古学和古人类学新闻。她的文章还发表在《福布斯》、《史密森尼》和《Mental Floss》等杂志上。克里斯蒂娜拥有博士学位。北卡罗来纳大学生物人类学学士学位和古典考古学硕士学位，以及北卡罗来纳大学古典考古学学士学位。她拥有弗吉尼亚大学拉丁语学位，曾任大学教授和研究员。她因其科学写作而获得美国考古学会和美国人类学协会颁发的奖项。

articles.title: Cryptic padlock from a 400-year-old shipwreck finally opened ‪—‬ but it leaves a mystery
articles.author: Patrick Pester

paras.en: An Elizabethan padlock has been opened for the first time in more than 400 years after researchers used X-ray imaging techniques to crack its four-letter combination.
paras.zh: 研究人员利用 X 射线成像技术破解了一把伊丽莎白时代的挂锁的四个字母组合，400 多年来首次被打开。

paras.en: The brass lock was part of the Ann Francis treasure hoard, named after the British merchant ship that wrecked during a storm off the coast of Wales in 1583. Researchers believe the lock once secured a chest aboard the ship, before becoming separated from whatever riches it was protecting.
paras.zh: 这把黄铜锁是安·弗朗西斯宝藏的一部分，以 1583 年在威尔士海岸的风暴中失事的英国商船命名。研究人员认为，这把锁曾经固定船上的一个箱子，后来与它所保护的财富分离。

paras.en: Some of the Ann Francis' cargo was recovered at the time of the wreck, while the rest was claimed by the sea. In recent decades, dredging and storms on Margam beach in South Wales have exposed some of the ship's lost treasure.
paras.zh: 安·弗朗西斯号的部分货物在失事时被打捞上岸，其余的则被大海认领。近几十年来，南威尔士马格姆海滩的疏浚和风暴暴露了船上丢失的一些宝藏。

paras.en: Between 1996 and 2017, metal detectorist Peter Hughes found the lock and much of the hoard, which included gold and silver coins. The lock was subsequently acquired by Amgueddfa Cymru — National Museum Wales, which worked with researchers at Cardiff University in Wales to decipher its combination.
paras.zh: 1996 年至 2017 年间，金属探测器彼得·休斯发现了这把锁和大部分宝藏，其中包括金币和银币。该锁随后被威尔士国家博物馆 Amgueddfa Cymru 收购，该博物馆与威尔士卡迪夫大学的研究人员合作破译了其密码。

paras.en: To study the lock's internal mechanisms, the team used micro-CT scans, which make thousands of X-rays that can then be configured into a 3D digital image. By matching internal notches to external letters in the digital 3D image, the researchers were able to decipher the correct four-letter code — "ANCE" — and open the lock.
paras.zh: 为了研究锁的内部机制，该团队使用微型 CT 扫描，产生数千张 X 射线，然后将其配置为 3D 数字图像。通过将内部凹口与数字 3D 图像中的外部字母进行匹配，研究人员能够破译正确的四字母代码“ANCE”并打开锁。

paras.en: "We normally use this technology to study bones and other biological structures, so investigating a 400-year-old padlock was certainly a first for us," David Williams, a research associate at the Musculoskeletal Biomechanics Research Facility at Cardiff University, said in a statement. "It's not every day you get to solve a 400-year-old mystery!"
paras.zh: 卡迪夫大学肌肉骨骼生物力学研究机构的研究员戴维·威廉姆斯 (David Williams) 在一份声明中表示：“我们通常使用这项技术来研究骨骼和其他生物结构，因此研究一把 400 年历史的挂锁对我们来说无疑是第一次。” “你不是每天都能解开 400 年前的谜团！”

paras.en: The Ann Francis was owned by Francis Shaxton, a merchant and notorious smuggler. Francis claimed the ship was sailing along the eastern English coast from King’s Lynn to Hartlepool, when it was actually traveling in the opposite direction, heading to Spain to deliver a cargo of wheat. Spain was dependent on grain shipments at the time and paid for such shipments in gold and silver from colonial conquests in Central and South America, according to Amgueddfa Cymru.
paras.zh: 安·弗朗西斯号的所有者是商人兼臭名昭著的走私犯弗朗西斯·沙克斯顿。弗朗西斯声称这艘船当时正沿着英国东海岸从金斯林航行到哈特尔普尔，但实际上它正朝相反的方向行驶，前往西班牙运送一批小麦。据Amgueddfa Cymru称，西班牙当时依赖谷物运输，并用中美洲和南美洲殖民征服中的黄金和白银支付这些运输费用。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: The ship was traveling back from Spain to England when, on the evening of Dec. 28, 1583, it was caught in a violent storm. After heading off course, the ship ended its journey in ruin off Margam beach.
paras.zh: 1583 年 12 月 28 日晚，这艘船正从西班牙返回英国，途中遭遇了一场猛烈的风暴。偏离航线后，这艘船在马格姆海滩附近的废墟中结束了旅程。

paras.en: A parish register noted the loss of 14 sailors during the same month as the wreckage, which could have been The Ann Francis's crew, according to Amgueddfa Cymru. The deaths were blamed on the nefarious work of a supposed witch.
paras.zh: 据 Amgueddfa Cymru 称，教区登记册显示，在飞机残骸发生的同一个月，有 14 名水手丧生，他们可能是“安·弗朗西斯”号的船员。这些死亡被归咎于一名所谓女巫的邪恶行为。

paras.en: Locals were quick to loot the Ann Francis wreck before a legal dispute ensued over who had the right to its goods. One Welsh lord claiming the wreck made an inventory list of items he impounded, which included cannons, guns, a piece of mast, Spanish silver and three chests with their locks broken. The newly cracked lock could have originally secured one of these chests, according to Amgueddfa Cymru.
paras.zh: 当地人很快就抢劫了安·弗朗西斯号沉船，随后就谁拥有其货物的权利引发了法律纠纷。一位声称失事的威尔士领主列出了他扣押的物品清单，其中包括大炮、枪支、一根桅杆、西班牙银器和三个锁坏了的箱子。据Amgueddfa Cymru 称，这把新破解的锁原本可以用来固定其中一个箱子。

paras.en: Centuries after the ship was wrecked, Hughes found the lock near a previously undiscovered stash of Spanish silver coins and coin weights while metal detecting on the beach.
paras.zh: 船失事几个世纪后，休斯在海滩上进行金属探测时，在之前未被发现的西班牙银币和硬币重量的藏匿处发现了这把锁。

paras.en: "When I found the lock I was immediately astonished by the incredible workmanship and its astonishing condition," Hughes said. "When I moved the ring dials of the combination they turned with ease after over 400 years beneath the sands and I was left in disbelief."
paras.zh: 休斯说：“当我发现这把锁时，我立即对它令人难​​以置信的做工及其令人惊讶的状况感到惊讶。” “当我移动该组合的环形表盘时，它们在沙子下 400 多年后轻松转动，我简直不敢相信。”

paras.en: - Wreck of World War II Japanese 'hellship' that sank with more than 1,000 Allied POWs on board discovered off the Philippines
paras.zh: - 菲律宾海域发现二战时期日本“地狱舰”残骸，船上载有 1,000 多名盟军战俘

paras.en: - First shipwrecks linked to real pirates of the Caribbean found in Bahamas

paras.zh: - 潜水员在爱琴海海底埃尔金勋爵失事的双桅船中发现了雅典卫城的大理石宝藏

paras.en: Hughes said he attempted to open the lock himself over many years but could never find the right combination. After Amgueddfa Cymru acquired the lock, staff were concerned that they could hear grit moving around inside the dials, and with more than 1,000 possible combinations, they didn't want to cause any damage.
paras.zh: 休斯说，多年来他一直试图自己打开锁，但始终找不到正确的密码。 Amgueddfa Cymru 获得这把锁后，工作人员担心他们会听到表盘内沙粒移动的声音，而且由于有超过 1,000 种可能的组合，他们不想造成任何损坏。

paras.en: The micro-CT scans offered a nondestructive view inside the lock, and an opportunity to finally identify the correct four-letter combination.
paras.zh: 微型 CT 扫描提供了锁内部的无损视图，并有机会最终识别正确的四字母组合。

paras.en: "Elizabethan combination locks are known in Britain, but this one is in exceptionally good condition and is associated with a dated wreck, making it a unique find and the code a tantalising mystery to solve," Alastair Willis, the senior curator for numismatics and the Welsh economy at Amgueddfa Cymru, said in the statement. "Of course, now we've solved it, we are left wondering if the code meant something to its owner."
paras.zh: Amgueddfa Cymru 钱币学和威尔士经济高级馆长阿拉斯泰尔·威利斯 (Alastair Willis) 在声明中表示：“伊丽莎白密码锁在英国广为人知，但这把锁的状况非常好，而且与一艘年代久远的沉船有关，这使其成为一次独特的发现，而其密码也是一个令人着迷的谜团。” “当然，现在我们已经解决了这个问题，但我们想知道代码对其所有者是否意味着什么。”

paras.en: Patrick Pester is the trending news writer at Live Science. His work has appeared on other science websites, such as BBC Science Focus and Scientific American. Patrick retrained as a journalist after spending his early career working in zoos and wildlife conservation. He was awarded the Master's Excellence Scholarship to study at Cardiff University where he completed a master's degree in international journalism. He also has a second master's degree in biodiversity, evolution and conservation in action from Middlesex University London. When he isn't writing news, Patrick investigates the sale of human remains.
paras.zh: 帕特里克·佩斯特 (Patrick Pester) 是《Live Science》的热门新闻撰稿人。他的作品曾出现在其他科学网站上，例如 BBC Science Focus 和 Scientific American。帕特里克在其早期职业生涯从事动物园和野生动物保护工作后，接受了记者再培训。他获得了硕士卓越奖学金，前往卡迪夫大学学习，并在那里完成了国际新闻学硕士学位。他还拥有伦敦密德萨斯大学生物多样性、进化和保护实践的第二个硕士学位。当帕特里克不写新闻时，他会调查人类遗骸的买卖。

articles.title: 2,800-year-old tomb in Siberia has evidence of the earliest use of cannabis — possibly as a way to calm human sacrifice victims
articles.author: Kristina Killgrove

paras.en: Archaeologists have unearthed the oldest evidence of cannabis use from a 2,800-year-old monumental tomb in Siberia. The presence of plant seeds in the grave and chemical traces of the drug in mummy hair suggest people practiced a funeral ritual that may have involved a grim practice: calming human sacrifice victims with cannabis.
paras.zh: 考古学家在西伯利亚一座拥有 2800 年历史的古墓中发现了最古老的大麻使用证据。坟墓中植物种子的存在以及木乃伊头发中药物的化学痕迹表明，人们进行了一种葬礼仪式，其中可能涉及一种残酷的做法：用大麻安抚活人祭祀受害者。

paras.en: In a study published Thursday (Nov. 5) in the journal Science, researchers investigated the contents of a "royal mound" burial at the Tunnug archaeological site in the Uyuk valley of southern Siberia. Archaeologists discovered four wooden structures containing several log coffins in the middle of the mound. On top of the wooden burial structures were the skeletons of horses that once formed a "spectral cavalcade," a Scythian funeral tradition that involved sacrificing horses and humans. And inside the burial structures, the archaeologists discovered piles of tiny seeds from the plant Cannabis ruderalis, a wild type of cannabis or marijuana.
paras.zh: 在《科学》杂志周四（11 月 5 日）发表的一项研究中，研究人员调查了西伯利亚南部乌尤克山谷图努格考古遗址的“皇家土墩”墓葬的内容。考古学家在土丘中央发现了四座木结构建筑，里面装有几口木棺。木制墓葬结构的顶部是马的骨架，它们曾经组成“幽灵队列”，这是一种斯基泰人的葬礼传统，涉及牺牲马和人。在墓葬结构内，考古学家发现了成堆的来自大麻植物大麻（Cannabis ruderalis）（一种野生大麻或大麻）的微小种子。

paras.en: Cannabis likely originated in Asia and was cultivated thousands of years ago for various purposes, including for ropes and textiles, and 6,000 years ago as an oilseed crop, according to the study. But it's unclear when people learned about the psychoactive properties of the plant. In the fifth century B.C., the ancient Greek historian Herodotus wrote that the Scythian nomads inhaled the fumes from burning hemp seeds. And evidence of cannabis use was previously discovered in a cemetery in China dated to about 500 B.C. The new study, however, pushes back this date by three centuries.
paras.zh: 研究表明，大麻很可能起源于亚洲，数千年前就被种植用于各种用途，包括用于绳索和纺织品，并且在 6000 年前作为油籽作物种植。但尚不清楚人们何时了解这种植物的精神活性特性。公元前五世纪，古希腊历史学家希罗多德写道，斯基泰游牧民族吸入了燃烧大麻籽所产生的烟雾。此前在中国的一个墓地中发现了使用大麻的证据，其历史可追溯至公元前 500 年左右。然而，这项新研究将这一日期推迟了三个世纪。

paras.en: Researchers discovered more than 1,000 whole cannabis seeds and around 500 partial seeds in the Tunnug burial mound, and they carbon-dated them to between 800 and 760 B.C. They also recovered several human hair samples from the grave. An analysis of the hair revealed signals matching cannabinol and THC (tetrahydrocannabinol), psychoactive chemical compounds found in cannabis. The tests could not determine how much of the drug people consumed, however.
paras.zh: 研究人员在 Tunnug 墓葬中发现了 1,000 多颗完整的大麻种子和大约 500 颗部分种子，并通过碳测年将它们确定为公元前 800 年至 760 年之间。他们还从坟墓中发现了一些人类头发样本。对头发的分析显示，信号与大麻酚和 THC（四氢大麻酚）（大麻中发现的精神活性化合物）相匹配。然而，测试无法确定人们消耗了多少药物。

paras.en: "The molecular traces in the hair and the cannabis seeds come from the same grave and suggest that cannabis was used for its intoxicating properties," study first author Gino Caspari, an archaeologist at the Max Planck Institute of Geoanthropology in Jena, Germany, said in a statement.
paras.zh: 研究第一作者、德国耶拿马克斯·普朗克地球人类学研究所的考古学家吉诺·卡斯帕里在一份声明中说：“头发和大麻种子中的分子痕迹来自同一个坟墓，这表明大麻因其令人陶醉的特性而被使用。”

paras.en: But given the burial context of the discovery, the use of cannabis may have had a darker purpose.
paras.zh: 但考虑到这一发现的埋葬背景，大麻的使用可能有更黑暗的目的。

paras.en: "In this princely tomb, the burials were accompanied by extensive horse sacrifices and, most likely, human sacrifices as well," Caspari said. The tradition of human sacrifice, in particular, "would have potentially made the plant a useful agent to calm individuals who were to be included in the rituals," the researchers wrote in the study.
paras.zh: 卡斯帕里说：“在这座王陵中，埋葬时伴随着大量的马祭品，很可能还有活人祭品。”研究人员在研究中写道，特别是活人祭祀的传统“可能使这种植物成为一种有用的媒介，让参加仪式的人平静下来”。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: The new study confirms the ancient use of cannabis in funerals in Central Asia and extends the date back to 2,800 years ago, the researchers noted. Future work is planned but will focus on other aspects of ancient cannabis.
paras.zh: 研究人员指出，这项新研究证实了中亚古代在葬礼上使用大麻的情况，并将其追溯到 2800 年前。未来的工作已计划，但将重点关注古代大麻的其他方面。

paras.en: "We have already begun sequencing some of the plant samples," Caspari said. "This will help us learn more about the history of the domestication and spread of the crop soon."
paras.zh: “我们已经开始对一些植物样本进行测序，”卡斯帕里说。 “这将帮助我们尽快更多地了解该作物的驯化和传播历史。”

paras.en: Caspari, G., Sadykov, T., Formicheva, D., Blochin, J., Armbruster, D., Happel, O., Ryabogina, N., Boxleitner, K., Spengler, R. (2026). Direct evidence for psychoactive cannabis use 2800 years ago. Science. http://dx.doi.org/10.1126/science.aeg3800
paras.zh: Caspari, G.、Sadykov, T.、Formicheva, D.、Blochin, J.、Armbruster, D.、Happel, O.、Ryabogina, N.、Boxleitner, K.、Spengler, R. (2026)。 2800 年前使用精神活性大麻的直接证据。科学。 http://dx.doi.org/10.1126/science.aeg3800

paras.en: Kristina Killgrove is a staff writer at Live Science with a focus on archaeology and paleoanthropology news. Her articles have also appeared in venues such as Forbes, Smithsonian, and Mental Floss. Kristina holds a Ph.D. in biological anthropology and an M.A. in classical archaeology from the University of North Carolina, as well as a B.A. in Latin from the University of Virginia, and she was formerly a university professor and researcher. She has received awards from the Society for American Archaeology and the American Anthropological Association for her science writing.
paras.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·基尔格罗夫 (Kristina Killgrove) 是《Live Science》的特约撰稿人，专注于考古学和古人类学新闻。她的文章还发表在《福布斯》、《史密森尼》和《Mental Floss》等杂志上。克里斯蒂娜拥有博士学位。北卡罗来纳大学生物人类学学士学位和古典考古学硕士学位，以及北卡罗来纳大学古典考古学学士学位。她拥有弗吉尼亚大学拉丁语学位，曾任大学教授和研究员。她因其科学写作而获得美国考古学会和美国人类学协会颁发的奖项。

articles.title: This Ancient 'Hell Chicken' Might Be the First Known Fruit-Loving Dinosaur, Revealing a Whole New Cretaceous Lifestyle

paras.en: When it comes to the Late Cretaceous period’s main characters, people tend to think of the terrifying, carnivorous Tyrannosaurus rex or the huge, long-necked, herbivorous sauropods. But the menu some 66 million to 100 million years ago offered more than just meat and veggies, and researchers have finally discovered evidence of a species taking advantage of it.
paras.zh: 说到白垩纪晚期的主角，人们往往会想到可怕的肉食性霸王龙或巨大的长颈草食性蜥脚类恐龙。但大约 6600 万到 1 亿年前的菜单提供的不仅仅是肉类和蔬菜，研究人员终于发现了一个物种利用它的证据。

paras.en: In a study published October 10 in the journal Nature Communications, researchers describe what might be the first known dinosaur that ate mostly fruit. The newly described Infernogallus jamesi had a mouth and jaw adapted to chewing soft foods similar to today’s frugivorous parrots. The findings shed new light on Cretaceous ecology and suggest that dinosaurs were more diverse than previously thought.
paras.zh: 在 10 月 10 日发表在《自然通讯》杂志上的一项研究中，研究人员描述了可能是已知的第一种主要以水果为食的恐龙。新描述的 Infernogallus jamesi 的嘴和下巴适合咀嚼软食物，类似于今天的食果鹦鹉。这些发现为白垩纪生态学提供了新的线索，并表明恐龙比之前想象的更加多样化。

paras.en: “It has been proposed before that some groups of dinosaurs ate fruits, but there was never evidence to back it up,” study co-author Thomas Dudgeon, an evolutionary ecologist at the Royal Ontario Museum in Canada, tells Reuters’ Will Dunham.
paras.zh: 研究报告的合著者、加拿大皇家安大略博物馆的进化生态学家托马斯·杜金 (Thomas Dudgeon) 告诉路透社记者威尔·邓纳姆 (Will Dunham)：“之前有人提出，某些恐龙群体吃水果，但从未有证据支持这一说法。”

paras.en: The genus name Infernogallus means “hell chicken.” That’s because of the creature’s small size and because the fossils, including a nearly complete skull and partial skeleton, were found in the Hell Creek Formation, a famous boneyard that stretches across Montana, the Dakotas and Wyoming. The species name jamesi honors the grandfather of one of the co-authors, who sparked the scientist’s love for paleontology.
paras.zh: Infernogallus 属名的意思是“地狱鸡”。这是因为这种生物体型较小，而且这些化石（包括几乎完整的头骨和部分骨骼）是在地狱溪地层中发现的，这是一个横跨蒙大拿州、达科他州和怀俄明州的著名墓地。物种名称“jamesi”是为了纪念一位合著者的祖父，他激发了这位科学家对古生物学的热爱。

paras.en: I. jamesi weighed an estimated 25 pounds and was about the size of a turkey. It was one of the smallest caenagnathids—a group of beaked, two-legged, feathered dinosaurs—and lived in the same region and at the same time as the fearsome T. rex, around 67 million years ago. But the most notable aspect of the newly identified species was its chewing abilities.
paras.zh: I. jamesi 的体重估计为 25 磅，大小与火鸡相当。它是最小的蜥蜴类恐龙之一，是一群有喙、两足、有羽毛的恐龙，大约在 6700 万年前，与可怕的霸王龙生活在同一地区、同一时期。但新发现的物种最引人注目的方面是它的咀嚼能力。

paras.en: “It’s pretty rare for animals to become specialized for a diet of fruit, so when it happens, it comes with some remarkable adaptations,” Dudgeon says in a statement. “The anatomy of Infernogallus is bizarre among dinosaurs, and we quickly realized that we were dealing with something special.”
paras.zh: 杜金在一份声明中说：“动物专门以水果为食的情况非常罕见，因此当这种情况发生时，它会带来一些显着的适应。” “地狱鸡的解剖结构在恐龙中很奇怪，我们很快意识到我们正在处理一些特殊的东西。”

paras.en: Flowers are essential for pretty much all modern fruit-bearing plants. Their bright colors and scents serve as flashy billboards to attract pollinators. But before they evolved around 130 million years ago, plants used infrared heat to lure pollinating beetles, according to a study published in 2025.
paras.zh: 花朵对于几乎所有现代果树植物来说都是必不可少的。它们鲜艳的颜色和气味充当华丽的广告牌来吸引传粉者。但根据 2025 年发表的一项研究，在大约 1.3 亿年前进化之前，植物就利用红外线热量来引诱授粉甲虫。

paras.en: The team created a digital reconstruction of the skull by CT scanning the fossils. Three key features pointed to a fruit-based diet: mouth muscles that enabled back-and-forth chewing, a special joint that allowed the jaw to slide forward, and ridges and grooves inside the beak that could help process soft materials like fruits. Today, this muscle organization exists in mammals with complex chewing abilities, including humans, as well as some fruit-eating birds like the vulturine parrot.
paras.zh: 该团队通过 CT 扫描化石对头骨进行了数字重建。以水果为主的饮食具有三个关键特征：能够前后咀嚼的口腔肌肉、允许下巴向前滑动的特殊关节以及喙内的脊和凹槽可以帮助处理水果等软质材料。如今，这种肌肉组织存在于具有复杂咀嚼能力的哺乳动物中，包括人类，以及秃鹫鹦鹉等一些以水果为食的鸟类。

paras.en: “This is a fantastic new dinosaur discovery,” Steve Brusatte, a paleontologist at the University of Edinburgh in Scotland who did not participate in the study, tells Science’s Taylor Mitchell Brown. “This new species finally reveals the face of a dinosaur fruit eater,” he adds. “We can now be sure that at least some dinosaurs were enjoying Cretaceous fruit salads.”
paras.zh: “这是一项了不起的恐龙新发现，”苏格兰爱丁堡大学古生物学家史蒂夫·布鲁萨特（Steve Brusatte）告诉《科学》杂志的泰勒·米切尔·布朗，他没有参与这项研究。 “这个新物种最终揭示了食果恐龙的面孔，”他补充道。 “我们现在可以确定，至少有一些恐龙正在享用白垩纪的水果沙拉。”

paras.en: I. jamesi’s fruit salad probably included drupes, which had soft flesh around a hard seed or pit, similar to today’s cherries and peaches, Greg Funston, lead author of the study and a paleontologist at Stony Brook University, tells the outlet. In fact, when Funston and colleagues investigated the evolution of the hell chicken and drupes, they discovered that the dinosaur’s lineage started to adapt to its specialized diet right as these fruits became larger and more abundant. The finding represents a rare clear connection between dinosaur diversity and the evolution of flowering plants.
paras.zh: 该研究的主要作者、纽约州立大学石溪分校的古生物学家格雷格·芬斯顿 (Greg Funston) 告诉媒体，I. jamesi 的水果沙拉可能包括核果，核果坚硬的种子或果核周围有柔软的果肉，类似于今天的樱桃和桃子。事实上，当芬斯顿和同事研究地狱鸡和核果的进化时，他们发现，随着这些水果变得更大、更丰富，恐龙的谱系开始适应其特殊的饮食。这一发现代表了恐龙多样性与开花植物进化之间罕见的明确联系。

paras.en: Furthermore, fruit-eating dinosaurs may have helped these plants spread by dispersing their seeds through their feces. The fossil record shows that during the Cretaceous, flowering plants became the most prominent land-based vegetation.
paras.zh: 此外，食果恐龙可能通过粪便传播种子，从而帮助这些植物传播。化石记录显示，在白垩纪，开花植物成为最重要的陆地植被。

paras.en: “We know that these big-seeded fruits were proliferating and spreading, and it seems like caenagnathids could have fit this role—although we feel more evidence is needed before drawing that link confidently,” Funston tells Reuters.
paras.zh: “我们知道这些大种子的果实正在增殖和传播，而且看起来蜥蜴可能适合这个角色——尽管我们认为在自信地得出这种联系之前需要更多的证据，”芬斯顿告诉路透社。

articles.title: This Bull and Male Donkey Have a Surprisingly Sexual Relationship, Providing Insights Into Interspecies and Same-Sex Bonds

paras.en: Earlier this year, researchers were studying monkeys on an Ethiopian plateau when members of two other species caught their eye. They spotted something unexpected: a bull mounting a male donkey.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，研究人员在埃塞俄比亚高原上研究猴子时，另外两个物种的成员引起了他们的注意。他们发现了一些意想不到的东西：一头公牛骑着一头公驴。

paras.en: “We were not sure if we had actually seen it or if it was some type of mirage,” recalls André Beirão da Cruz, an ecologist at the University of Pisa in Italy and the NOVA University of Lisbon in Portugal, to Mary Randolph at Scientific American.
paras.zh: “我们不确定我们是否真的看到过它，或者它是否是某种海市蜃楼，”意大利比萨大学和葡萄牙里斯本新星大学的生态学家安德烈·贝朗·达克鲁斯向《科学美国人》的玛丽·伦道夫回忆道。

paras.en: It wasn’t. Over the course of several days, da Cruz and colleagues observed the two ungulates licking and rubbing each other and having sex despite the availability of members of their own species. Their findings, described in the journal Current Biology on November 2, suggest that scientists still have a lot to learn about social and sexual interactions between members of different species.
paras.zh: 事实并非如此。在几天的时间里，达克鲁兹和同事观察到这两只有蹄类动物互相舔舐、摩擦并发生性行为，尽管有同种成员。他们的研究结果发表在 11 月 2 日的《当代生物学》杂志上，表明科学家对于不同物种成员之间的社会和性互动仍有很多东西需要了解。

paras.en: “It is really, really unusual,” says study co-author Elisabetta Palagi, an ecologist at the University of Pisa, to Nicola Davis at the Guardian. “And it is the first time it is reported in literature.”
paras.zh: “这真的非常非常不寻常，”该研究的合著者、比萨大学的生态学家 Elisabetta Palagi 对《卫报》的 Nicola Davis 说道。 “这是第一次在文献中报道。”

paras.en: Achille and Patroclo, the bull and donkey’s respective nicknames, belong to different owners but spend time together on the pasture. So, the researchers observed the two animals on four days when they were together and four days when they were separated this past March.
paras.zh: 公牛和驴各自的昵称阿奇勒和帕特罗克洛属于不同的主人，但在牧场上度过了时光。因此，研究人员在今年三月观察了两只动物在一起的四天和分开的四天。

paras.en: Overall, the team recorded 51 mountings between Patroclo and Achille in that window, 34 of which involved penetration. The donkey often initiated interactions by presenting his hindquarters to the bull and nibbling him. They displayed affectionate behaviors before and after each rendezvous.
paras.zh: 总体而言，该团队在该窗口内记录了 Patroclo 和 Achille 之间的 51 次挂架，其中 34 次涉及穿透。驴经常通过将后腿展示给公牛并咬它来发起互动。每次约会前后，他们都会表现出深情的行为。

paras.en: The pair specifically picked each other for these intimate encounters. When another bull tried to approach Patroclo, the donkey displayed aggressive behaviors like chasing and biting. Achille, meanwhile, tried to mount another male donkey, but the animal showed avoidance and threatening behaviors, like flattened ears—something Patroclo never did to him.
paras.zh: 两人特意挑选了对方来进行这些亲密的接触。当另一头公牛试图接近帕特罗克洛时，驴子表现出了追逐和撕咬等攻击性行为。与此同时，阿奇勒试图骑上另一头公驴，但这只动物表现出回避和威胁行为，比如耳朵被压扁——而帕特罗克洛从未对他做过这种事。

paras.en: The two ungulates don’t seem to have chosen each other out of convenience or because they had no other options. Numerous male and female cattle and donkeys grazed alongside Achille and Patroclo, yet the duo continued to spend time together when the opportunity arose.
paras.zh: 这两只有蹄类动物似乎并不是出于方便或因为别无选择而选择了对方。许多雄性和雌性牛和驴与阿奇勒和帕特罗克洛一起吃草，但当机会出现时，两人继续在一起度过时光。

paras.en: “What really caught our attention was that these interactions were embedded in a very selective and consistent social relationship between the two individuals,” Palagi says in a statement.
paras.zh: 帕拉吉在一份声明中说：“真正引起我们注意的是，这些互动植根于两个人之间非常有选择性和一致的社会关系中。”

paras.en: The bond between the two animals—which the researchers discovered was common knowledge among local herders—raises further questions. While same-sex sexual behaviors are widespread in animals, they usually involve members of the same species, like penguins and bonobos. In nonhuman primates, research suggests these behaviors might reinforce social bonds and help the animals live longer. However, it’s unclear why the male ungulates of different species would pick their trysts.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，这两种动物之间的联系是当地牧民的共识，这引发了进一步的问题。虽然同性性行为在动物中很普遍，但它们通常涉及同一物种的成员，例如企鹅和倭黑猩猩。在非人类灵长类动物中，研究表明这些行为可能会加强社会联系并帮助动物活得更久。然而，目前尚不清楚为什么不同物种的雄性有蹄类动物会选择幽会。

paras.en: “Achille and Patroclo cannot tell us why they choose one another. This short study can’t tell us what evolutionary purpose, if any, their relationship serves,” writes Jo Setchell, a biological anthropologist at Durham University in England who wasn’t involved in the study, for the Conversation. “But it does remind us that animal behavior can be more diverse than our theories suggest.”
paras.zh: “阿基尔和帕特罗克洛无法告诉我们为什么他们选择彼此。这项简短的研究无法告诉我们他们的关系有什么进化目的（如果有的话），”英国达勒姆大学的生物人类学家乔·塞切尔（Jo Setchell）在《对话》中写道，他没有参与这项研究。 “但它确实提醒我们，动物的行为可能比我们的理论所暗示的更加多样化。”

paras.en: Vincent Savolainen, an ecologist at Imperial College London who wasn’t involved in the work, tells Scientific American that Achille and Patroclo’s behavior could be influenced by their domestication, meaning wild animals might not exhibit the same social traits or patterns.
paras.zh: 伦敦帝国理工学院的生态学家文森特·萨沃莱宁（Vincent Savolainen）没有参与这项工作，他告诉《科学美国人》，阿奇勒和帕特罗克洛的行为可能会受到驯化的影响，这意味着野生动物可能不会表现出相同的社会特征或模式。

paras.en: “It’s important to publish and publicize this example just to show the diversity of what can happen, but it is obviously limited to two animals from two species that are domesticated,” Savolainen adds. “If we want to make massive steps in the field of behavior ecology, you would want to study a larger group of wild animals.”
paras.zh: “发布和宣传这个例子很重要，只是为了展示可能发生的事情的多样性，但它显然仅限于两个驯化物种的两种动物，”萨沃莱宁补充道。 “如果我们想在行为生态学领域取得重大进展，你就需要研究更多的野生动物。”

paras.en: Still, Josh Luke Davis, a science writer at the Natural History Museum in London and author of A Little Gay Natural History, cautions against “reading too much into the significance” of Achille and Patroclo’s relationship.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，伦敦自然历史博物馆的科普作家、《同性恋自然史》一书的作者乔什·卢克·戴维斯（Josh Luke Davis）警告说，不要“过度解读”阿基尔和帕特罗克洛关系的意义。

paras.en: Given that queer behaviors are common in the natural world and interspecies connections aren’t that unusual, it’s “probably not that surprising” that the two have overlapped, he tells the Guardian.
paras.zh: 他告诉《卫报》，考虑到酷儿行为在自然界中很常见，而且种间联系也并不罕见，因此两者重叠“可能并不令人惊讶”。

articles.title: China Announces a Plan to Put Astronauts on the Moon by 2030, Revealing Details of Four Upcoming Missions

paras.en: In the wake of a recent NASA update on the schedule of its upcoming Artemis 3 mission into Earth’s orbit, China has announced details about its own lunar program, shining a rare light on how the nation plans to land humans on the moon by 2030.
paras.zh: 在美国宇航局 (NASA) 最近更新即将执行的阿耳忒弥斯 3 号进入地球轨道的任务时间表后，中国宣布了有关其月球计划的详细信息，为中国计划如何在 2030 年将人类送上月球提供了罕见的线索。

paras.en: Wang Xiang, deputy chief designer of China’s manned space program and chief designer of the lunar exploration program, explained how the moon landing will be executed at the Seventh Manned Space Symposium in Beijing on Saturday, according to the state-run Chinese news agency Xinhua.
paras.zh: 据中国官方通讯社新华社报道，中国载人航天工程副总设计师兼探月工程总设计师王翔在周六于北京举行的第七届载人航天研讨会上解释了如何实施登月。

paras.en: The release of details comes within the context of what’s widely seen as a new space race, this time between China and the United States. NASA is currently targeting 2028 for its highly anticipated lunar return, but many external experts are dubious that the agency will be able to stick to its timeline, reports Kenneth Chang for the New York Times.
paras.zh: 细节的发布是在人们普遍认为的一场新的太空竞赛的背景下进行的，这次竞赛的对手是中国和美国。据《纽约时报》的 Kenneth Chang 报道，美国宇航局目前的目标是 2028 年进行备受期待的月球返回，但许多外部专家怀疑该机构是否能够坚持其时间表。

paras.en: China unveils detailed plan for manned moon landing China plans to land Chinese taikonauts on the Moon before 2030, with a crew of three, two of whom are expected to set foot on the lunar surface, according to information released at the 7th Human Space Symposium on Saturday. The mission will use a “two launches, one lunar landing” approach, involving two Long March-10 carrier rockets. Check the details. #ChinaSpaceMission #moon
paras.zh: 中国公布载人登月详细计划 根据周六第七届载人航天研讨会发布的信息，中国计划在 2030 年之前让中国航天员登陆月球，搭载 3 名宇航员，其中两人预计将踏上月球表面。此次任务将采用“两次发射、一次登月”的方式，涉及两枚长征十号运载火箭。检查详细信息。 #中国太空任务#moon

paras.en: — CGTN Frontline (@Frontlinestory) November 1, 2026
paras.zh: — CGTN 前线 (@Frontlinestory) 2026 年 11 月 1 日

paras.en: Wang said that China’s planned moon landing mission, slated for “before 2030,” will involve launching two separate Long March 10 rockets—one for a Mengzhou spacecraft, carrying a three-person crew, and the other for a Lanyue lunar lander. Once the two spacecraft reach the moon’s orbit, they will attach, or dock, and two of the Chinese astronauts, referred to as taikonauts, will move into the lander. The lander will then take them down to the surface of the moon.
paras.zh: 王说，中国计划在“2030年之前”实施的登月任务将涉及发射两枚独立的长征十号火箭——一枚用于运载三名宇航员的孟州飞船，另一枚用于兰月月球着陆器。一旦两艘航天器到达月球轨道，它们将附着或对接，两名中国宇航员（称为太古宇航员）将进入着陆器。然后着陆器将把他们带到月球表面。

paras.en: There, the astronauts will use a Tansuo lunar rover to drive around, collect samples and carry out experiments, according to China Daily’s Zhao Lei. The third taikonaut will wait for them in lunar orbit, providing support from the Mengzhou spacecraft.
paras.zh: 据《中国日报》记者赵雷报道，宇航员将在那里驾驶探索月球车绕行、采集样本并进行实验。第三名航天员将在月球轨道上等待他们，由孟洲飞船提供支持。

paras.en: “It is notable that we will deploy a lunar rover on our first crewed landing mission,” Wang tells China National Radio, as reported by China Daily. “This will substantially expand our capability to conduct a wide range of operations on the lunar surface and enhance operational flexibility.”
paras.zh: 据《中国日报》报道，王告诉中央人民广播电台：“值得注意的是，我们将在首次载人着陆任务中部署月球车。” “这将大大扩展我们在月球表面进行广泛行动的能力，并增强行动灵活性。”

paras.en: But before this complicated feat, the Chinese Lunar Exploration Program will test out its technological capabilities in uncrewed missions, Wang explains in a CCTV interview. “In an unmanned state, we will validate as many key technologies of the entire crewed process as possible, including launch, orbiting the moon, docking with the Mengzhou spacecraft, landing and staying on the lunar surface, taking off again and re-docking with the Mengzhou spacecraft,” he says, translated by the outlet. “This is to ensure that the crewed flight is safe and reliable.”
paras.zh: 但王在接受中央电视台采访时解释说，在这项复杂的壮举之前，中国探月计划将在无人任务中测试其技术能力。 “在无人状态下，我们将尽可能多地验证整个载人过程的关键技术，包括发射、绕月、与孟舟飞船对接、在月球表面着陆和停留、再次起飞以及与孟舟飞船重新对接，”他说。 “这是为了确保载人飞行安全可靠。”

paras.en: Did you know? China’s lunar sample return
paras.zh: 你可知道？中国月球样本返回

paras.en: While China has not landed humans on the moon, it has seen success with robotic moon missions in recent years: The Chang’e-5 spacecraft brought samples of lunar soil to Earth in 2020, and in 2024, Chang’e-6 retrieved the world’s first-ever samples from the lunar far side.
paras.zh: 虽然中国尚未将人类送上月球，但近年来在机器人探月任务方面取得了成功：嫦娥五号航天器于 2020 年将月球土壤样本带到了地球，嫦娥六号于 2024 年从月球背面取回了世界上第一个样本。

paras.en: China is working toward three uncrewed test missions before its crewed lunar landing, reports Arstechnica’s Eric Berger, citing presentation slides posted on social media. The first, expected early next year, is slated to launch the Mengzhou spacecraft into low-Earth orbit on a Long March 10A rocket. That will be followed by a lunar mission in 2028 involving the larger Long March 10 rocket and the uncrewed Lanyue lunar lander, which will land on and depart from the moon’s surface.
paras.zh: Arstechnica 的埃里克·伯杰 (Eric Berger) 援引社交媒体上发布的演示幻灯片报道称，中国正在努力在载人登月之前进行三项无人驾驶测试任务。第一个预计于明年初发射，计划利用长征十号甲运载火箭将孟州飞船送入近地轨道。随后，2028 年将执行一次探月任务，其中包括更大的长征十号火箭和无人载人的揽月月球着陆器，该着陆器将在月球表面着陆和离开。

paras.en: But the 2028 mission won’t be touch-and-go. Scientists back in China will use the opportunity to collect lunar data on features such as surface temperature and lunar dust conditions, according to CCTV. They’ve also opened a call for scientific experiments from other researchers to be included in the mission.
paras.zh: 但 2028 年的任务不会是一蹴而就的。据中央电视台报道，中国科学家将利用这个机会收集月球表面温度和月球尘埃状况等特征的数据。他们还呼吁其他研究人员进行科学实验，将其纳入此次任务中。

paras.en: “Because it is an unmanned mission, we will have some surplus resources, and we must make full use of them. Through a selection process, we will choose scientific experiment projects that are meaningful and necessary to be conducted on the moon,” explains Wang, as reported by Bastille Post Global. “It is like giving them a ‘free ride’ to the moon to conduct corresponding scientific experiments or technical explorations, achieving the goal of benefiting multiple parties with a single flight.”
paras.zh: 据《巴士底邮报》报道，王解释说：“因为这是一项无人任务，我们会有一些剩余资源，我们必须充分利用它们。通过筛选过程，我们将选择在月球上进行有意义且必要的科学实验项目。” “这就像让他们‘搭便车’到月球去进行相应的科学实验或技术探索，达到一次飞行多方受益的目的。”

paras.en: Then, 2029 will see another test mission in which two Long March 10 rockets will separately launch the Mengzhou spacecraft and the Lanyue lunar lander to the moon, where they will meet in lunar orbit. The long-awaited crewed lunar landing mission is expected to follow.
paras.zh: 2029年，两枚长征十号运载火箭将分别发射孟舟飞船和揽月着陆器飞向月球，并在月球轨道上相遇。期待已久的载人登月任务预计将随之而来。

paras.en: Both China and the U.S. hope to soon establish lunar bases near the moon’s south pole, which is thought to host valuable resources, including water ice. Last year, G. Scott Hubbard, a former director of NASA’s Ames Research Center, told the Los Angeles Times’ Michael Wilner that beating China to the moon would be “a stretch” for NASA.
paras.zh: 中国和美国都希望很快在月球南极附近建立月球基地，那里被认为蕴藏着包括水冰在内的宝贵资源。去年，美国宇航局艾姆斯研究中心前主任斯科特·哈伯德 (G. Scott Hubbard) 告诉《洛杉矶时报》的迈克尔·维尔纳 (Michael Wilner)，对美国宇航局来说，击败中国登上月球将是“一个延伸”。

paras.en: “It’ll take an intense effort by the best engineers and appropriate funding,” he added. But “it’s not inconceivable.”
paras.zh: “这需要最优秀的工程师的大力努力和适当的资金，”他补充道。但“这并非不可想象”。

articles.title: Reddit Founder Says Building Social Media Apps Is ‘Not Cool Anymore’
articles.author: Isabella Ward

paras.en: Alexis Ohanian wants to figure out the future of user-generated content. According to the Reddit cofounder, building social media apps is “not cool anymore” and so much of the internet has been compromised.
paras.zh: Alexis Ohanian 希望弄清楚用户生成内容的未来。这位 Reddit 联合创始人表示，构建社交媒体应用程序“不再酷了”，而且互联网的大部分内容都已受到损害。

paras.en: “I'm expecting some better version of the group chat to be that new version of UGC,” Ohanian told WIRED senior correspondent Lauren Goode at the inaugural WIRED World Fair.
paras.zh: “我期待新版 UGC 能成为更好的群聊版本，”Ohanian 在首届 WIRED 世界博览会上告诉 WIRED 高级记者 Lauren Goode。

paras.en: Ohanian has a complicated relationship with the internet. He resigned from Reddit in 2020, following the killing of George Floyd, to make room for a Black board member and to pressure the company to reform its content moderation policies. The social site had been notorious for hosting violent and harmful rhetoric. Ohanian reflects on recently learning someone with a Reddit tattoo—once a sign of the site’s success to Ohanian—had since covered it up: “I don’t blame him.”
paras.zh: 奥哈尼安与互联网有着复杂的关系。乔治·弗洛伊德被杀后，他于 2020 年从 Reddit 辞职，为一名黑人董事会成员腾出空间，并向该公司施压，要求其改革内容审核政策。该社交网站因发布暴力和有害言论而臭名昭著。奥哈尼安最近得知有人在 Reddit 上有纹身（这对奥哈尼安来说曾经是该网站成功的标志），但后来却将其掩盖起来，他对此进行了反思：“我不怪他。”

paras.en: He now runs venture capital firm Seven Seven Six, which has over $1.3 billion in assets under management. He focuses on sports, where he finds real-life communities “in the age of AI slop” and a “manipulated” internet.
paras.zh: 他现在经营着风险投资公司七七六，该公司管理的资产超过 13 亿美元。他专注于体育运动，在那里他发现了“人工智能时代”和“被操纵”的互联网的现实生活社区。

paras.en: Ohanian is a proponent of the “Dead Internet Theory”—the idea that a lot of online activity and content is being generated by bots. Large language models have turbocharged this, with AI agents outrunning human users. “The internet that I grew up on … that was really built for humans first; user interfaces and experiences are going to go away,” said Ohanian, “because more of the internet is going to get created for these agents to use, [rather] than for people.”
paras.zh: 奥哈尼安是“死亡互联网理论”的支持者，该理论认为许多在线活动和内容都是由机器人生成的。大型语言模型加速了这一过程，人工智能代理超越了人类用户。奥哈尼安说：“我成长的互联网……实际上首先是为人类而构建的；用户界面和体验将会消失，因为更多的互联网将被创建供这些代理使用，而不是供人类使用。”

paras.en: In some ways, the advance in generative AI has been lucrative for sites like Reddit, which has licensed its vast archive of human conversations to companies including Google and OpenAI to train AI models. “Platforms like ours became very, very valuable to LLMs,” Ohanian said.
paras.zh: 在某些方面，生成式人工智能的进步对于 Reddit 等网站来说是有利可图的，Reddit 已将其庞大的人类对话档案授权给谷歌和 OpenAI 等公司来训练人工智能模型。 “像我们这样的平台对于法学硕士来说变得非常非常有价值，”奥哈尼安说。

paras.en: But the technology has also undermined the business. Reddit shares plunged 29 percent last week after the platform warned that Google’s AI-powered search was hurting referral traffic. Ohanian also worries the commercialisation of these conversations means they are full of “bullshit.” “The internet has gotten so manipulated because it is so incredibly valuable to do so,” he said.
paras.zh: 但这项技术也损害了业务。在该平台警告谷歌人工智能驱动的搜索正在损害推荐流量后，Reddit 股价上周暴跌 29%。奥哈尼安还担心这些对话的商业化意味着它们充满了“废话”。 “互联网被如此操纵，因为这样做非常有价值，”他说。

paras.en: Reddit recently said it would require users to sign in to fight third-party scraping and keep up user engagement. While Ohanian declined to say whether he agrees with the move, “there has to be provable humanity on the internet without being creepy.”
paras.zh: Reddit 最近表示，将要求用户登录以对抗第三方抓取并保持用户参与度。虽然奥哈尼安拒绝透露他是否同意此举，但“互联网上必须有可证明的人性，但又不令人毛骨悚然。”

paras.en: An early Anthropic investor, Ohanian is nonetheless optimistic about the potential benefits of AI. He is especially excited to see medical breakthroughs from the technology. “There is still a very real chance that this technology can cause a lot of harm for sure,” he said. “I think we have to be sober about how we're building and what we're doing, but I still can't help but see all of the things that can get so demonstrably better.”
paras.zh: 尽管如此，作为 Anthropic 的早期投资者，Ohanian 对人工智能的潜在好处仍然持乐观态度。他对这项技术在医学上的突破感到特别兴奋。 “这项技术确实很有可能造成很大的伤害，”他说。 “我认为我们必须对我们如何建设和我们正在做什么保持清醒，但我仍然情不自禁地看到所有事情都可以变得如此明显更好。”

articles.title: The Blue Tsunami Swept Doctors and Scientists Into Office
articles.author: Kate Knibbs

paras.en: What do Michigan senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed, South Carolina senator-elect Annie Andrews, Ohio governor-elect Amy Acton, and North Carolina representative-elect Jamie Ager have in common, beyond their victories in this week’s midterm elections?
paras.zh: 密歇根州当选参议员阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德、南卡罗来纳州当选参议员安妮·安德鲁斯、俄亥俄州当选州长艾米·阿克顿和北卡罗来纳州当选众议员杰米·阿格尔，除了在本周中期选举中取得胜利之外，还有什么共同点？

paras.en: Each is either a doctor or a scientist. And each had the backing of the political action committee 314 Action Fund, which focuses on electing pro-science voices to public office.
paras.zh: 每个人要么是医生，要么是科学家。他们都得到了政治行动委员会“314行动基金”的支持，该基金的重点是选举亲科学的声音担任公职。

paras.en: “We really benefit by having those data-driven, fact-based decisionmakers actually in a position at the governing table,” says Shaughnessy Naughton, a chemist and former congressional candidate who founded 314 Action after losing her race in 2016. This cycle, the PAC spent above $30 million donating to and supporting various campaigns, including fundraising for specific races. It raised $3.6 million for pediatrician Andrews in the fight over what had been Lindsay Graham’s Senate seat in South Carolina, for example, and another $3 million for physician Acton’s campaign in the hotly contested Ohio governor race, according to Naughton.
paras.zh: 化学家、前国会候选人肖内西·诺顿 (Shaughnessy Naughton) 在 2016 年竞选失败后创立了 314 Action，她表示：“让那些以数据为依据、基于事实的决策者真正坐在管理席上，我们确实受益匪浅。”在这一周期中，PAC 花费了超过 3000 万美元捐赠和支持各种活动，包括为特定种族筹款。例如，根据诺顿的说法，它为儿科医生安德鲁斯筹集了 360 万美元，用于争夺南卡罗来纳州林赛·格雷厄姆的参议员席位之争，并为医生阿克顿在竞争激烈的俄亥俄州州长竞选中的竞选活动筹集了 300 万美元。

paras.en: The organization’s success rate topped 80 percent this cycle for congressional candidates, with 14 of 17 of its candidates in the US House of Representatives winning their races and hundreds of successful down-ballot candidates. Nine of these races flipped seats from Republican to Democrat. Victorious congressional candidates who flipped their districts this year include an oncology nurse-practitioner, a mathematician, a microbiologist, a nuclear engineer, and an agricultural scientist. “It did turn out to be a health care election,” Naughton says.
paras.zh: 该组织本周期的国会候选人成功率高达 80%，美国众议院 17 名候选人中有 14 名获胜，还有数百名成功的下轮投票候选人。其中九场比赛将席位从共和党转变为民主党。今年翻转选区的获胜国会候选人包括一名肿瘤科执业护士、一名数学家、一名微生物学家、一名核工程师和一名农业科学家。 “这确实是一场医疗保健选举，”诺顿说。

paras.en: Richard Frank, the director of the Brookings Institute’s Center on Health Policy, notes that health care workers and scientists have always been part of the makeup of Congress, but not to this degree. “What is unusual,” he says, “is just how many came in one wave.” He sees the spike in this type of candidate as a direct result of the hostility toward medical and technical expertise from the Trump administration. “Science has been under attack,” Frank says. “It’s not surprising that scientists have recognized that, and some of them went out and ran for Congress.”
paras.zh: 布鲁金斯学会卫生政策中心主任理查德·弗兰克指出，卫生保健工作者和科学家一直是国会组成的一部分，但还没有达到这个程度。 “不同寻常的是，”他说，“只是一波就涌来了这么多人。”他认为此类候选人的激增是特朗普政府对医疗和技术专业知识的敌意的直接结果。 “科学一直受到攻击，”弗兰克说。 “科学家们认识到这一点，并且其中一些人出去竞选国会议员，这并不奇怪。”

paras.en: The rise of the science candidate has several causes, according to historian Kristoffer Shields, who runs Rutgers University’s Eagleton Institute of Politics. “Some of it certainly is a reaction to what's been happening at the federal level, the defunding of a lot of laboratories and scientific exploration,” he says. But he also sees this as a legacy of the pandemic, when many health care workers started thinking about how politics impacts public health.
paras.zh: 罗格斯大学伊格尔顿政治学院院长、历史学家克里斯托弗·希尔兹 (Kristoffer Shields) 表示，理科候选人的崛起有几个原因。 “其中一部分肯定是对联邦层面发生的事情的反应，即取消对许多实验室和科学探索的资助，”他说。但他也认为这是大流行的遗产，当时许多医护人员开始思考政治如何影响公共卫生。

paras.en: Earlier this year, El-Sayed emphasized to WIRED that his candidacy was focused on public health, noting that the cyclospora outbreak that sickened Americans over the summer likely stemmed from the Trump administration’s choices. “We DOGE’d our whole service that keeps the lettuce safe,” he said at the time, referencing the so-called Department of Government Efficiency directing mass layoffs at the Food and Drug Administration.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，埃尔-赛义德向《连线》杂志强调，他的竞选重点是公共卫生，并指出今年夏天导致美国人患病的环孢子虫疫情可能源于特朗普政府的选择。他当时说：“我们对保证生菜安全的整个服务进行了严格监管。”他指的是所谓的政府效率部，该部门正在指导美国食品和药物管理局的大规模裁员。

paras.en: In 2024, 314 Action’s past acceptance of funding from groups with ties to the pro-Israel lobbying group AIPAC came under scrutiny. The organization no longer accepts AIPAC funding and supported candidates like El-Sayed who were vocally critical of the Israeli government. Unlike some other political committees that aim to put doctors in office, like the American Medical Association’s PAC, 314 Action specifically focuses on electing Democratic health and science experts; it is forthright about its opposition to the Trump administration’s approach to public health.
paras.zh: 2024 年，314 Action 过去接受与亲以色列游说团体 AIPAC 有联系的团体提供的资金受到了密切关注。该组织不再接受 AIPAC 资助，并支持像 El-Sayed 这样公开批评以色列政府的候选人。与美国医学会的 PAC 等其他一些旨在让医生上台的政治委员会不同，314 行动特别注重选举民主党健康和科学专家；它直率地反对特朗普政府的公共卫生方针。

paras.en: That so many of these politicians are advocates for the importance of public health and scientific expertise suggests that the election was, in part, a rejection of current health secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.’s MAHA movement, which promotes medical misinformation, including anti-vaccine sentiment. Many of the winning candidates with scientific and technical backgrounds have explicitly discussed how their concerns about the state of health care policy drove them to enter the race. “I am appalled seeing infectious diseases spreading through our communities that we had once declared eradicated,” microbiologist Jasmine Clark, the incoming representative from Georgia, told The Guardian earlier this year.
paras.zh: 这些政客中的许多人都是公共卫生和科学专业知识重要性的倡导者，这表明这次选举在一定程度上是对现任卫生部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪的 MAHA 运动的拒绝，该运动宣扬医疗错误信息，包括反疫苗情绪。许多具有科学和技术背景的获胜候选人都明确讨论了他们对医疗保健政策状况的担忧如何促使他们参加竞选。今年早些时候，来自佐治亚州的新任代表、微生物学家贾斯敏·克拉克 (Jasmine Clark) 告诉《卫报》：“看到传染病在我们的社区蔓延，而我们曾经宣布消灭这些疾病，我感到震惊。”

paras.en: Clark was first supported by 314 Action when she ran for Georgia’s House of Representatives eight years ago. “She was in the first class of scientists that we helped elect in that 2018 cycle and now has made that move up to the federal level,” says Naughton.
paras.zh: 八年前，克拉克竞选佐治亚州众议院议员时，首次得到了“314行动”的支持。 “她是我们在 2018 年周期中帮助选出的第一批科学家之一，现在已经晋升到联邦一级，”诺顿说。

paras.en: Shields sees the straightforward communication style favored by doctors and scientists as another asset that has made them strong candidates. Some of this year’s winners are especially direct. In recent interviews, South Carolina’s Annie Andrews has referred to RFK Jr. as her “archnemesis” and promised to hold him accountable.
paras.zh: 希尔兹认为医生和科学家青睐的直接沟通方式是使他们成为强有力候选人的另一项资产。今年的一些获奖者尤其直接。在最近的采访中，南卡罗来纳州的安妮·安德鲁斯将小罗伯特·肯尼迪称为她的“宿敌”，并承诺追究他的责任。

paras.en: 314 Action has also been clear that rebuking RFK Jr.’s agenda is a core part of its goals. In 2025, it launched its Guardians of Public Health initiative to recruit health care experts to run for public office. “We thought it was important to speak directly to doctors and people in public health, like nurses, to say that we have this program and we need you to step up to run, because we have a madman running the Health and Human Services cabinet,” Naughton says.
paras.zh: 314 Action 也明确表示，斥责 RFK Jr. 的议程是其目标的核心部分。 2025年，它发起了“公共卫生卫士”倡议，招募医疗保健专家竞选公职。 “我们认为，直接与医生和公共卫生人员（例如护士）交谈非常重要，告诉他们我们有这个计划，我们需要你们站出来竞选，因为我们有一个疯子在管理卫生与公共服务内阁，”诺顿说。

paras.en: The push for pro-science public servants isn’t over; 314 Action is starting its next recruitment round later this month.
paras.zh: 对亲科学公务员的推动还没有结束； 314 Action 将于本月晚些时候开始下一轮招募。

articles.title: 13 Best Early Black Friday Deals at Best Buy on Hot Tech (2026)
articles.author: Kat Merck

paras.en: Even though Black Friday is still more than three weeks away, retailers are already rolling out holiday discounts, making this a good time to get a head start on your wish list before items sell out. This is especially useful if you (like me) have a pre-Thanksgiving birthday in your household, or just want to have something before the holiday, like headphones to tune out your family on the ride to relatives' house, or an espresso machine to impress your in-laws with a post-dinner cappuccino.
paras.zh: 尽管距离黑色星期五还有三周多的时间，但零售商已经推出了节日折扣，这使得这是在商品售完之前抢占您的愿望清单的好时机。如果您（像我一样）在家里过感恩节前的生日，或者只是想在节日前买点东西，比如在去亲戚家的路上用耳机来隔绝家人的声音，或者用浓缩咖啡机在餐后喝一杯卡布奇诺给姻亲留下深刻印象，那么这一点特别有用。

paras.en: Every deal below is on an item a WIRED reviewer has tested and can personally vouch for being worth your money. For more great discounts, check out our Best Early Black Friday Deals, as well as early discounts on smart bird feeders, mattresses, and espresso machines.
paras.zh: 以下每件商品均经过《连线》评论员测试，可亲自保证物有所值。如需更多折扣，请查看我们的黑色星期五最佳早期优惠，以及智能喂鸟器、床垫和浓缩咖啡机的早期折扣。

paras.en: Samsung's interesting, brand-new Galaxy Z Fold8 (8/10, WIRED Review) unfurls into a 7.6-inch display for wide-view typing and multitasking. WIRED reviewer Julian Chokkattu actually prefers this model to the pricier Fold8 Ultra ($2,032), praising its easier-to-open hinge and declaring it just nicer to use in every way.
paras.zh: 三星有趣的全新 Galaxy Z Fold8（8/10，《连线》评论）配备 7.6 英寸显示屏，可实现宽视角打字和多任务处理。 《连线》评论员 Julian Chokkattu 实际上更喜欢这款型号，而不是价格更高的 Fold8 Ultra（2,032 美元），称赞其更容易打开的铰链，并宣称它在各方面都更好用。

paras.en: Though the bass-forward Beats Studio Pro (7/10, WIRED Recommends) come in a range of fun colors, including navy, brown, and gray, the plain black ones are on sale for $109 off right now. They offer easy pairing with both Apple and Android devices, as well as head tracking for spatial audio.
paras.zh: 虽然低音前置 Beats Studio Pro（7/10，《连线》推荐）有一系列有趣的颜色，包括海军蓝、棕色和灰色，但纯黑色的现在售价 109 美元。它们可以轻松与 Apple 和 Android 设备配对，以及空间音频的头部跟踪。

paras.en: WIRED reviewer Luke Larsen likes this well-equipped laptop with its Qualcomm Snapdragon X Elite chip and generously sized, 120-Hz refresh rate display. The battery life is excellent, and while it's not quite as sharp as a Macbook, it's a great value and upgrade over similarly equipped Windows laptops.
paras.zh: 《连线》评论员 Luke Larsen 喜欢这款配备精良的笔记本电脑，它配备了高通 Snapdragon X Elite 芯片和大尺寸的 120 Hz 刷新率显示屏。电池续航时间非常长，虽然不如 Macbook 那么锋利，但与配备类似功能的 Windows 笔记本电脑相比，它具有很大的价值和升级。

paras.en: If you're looking for a TV under $1,000, the TCL QM6K QLED (8/10, WIRED Recommends) is your best bet, at a hefty $400 off. Former WIRED reviewer Ryan Waniata calls it “a versatile display that does just about everything well, from naturalistic colors to rich black levels and impressive clarity.” It's even got a 144-Hz refresh rate if you plan to use it for gaming.
paras.zh: 如果您正在寻找 1,000 美元以下的电视，TCL QM6K QLED（8/10，连线推荐）是您的最佳选择，可享受 400 美元的大幅折扣。前《连线》评论员 Ryan Waniata 称其为“一款多功能显示器，几乎所有功能都表现出色，从自然色彩到丰富的黑色层次和令人印象深刻的清晰度。”如果您打算用它来玩游戏，它甚至可以提供 144 Hz 刷新率。

paras.en: These are the best wireless headphones we've ever tested, featuring some of the best noise canceling you can buy paired with 30 hours of battery power. They're the latest in the lineup, with a new, smaller case and memory foam-augmented folding ear cups that make them easy to travel with.
paras.zh: 这些是我们测试过的最好的无线耳机，具有您可以购买的一些最好的降噪功能，并配有 30 小时的电池电量。它们是该系列中的最新产品，具有全新的、更小的外壳和记忆泡沫增强的折叠耳罩，方便携带。

paras.en: These earbuds weigh just 5.5 grams per bud—25 percent smaller and 20 percent lighter than the previous model. Our reviewer loved them for their detailed and balanced sound, though he did find the noise canceling and call quality to be underwhelming. If you prioritize musical detail over bass, however, this sale makes them an excellent option to grab for your holiday travels.
paras.zh: 这些耳塞每个耳机仅重 5.5 克，比之前的型号小 25%，轻 20%。我们的评论家喜欢它们细致而平衡的声音，尽管他确实发现降噪和通话质量令人印象深刻。然而，如果您优先考虑音乐细节而不是低音，那么这次促销使它们成为您假期旅行的绝佳选择。

paras.en: The best semiautomatic espresso machine for most people, according to our reviewer, this longtime WIRED favorite has been in use by reviewer Julian Chokkattu for seven years. We love its consistent pressure, steam wand, and built-in grinder, as well as the all-metal construction that's easy to clean. Buy it now and impress your in-laws at Thanksgiving with espresso martinis and latte art.
paras.zh: 根据我们的评论家的说法，这是对大多数人来说最好的半自动浓缩咖啡机，评论家朱利安·乔卡图 (Julian Chokkattu) 已经使用这款《连线》杂志长期喜爱的机器七年了。我们喜欢它稳定的压力、蒸汽棒和内置研磨机，以及易于清洁的全金属结构。立即购买，在感恩节用浓缩咖啡马提尼和拿铁艺术给您的姻亲留下深刻印象。

paras.en: The new Google Pixel 11 is only a minor upgrade over last year's Pixel 10, which is still a solid phone with its 5X telephoto lens, magnetic Qi2 wireless charging, and impressive seven years of software support from launch. Note that this early deal is on unlocked 128-GB models in Indigo (shown) and Frost.
paras.zh: 新款 Google Pixel 11 仅比去年的 Pixel 10 进行了小幅升级，后者仍然是一款坚固的手机，配备 5 倍长焦镜头、磁性 Qi2 无线充电以及自发布以来长达七年的软件支持。请注意，此早期优惠适用于 Indigo（如图所示）和 Frost 中未锁定的 128 GB 型号。

paras.en: Samsung makes some of the best gaming monitors, and this model is one of our top picks. Get all the gaming out of your system before the holidays on this 360-Hz refresh rate screen that displays deep blacks and rich, accurate colors. These qualities that also make this an excellent pick for graphic design and video editing. Its high price was one of our reviewer’s main complaints, so if you've been in the market, consider this your lucky day.
paras.zh: 三星制造了一些最好的游戏显示器，该型号是我们的首选之一。在这个可显示深黑色和丰富、准确色彩的 360 Hz 刷新率屏幕上，在假期前将所有游戏从系统中释放出来。这些品质也使其成为图形设计和视频编辑的绝佳选择。它的高价格是我们评论者的主要抱怨之一，所以如果您已经进入市场，请认为这是您的幸运日。

paras.en: Given the Oura Ring 5 release this year, it's no surprise that the previous Oura Ring 4 is seeing some deep holiday discounts. While our reviewer loves the 5's slimmer, more lightweight design, I actually prefer the chunky look of the 4, which I bought at Best Buy last year (for $100 more than this sale price) and can report is still going strong.
