articles.title: The most beautiful sections of China's Great Wall

paras.en: Editor’s Note: Monthly Ticket is a CNN Travel series that spotlights some of the most fascinating topics in the travel world. In September, we’re celebrating superlatives as we look at some of the world’s biggest, tallest and most expensive attractions and destinations.
paras.zh: 编者注：《月票》是 CNN 的旅游系列节目，重点关注旅游界一些最有趣的话题。九月，当我们参观世界上一些最大、最高和最昂贵的景点和目的地时，我们正在庆祝最高级。

paras.en: Having lived in Beijing for almost 12 years, I’ve had plenty of time to travel widely in China.
paras.zh: 在北京生活了近12年，我有足够的时间去中国各地旅行。

paras.en: I’ve visited more than 100 cities, not to mention countless towns and villages throughout the mainland’s 31 provinces.
paras.zh: 我去过100多个城市，更不用说遍布大陆31个省份的无数城镇和村庄。

paras.en: Looking back, I’ve come to realize it was my frequent visits to different parts of the Great Wall in Beijing that were a driving force behind my desire to explore the rest of the country and, along with it, the many sections of wall that lie outside the capital’s boundaries.
paras.zh: 回想起来，我逐渐意识到，正是我对北京长城不同部分的频繁访问，推动了我探索中国其他地区以及首都边界之外的许多长城的愿望。

paras.en: Work on the Great Wall began more than 2,500 years ago, its origins dating back to China’s Spring and Autumn Period of around 770 BCE to 476 BCE. Various sections were added in subsequent eras as competing dynasties and factions sought to exert their control.
paras.zh: 长城的修建始于 2500 多年前，其起源可以追溯到公元前 770 年至公元前 476 年左右的中国春秋时期。在随后的时代中，随着相互竞争的王朝和派别试图施加控制，各个部分被添加。

paras.en: Work eventually stopped in the 17th century.
paras.zh: 工程最终于 17 世纪停止。

paras.en: Though not a single, unbroken structure, the wall spans over 21,000 kilometers, winding through 15 provinces, 97 prefectures and 404 counties.
paras.zh: 长城虽然不是一个完整的结构，但全长超过 21,000 公里，蜿蜒穿过 15 个省、97 个地区和 404 个县。

paras.en: And while certain sections have been incredibly popular among tourists, many parts have slipped into obscurity, disrepair and sometimes oblivion.
paras.zh: 虽然某些部分非常受游客欢迎，但许多部分却变得默默无闻、年久失修，有时甚至被遗忘。

paras.en: Whether you’re planning to visit the Great Wall for the first time or the 50th, the following destinations are sure to make your trip to China even more worthwhile. (Check out the above video for dramatic aerial footage of some of these amazing sites.)
paras.zh: 无论您是第一次还是第 50 次游览长城，以下目的地一定会让您的中国之旅更加值得。 （查看上面的视频，了解其中一些令人惊叹的景点的戏剧性航拍镜头。）

paras.en: The Great Wall is not simply a brick and mortar bulwark; in certain places, towers on jagged mountain peaks, fortress towns or even wide rivers count as sections of “wall.”
paras.zh: 长城不仅仅是一座砖砌的堡垒，更是一座砖砌的堡垒。在某些地方，锯齿状山峰上的塔楼、要塞城镇甚至宽阔的河流都算作“墙”的一部分。

paras.en: The Turtle City, built in the Ming Dynasty (1368-1644) as part of the Great Wall’s “Yellow River Defense Line,” was completed in 1608 and was home to around 2,000 infantrymen and 500 cavalry units during peak use.
paras.zh: 龟城建于明朝（1368-1644 年），是长城“黄河防线”的一部分，于 1608 年竣工，在高峰期可容纳约 2,000 名步兵和 500 名骑兵。

paras.en: Today, this fortress city is located in the Sitan Township of Jingtai County in north central Gansu province.
paras.zh: 如今，这座要塞城市位于甘肃省中北部景泰县泗滩乡。

paras.en: While there aren’t many real turtles in the “Turtle City,” the garrison town got its nickname due to its unique shape.
paras.zh: 虽然“龟城”中真正的乌龟不多，但这座驻军小镇因其独特的造型而得名。

paras.en: The south gate acts as the head and the west and east gates as the flippers. The town’s oval wall is the body, while the north gate acts as its tail. As one of the most well-preserved and truly authentic walled cities left in China today, it’s definitely worth your time.
paras.zh: 南门为头，西门、东门为脚蹼。椭圆形城墙为城身，北门为城尾。作为当今中国保存最完好、最真实的城墙之一，这里绝对值得您花时间。

paras.en: Staying in the Jingtai County center is recommended. The ancient city is only a 30-minute cab ride from your lodgings, so you can visit whenever the light is best for photos.
paras.zh: 推荐住在景泰县城中心。从您的住处乘坐出租车仅需 30 分钟即可到达古城，因此您可以在光线最适合拍照的时候前往游览。

paras.en: When in Jingtai, try local specialties such as the five Buddha tofu and the Jingtai cold mixed noodles – both are spicy vegetarian dishes. A walk through the sprawling night market in Jingtai County People’s Square, which boasts more than 50 snack stalls, is also recommended for adventurous foodies.
paras.zh: 到了景泰，一定要尝尝当地的特色菜，比如五佛豆腐和景泰凉拌面，都是麻辣素菜。景泰县人民广场的夜市拥有 50 多个小吃摊位，值得喜欢冒险的美食家们前往逛一逛。

paras.en: Getting there: Lanzhou, the capital of Gansu province, has a major international airport and high-speed train connections from many cities in China. The drive to Yongtai Turtle City from downtown Lanzhou takes about 2.5 hours (195 kilometers). From Lanzhou Zhongchuan Airport, it’s only 1.5 hours (125 kilometers).
paras.zh: 交通：兰州是甘肃省的省会，拥有一个主要的国际机场和连接中国许多城市的高速列车。从兰州市区驾车至永泰龟城，车程约2.5小时（195公里）。距兰州中川机场仅1.5小时（125公里）。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are two parts of the same Stone Dragon – two contiguous sections of the Great Wall that together stretch for roughly 25 kilometers along Beijing’s mountaintops.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口是同一条石龙的两个部分——长城的两个连续部分，沿着北京的山顶绵延约 25 公里。

paras.en: Historical records show that millions of men spent centuries constructing the Great Wall. Stand atop the wall at either Mutianyu or Jiankou, and you’ll begin to comprehend the gravity of this statement.
paras.zh: 历史记录表明，数百万人花费了几个世纪的时间建造长城。站在慕田峪或剑口的城墙上，你就会开始理解这句话的严重性。

paras.en: These two sections are arguably the two most classic examples of Ming Dynasty Great Wall surviving today, and climbing either is guaranteed to be a life-changing experience.
paras.zh: 这两段可以说是现存明代长城中最经典的两个例子，攀登其中任何一段都将是一次改变人生的经历。

paras.en: Mutianyu is the best portion of the “tourist wall.” Restored in the 1980s, it’s very commercial but also superbly beautiful. Visitors not up for the hike can take a cable car to the top.
paras.zh: 慕田峪是“旅游墙”中最好的部分。它于 20 世纪 80 年代修复，非常商业化，但也非常美丽。不适合徒步的游客可以乘坐缆车到达山顶。

paras.en: To the west of Mutianyu, Jiankou is colloquially known as the “wild wall” – no ticket needed and not commercialized. That being said, as of 2020, hiking at Jiankou has become somewhat frowned upon by the local government because of safety concerns.
paras.zh: 慕田峪以西的剑口俗称“野墙”，不需门票，不商业化。尽管如此，从2020年开始，出于安全考虑，当地政府对剑口徒步有些不满。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are less than a 90-minute drive (without traffic) from downtown Beijing, yet it’s highly recommended to enjoy a night in the countryside if time allows.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口距离北京市中心不到 90 分钟车程（不堵车），但如果时间允许，强烈建议在乡村享受一晚。

paras.en: Jiankou can be accessed via Xizhazi village; if dates align, you might even be able to spend a few days with William Lindesay, world-renowned Great Wall historian, and his wonderful family at The Barracks, their wall-side courtyard home.
paras.zh: 经西栅子村可到达剑口；如果日期一致，您甚至可以与世界著名的长城历史学家威廉·林德赛 (William Lindesay) 和他的家人一起在军营 (The Barracks) 度过几天，这是他们位于墙边的庭院住宅。

paras.en: For lodgings around Mutianyu, The Brickyard is a superbly comfortable choice.
paras.zh: 对于慕田峪周边的住宿而言，瓦厂是一个非常舒适的选择。

paras.en: In fall and spring, shades of the wall’s gray brick contrast with nature’s vibrant colors. Peak autumn foliage and spring cherry blossoms provide stunning backdrops for photos.
paras.zh: 在秋季和春季，灰色砖墙的色调与大自然鲜艳的色彩形成鲜明对比。秋天的枫叶和春天的樱花为照片提供了令人惊叹的背景。

paras.en: For winter sports enthusiasts, there’s skiing and skating next to the Wall at locations not far from Mutianyu.
paras.zh: 对于冬季运动爱好者来说，距离慕田峪不远的长城旁有滑雪场和滑冰场。

paras.en: Getting to Mutianyu: Restrictions on applying for temporary driving licenses in China were relaxed in September 2019, so renting a car as a foreign tourist is entirely possible. (International driving licenses are not accepted in China.)
paras.zh: 前往慕田峪：2019年9月，中国放宽了申请临时驾驶执照的限制，因此外国游客完全可以租车。 （中国不接受国际驾照。）

paras.en: You can also hire a car with a driver for the day or take the Mutianyu Special Tourism Bus from the Dongzhimen Wai Bus Station.
paras.zh: 您也可以当天租一辆带司机的汽车，或者从东直门外汽车站乘坐慕田峪旅游专线巴士。

paras.en: Getting to Jiankou: Renting a car or booking private transport is recommended. As Xizhazi is a small village, buses are scarce so it can take up to five hours to get there by public transport, as opposed to 90 minutes by car.
paras.zh: 前往剑口：建议租车或预订私人交通工具。由于西栅子是一个小村庄，公交车很少，因此乘坐公共交通工具最多需要 5 个小时才能到达那里，而开车则需要 90 分钟。

paras.en: Bataizi village sits just inside the Motianling section of the Great Wall and is home to the ruins of a Gothic church built in 1876 under the direction of a German missionary.
paras.zh: 八台子村位于磨天岭长城内，是一座哥特式教堂的遗址，这座教堂建于 1876 年，由一位德国传教士主持建造。

paras.en: The church has been damaged and repaired numerous times in its nearly 150-year history; the bell tower is the only part still standing.
paras.zh: 这座教堂在近150年的历史中曾多次遭到损坏和修复。钟楼是唯一仍然矗立的部分。

paras.en: The juxtaposition of its ruins against the rammed-earth Great Wall makes Bataizi a unique place to spend a morning or afternoon.
paras.zh: 其遗址与夯土长城并列，使八台子成为度过早晨或下午的独特场所。

paras.en: After finishing your hike along the wall and visiting the church ruins, drop in to the village’s “new” church to say hello to Father Pan; if you speak Chinese, he can answer any questions about the village’s long connection with Catholicism.
paras.zh: 完成沿着城墙的徒步旅行并参观教堂遗址后，顺便去村里的“新”教堂向潘神父问好；如果你会说中文，他可以回答有关该村与天主教的悠久联系的任何问题。

paras.en: Besides Bataizi, Datong should also be on your tourist map; visiting the Yungang Grottoes (a UNESCO world heritage site) and the Hengshan Hanging Temple will make your trip even more memorable.
paras.zh: 除了八台子，大同也应该出现在你的旅游地图上；参观云冈石窟（联合国教科文组织世界遗产）和恒山悬空寺将使您的旅行更加难忘。

paras.en: Late summer is an ideal time to visit Bataizi, as you’ll see a wonderful contrast between the Great Wall and the lush green hills.
paras.zh: 夏末是游览八台子的理想时间，因为您会看到长城和郁郁葱葱的青山之间的奇妙对比。

paras.en: Getting there: Bataizi village is 80 kilometers west of Datong, one of Shanxi province’s largest and most famous cities. Zuoyun County is only 22 kilometers away from Bataizi – about a 35-minute drive.
paras.zh: 交通：八台子村位于山西省最大、最著名的城市之一大同以西 80 公里处。左云县距八台子仅22公里，车程约35分钟。

paras.en: Datong is easily accessible by plane or high-speed train from other cities in China; a taxi from downtown Datong to Bataizi should cost roughly 300 yuan (about $43).
paras.zh: 从中国其他城市乘坐飞机或高铁可轻松抵达大同；从大同市中心到八台子的出租车费用约为 300 元（约合 43 美元）。

paras.en: Alternatively, you can make your way to Zuoyun County by bus then hop in a taxi.
paras.zh: 或者，您也可以乘坐巴士前往左云县，然后乘坐出租车。

paras.en: In Datong, luxury seekers will want to head for the five-star Yunzhong Traditional Courtyard Hotel. Zuoyun County has one hotel that can accept foreigners: Zuoyun Jinshan International Hotel. Both can be found on popular hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: 在大同，追求奢华的游客将会前往五星级的云中传统四合院酒店。左云县有一家可以接待外国人的酒店：左云金山国际酒店。两者都可以在热门酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Laoniuwan (aka the Old Ox Bend Great Wall)
paras.zh: 老牛湾（又名老牛弯长城）

paras.en: As the locals say, Laoniuwan is where the Great Wall and the mighty Yellow River shake hands.
paras.zh: 当地人说，老牛湾是长城与浩瀚黄河握手的地方。

paras.en: The Laoniuwan Fortress was built in 1467, while the most famous tower of the Great Wall in this area, Wanghe Tower (literally meaning river-watching tower), was constructed in 1544.
paras.zh: 老牛湾城建于1467年，而该地区最著名的长城塔望河楼则建于1544年。

paras.en: Laoniuwan village is located in Pianguan County, part of Xinzhou city in Shanxi province, just across the river from Inner Mongolia.
paras.zh: 老牛湾村位于山西省忻州市偏关县，与内蒙古隔江相望。

paras.en: Late summer or early fall is a great time to visit, as you’ll avoid the potentially dangerous mountain roads during spring rainstorms, or being uncomfortably cold in a place without great infrastructure.
paras.zh: 夏末或初秋是游览的好时机，因为您可以避开春季暴雨期间潜在危险的山路，或者在没有良好基础设施的地方感到不舒服的寒冷。

paras.en: Along the Great Wall, there are only a few places where it meets bodies of water; of all those, this is the most stunning.
paras.zh: 长城沿线只有少数地方与水体交汇；其中，这是最令人惊叹的。

paras.en: A boat ride along the river is highly recommended. You’ll be able to soak in the natural beauty of the Yellow River Gorge while marveling at the steadfast resolve of these ancient architects.
paras.zh: 强烈推荐沿河乘船游览。您将能够沉浸在黄河峡谷的自然美景中，同时惊叹于这些古代建筑师的坚定决心。

paras.en: Getting there: Laoniuwan is difficult to get to by public transportation. The best option is to rent or book a car to take you from Datong to Laoniuwan via Bataizi – this way, you’ll be able to see two incredible locations along the Great Wall in one trip.
paras.zh: 交通：老牛湾乘坐公共交通不太方便。最好的选择是租赁或预订一辆车，从大同经八台子前往老牛湾——这样，您将能够在一次旅行中看到长城沿线的两个令人难以置信的景点。

paras.en: Pianguan is the nearest city, about one hour away. Pianguan does not have a train station or an airport. The only option is to arrive by bus. Shuozhou, 140 kilometers from Laoniuwan, has an airport opening later this year.
paras.zh: 偏关是最近的城市，大约一小时车程。偏关没有火车站和机场。唯一的选择是乘坐巴士到达。距离老牛湾 140 公里的朔州机场将于今年晚些时候开业。

paras.en: Construction on the Great Wall in Simatai began in 1373. It was expanded and reinforced periodically throughout the Ming Dynasty.
paras.zh: 司马台长城始建于 1373 年。明代期间不断扩建和加固。

paras.en: The Fairy Tower is one of the best-known towers of the wall at Simatai but also one of the least visited due to how difficult it is to access.
paras.zh: 仙塔是司马台最著名的城墙塔楼之一，但由于难以进入，也是参观人数最少的塔楼之一。

paras.en: Instead, aim to take in incredible views of the Fairy Tower from Wangjing Tower (just a few hundred meters away). It’s a journey that will satiate even the most adventurous hikers, yet can be done without any ropes, ladders or other essential safety gear.
paras.zh: 相反，您的目标是从望京塔（仅数百米外）欣赏仙女塔的壮丽景色。这是一次即使是最具冒险精神的徒步旅行者也能满足的旅程，而且无需任何绳索、梯子或其他必要的安全装备即可完成。

paras.en: As with a visit to Mutianyu/Jiankou, this section of wall is guaranteed to deliver stunning views any time of year. My only suggestion is to wait for a clear day (usually visibility is great the day after it rains or snows), as the view from Wangjing Tower is unobstructed in every direction.
paras.zh: 与游览慕田峪/剑口一样，这一段城墙保证在一年中的任何时候都能呈现出令人惊叹的景色。我唯一的建议是等待晴天（通常下雨或下雪后的第二天能见度很好），因为从望京塔的各个方向都一览无余。

paras.en: The hike to the Fairy Tower will leave you in awe of the Northern Barbarians’ supposed determination to reach the capital; the mountains are nearly impassable on foot, let alone by horse, with sheer cliff faces on either side.
paras.zh: 徒步前往仙塔，会让您对北蛮人到达首都的决心感到敬畏；这些山脉几乎无法步行通过，更不用说骑马了，两侧都是陡峭的悬崖。

paras.en: It makes for absolutely world-class hiking and an interesting history lesson.
paras.zh: 它绝对是世界一流的徒步旅行和有趣的历史课。

paras.en: Five-star lodgings are available at Hobo Farm; they also have an incredible restaurant that serves delicious Western and Chinese fare. For 4.5 star lodgings with a lower price tag, try Yatou’s Homestay. Both can be found on major hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: Hobo农场提供五星级住宿；他们还有一家令人难以置信的餐厅，供应美味的西餐和中餐。如果想要价格较低的 4.5 星级住宿，可以试试丫头民宿。两者都可以在主要的酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Getting there: Both the Fairy Tower and Wangjing Tower should be accessed via Tangjiazhai village, located in Beijing’s Miyun district.
paras.zh: 交通：仙女塔和望京塔均需经由位于北京密云区的唐家寨村到达。

paras.en: Tangjiazhai village is 140 kilometers from downtown Beijing, depending on your route. Booking a private car from the city is probably the most time-effective way to get there.
paras.zh: 唐家寨距离北京市中心 140 公里，具体取决于您的路线。从市区预订私家车可能是到达那里最省时的方式。

paras.en: You can also take a high-speed train from Beijing Station to Miyun district and switch to a bus or taxi from there.
paras.zh: 您也可以从北京站乘坐高铁到密云区，然后从那里换乘公交车或出租车。

paras.en: Constructed during the reign of Emperor Jiajing (1507-1567), this single-wall section stands seven meters tall in some spots – no small feat considering it was made by piling stones.
paras.zh: 这座单墙建筑建于嘉靖年间（1507-1567 年），有些地方高达 7 米，考虑到它是用石头堆砌而成，这可不是一件小事。

paras.en: It’s located just across the road from the town of Dushikou, in Chicheng in Hebei province.
paras.zh: 它位于河北省赤城独市口镇的马路对面。

paras.en: The piled-stone wall at Dushikou is unique, as many other sections of the Great Wall close to Beijing were constructed using kiln-fired bricks.
paras.zh: 独市口的石堆墙是独一无二的，因为许多靠近北京的长城都是用窑烧砖建造的。

paras.en: Dushikou is best visited in the summer, specifically July and August, when the rolling hills of the surrounding grasslands are peak green. Cool evenings make for perfect outdoor barbecue/bonfire weather.
paras.zh: 独石口的最佳旅游时间是夏季，特别是七月和八月，此时周围草原连绵起伏的山丘呈现出翠绿的景色。凉爽的夜晚是完美的户外烧烤/篝火天气。

paras.en: You’ll be able to find clean and comfortable farmhouse lodgings in Dushikou town; alternatively, Chicheng, 45 minutes away, has a range of hotels to choose from.
paras.zh: 在都市口镇你可以找到干净舒适的农家住宿；或者，距酒店 45 分钟路程的赤城也有多家酒店可供选择。

paras.en: Lamb skewers and roast leg of lamb are specialties in these parts, as this part of Hebei is very close to the border with Inner Mongolia. Noodle lovers should also try the local oat noodles, which are delicious.
paras.zh: 河北这一地区靠近内蒙古边境，羊肉串、烤羊腿是这些地区的特色菜。喜欢吃面食的人还应该尝尝当地的燕麦面，味道鲜美。

paras.en: Getting there: Thanks to all the infrastructure built for the 2022 Winter Olympics, the drive to Dushikou has been shortened by almost two hours. If you prefer not to drive, hop on a bus to Chicheng from the Liuliqiao Transport Hub in Beijing and take a 45-minute taxi ride to Dushikou.
paras.zh: 交通：得益于为 2022 年冬奥会建设的所有基础设施，前往都市口的车程缩短了近两个小时。如果您不想开车，可以从北京六里桥交通枢纽搭乘巴士前往赤城，然后乘坐出租车 45 分钟即可到达独市口。

paras.en: Note that public transportation will take one or two hours longer than private car.
paras.zh: 请注意，公共交通会比私家车多花一两个小时。

articles.title: DOJ launches criminal probe into Supreme Court leak that exposed ruling overturning Roe v Wade

paras.en: The leak that exposed the Supreme Court’s draft opinion overturning Roe v. Wade is under criminal investigation by the Department of Justice, years after the court’s own hunt for the culprit came up empty.
paras.zh: 最高法院推翻罗伊诉韦德案的意见草案的泄密事件正在接受司法部的刑事调查，而数年前，法院自己对罪魁祸首的追捕却一无所获。

paras.en: U.S. Attorney Jeanine Pirro’s Washington office is leading the probe, multiple sources briefed on the matter told Fox News.
paras.zh: 多位知情人士告诉福克斯新闻，美国检察官珍妮·皮罗 (Jeanine Pirro) 的华盛顿办公室正在领导这项调查。

paras.en: Politico published the draft before the 2022 ruling, prompting Chief Justice John Roberts to order an internal investigation that failed to identify the leaker.
paras.zh: Politico 在 2022 年裁决之前发布了该草案，促使首席大法官约翰·罗伯茨 (John Roberts) 下令进行内部调查，但未能查明泄密者的身份。

paras.en: The Justice Department declined to comment on the investigation.
paras.zh: 司法部拒绝对调查发表评论。

paras.en: This is a developing story, please check back for updates.
paras.zh: 这是一个正在发展的故事，请回来查看更新。

articles.title: Marine veteran working security hailed as hero after stopping active shooter at Florida Citibank campus

paras.en: A Florida Marine veteran was credited Thursday as a hero for fatally shooting a gunman who drove onto a Citibank Center campus and began hunting down workers in anger over a delinquent $2,500 credit card bill, officials said.
paras.zh: 官员称，周四，佛罗里达州一名海军陆战队退伍军人射杀了一名枪手，这名枪手开车进入花旗银行中心校园，并因拖欠 2,500 美元的信用卡账单而愤怒地开始追捕工人，因此被视为英雄。

paras.en: During a press briefing detailing the tragedy, Hillsborough County Sheriff Chad Chronister identified the security officer as John Fraley, who confronted 35-year-old Jacob Pearson inside the corporate setting just after he shot and killed a female Citibank employee.
paras.zh: 在详细介绍这场悲剧的新闻发布会上，希尔斯伯勒县警长查德·克罗尼斯特 (Chad Chronister) 确认这名安全官员是约翰·弗雷利 (John Fraley)，他在枪杀一名花旗银行女员工后不久，在公司环境中与 35 岁的雅各布·皮尔森 (Jacob Pearson) 发生冲突。

paras.en: "He is an individual that's afforded an opportunity to carry a firearm because the ones who were either previous law enforcement or military and have that training, Citibank empowers them to carry a handgun," Chronister said. "He didn't have to stop. He could have run and protected his own life, too. He took up a tactical position when he saw the suspect coming and made a decision."
paras.zh: 克罗尼斯特说：“他是一个有机会携带枪支的人，因为那些以前是执法人员或军人并接受过培训的人，花旗银行授权他们携带手枪。” “他不必停下来。他也可以逃跑并保护自己的生命。当他看到嫌疑人到来并做出决定时，他采取了战术立场。”

paras.en: "That decision put his own life at risk to stop that shooter from harming anyone else," he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“这个决定让他冒着生命危险，阻止枪手伤害其他人。”

paras.en: Pearson was married and had a 7-year-old child, the sheriff said.
paras.zh: 警长说，皮尔森已婚，并育有一个 7 岁的孩子。

paras.en: He became violent upon receiving a court summons regarding a $2,500 delinquent debt owed to Citibank, the sheriff said. Furious over the court notice, Pearson called an attorney's office contracted by the bank for collections around 9 a.m. Wednesday.
paras.zh: 治安官称，他在收到因拖欠花旗银行 2,500 美元债务的法庭传票后变得暴力。皮尔逊对法院通知感到愤怒，于周三上午 9 点左右致电与该银行签约的律师事务所进行催收。

paras.en: He allegedly made violent threats to the attorney's office over the phone before leaving his Orlando home.
paras.zh: 据称，他在离开奥兰多的家之前通过电话向律师办公室发出了暴力威胁。

paras.en: "Unless you want me to go over there with my AR-15, my bulletproof vest and my insanity, you m************ cancel this court case," he allegedly said, Fox 13 reported. "Do you understand me? They are only an hour and three minutes away, so the last thing you want to do is f*** with me."
paras.zh: 据福克斯 13 台报道，据称他说：“除非你想让我带着我的 AR-15、我的防弹背心和我的精神错乱去那里，否则你就取消这个法庭案件。” “你明白我的意思吗？距离只有一小时零三分钟，所以你最不想做的就是跟我操。”

paras.en: Citibank’s head of security, a retired Secret Service agent, recognized the severity of the threat, initiated proactive safety measures, and contacted both the Orlando Police Department for a welfare check and the Hillsborough County Sheriff's Office to request deputy presence on campus.
paras.zh: 花旗银行的安全主管是一名退休的特勤局特工，他认识到威胁的严重性，采取了积极主动的安全措施，并联系了奥兰多警察局进行福利检查，并联系了希尔斯伯勒县治安官办公室请求派警员到校园。

paras.en: Despite those steps, Pearson drove to the Brandon campus, crashing through a gate into the courtyard where employees were gathered.
paras.zh: 尽管采取了这些措施，皮尔逊还是开车前往布兰登校园，冲破大门，撞进了员工聚集的庭院。

paras.en: Once inside, he got out of his sedan with a rifle immediately shot 41-year-old learning advisor LeAnne Selmon three times before his weapon malfunctioned, according to Chronister.
paras.zh: 据 Chronister 报道，进入车内后，他从轿车中下来，立即用步枪向 41 岁的学习顾问 LeAnne Selmon 开了三枪，然后他的武器出现故障。

paras.en: "As he shoots her, his rifle begins to malfunction," he said. "This suspect goes back… returns back to his car, retrieves his handgun, walks back over to the victim who's trying to crawl away with her life and executes her."
paras.zh: “当他向她开枪时，他的步枪开始出现故障，”他说。 “这名嫌疑人回去了......回到他的车里，取回了他的手枪，走回试图爬行的受害者身边并处决了她。”

paras.en: "He was there intent on one purpose and that purpose was to hunt any human being he could find and kill," the sheriff said. "Because of the heroic actions of this Citibank security officer, vice president of operations, his reign of terror ended before it even began."
paras.zh: 警长说：“他在那里的目的只有一个，那就是追捕他能找到并杀死的任何人。” “由于这位花旗银行安全官员、运营副总裁的英勇行动，他的恐怖统治在开始之前就结束了。”

paras.en: Pearson then walked into a cafeteria intent on finding more victims before encountering Fraley, the sheriff said. Fraley, a Citibank security guard, vice president of operations, took a tactical position inside the men's restroom and opened fire, striking Pearson five times, according to the sheriff.
paras.zh: 警长说，皮尔逊随后走进一家自助餐厅，打算在遇到弗雷利之前寻找更多受害者。据治安官称，花旗银行保安兼运营副总裁弗雷利在男厕所内占据战术位置并向皮尔森开枪五次。

paras.en: Pearson was taken to Tampa General Hospital for medical care, where he died from his injuries.
paras.zh: 皮尔逊被送往坦帕综合医院接受治疗，但因伤重不治身亡。

articles.title: MATT CALKINS: Sophie Cunningham urges unity as Natasha Cloud taunts GOP after midterm losses

paras.en: One attempted to unify an increasingly divided country. Another seemed to give her opponents a firm slap in the face. Or, more specifically — a swat on the rear end.
paras.zh: 人们试图统一一个日益分裂的国家。另一位似乎狠狠地打了对手一记耳光。或者，更具体地说——拍打屁股。

paras.en: The first statement came from impending Fever free agent Sophie Cunningham. We know that the shooting guard isn't afraid to take a stance on a political issue, as she became a lightning rod over comments supporting the separation of biological males and females in sports and locker rooms last summer. But she isn't a formulaic partisan.
paras.zh: 第一份声明来自即将成为自由球员的索菲·坎宁安 (Sophie Cunningham)。我们知道，这位得分后卫并不害怕在政治问题上表明立场，去年夏天，她因支持在体育运动和更衣室中男女分开的言论而成为避雷针。但她并不是一个刻板的党派人士。

paras.en: Sophie has been adamant about being in the political "middle," saying she agrees with arguments from both sides of the aisle. And on Wednesday, one day after the Democratic-dominated midterm elections, she shared a post from entrepreneur Andy Frisella on her Instagram emphasizing personal growth over political identity.
paras.zh: 索菲一直坚持站在政治“中间派”，她说她同意两党的观点。周三，也就是民主党主导的中期选举后的一天，她在 Instagram 上分享了企业家安迪·弗里塞拉 (Andy Frisella) 的一篇帖子，强调个人成长高于政治身份。

paras.en: "One of the strangest things about our culture is how much faith we’ve placed in elections to change our lives and how little faith we’ve placed in our own ability to do the same. People will spend months arguing about who should lead the country while spending zero time considering how they could better lead themselves … and THAT is a much bigger problem than most people realize," Frisella’s post read.
paras.zh: “我们文化中最奇怪的事情之一是，我们对选举能够改变我们的生活抱有多大的信心，而我们对自己做同样的事情的能力却抱有多么小的信心。人们会花几个月的时间争论谁应该领导这个国家，而花零时间考虑如何更好地领导自己……这是一个比大多数人意识到的要大得多的问题，”弗里塞拉的帖子中写道。

paras.en: "Because the strength of a country is ultimately a reflection of the character, discipline and standards of the people who make it up. That’s you. Politics is downstream of culture. We can keep changing the people in charge, passing new laws and arguing over which party has the answers … but until we change the culture fostering, producing and tolerating the problems we have as a society, nothing fundamentally changes.
paras.zh: “因为一个国家的实力最终反映了组成这个国家的人民的品格、纪律和标准。那就是你。政治是文化的下游。我们可以不断更换负责人，通过新的法律，争论哪一方拥有答案……但是，除非我们改变助长、产生和容忍我们作为一个社会所存在问题的文化，否则什么都不会从根本上改变。

paras.en: "A population of weak, unhealthy, uninformed and dependent people is a hell of a lot easier to control than a population of strong, healthy, educated and self-reliant people. Your responsibility is to become the exact opposite of everything they want for you to the best of your abilities. Your REAL best. In my opinion that’s our obligation as Americans.
paras.zh: “一群弱小、不健康、无知和依赖他人的人比一群强大、健康、受过教育和自力更生的人更容易控制。你的责任是尽你所能，成为他们想要的一切的完全相反。你真正的最好。在我看来，这是我们作为美国人的义务。

paras.en: "A culture of personal excellence is the foundation of a great country. There is no election, politician, policy or law that can substitute for that … and the best thing about that is the same behaviors that make you a better American also make your own life better quickly. If we want a better America … It starts with better Americans. There is no other way. Personal excellence is the Ultimate Rebellion."
paras.zh: “个人卓越的文化是一个伟大国家的基础。没有任何选举、政治家、政策或法律可以替代它……而最好的事情是，让你成为更好的美国人的行为也能让你自己的生活迅速变得更好。如果我们想要一个更好的美国……就从更好的美国人开始。没有其他办法。个人卓越是最终的反叛。”

paras.en: This reminds me of the old Jordan Peterson axiom "clean your room." Before you can take on the world, make sure you can take care of yourself. It's not uncommon to see some of the most volatile, maladjusted people dedicating their lives to political causes in lieu of personal responsibility. That seems to be what Cunningham is warning against. Whether she would have reposted Frisella if the Republicans cleaned up in the midterms is unknown, but her premise holds up regardless. Constructive. Un-tribal.
paras.zh: 这让我想起了乔丹·彼得森的古老格言“清理你的房间”。在你能够应对世界之前，请确保你能照顾好自己。一些最不稳定、最不适应环境的人将自己的一生奉献给政治事业而不是个人责任，这种情况并不罕见。这似乎正是坎宁安所警告的。如果共和党在中期选举中获胜，她是否会转发弗里塞拉还不得而知，但她的前提无论如何都是成立的。有建设性。非部落的。

paras.en: Pretty much the opposite of Chicago Sky guard Natasha Cloud.
paras.zh: 与芝加哥天空队后卫娜塔莎·克劳德几乎相反。

paras.en: Cloud also took to social media after Tuesday's midterms, but not in an attempt to unify or inspire. The Chicago guard shared a Threads post from Rep. Robert Garcia reading "LAWYER UP!" and added her own three-letter commentary: "BTA!" — slang for "belt to ass." In short, Cloud was openly taunting Republicans over their midterm losses while celebrating the prospect of incoming Democratic oversight targeting President Trump.
paras.zh: 周二中期选举后，克劳德也开始使用社交媒体，但并不是为了团结或激励。这位芝加哥警卫分享了众议员罗伯特·加西亚的帖子，上面写着“律师起来！”并添加了她自己的三个字母的评论：“BTA！” — 俚语中的“腰带到屁股”。简而言之，克劳德公开嘲笑共和党中期选举的失利，同时庆祝民主党即将对特朗普总统进行监督的前景。

paras.en: This isn't the first time Cloud has used her platform to divide. In 2023, she tweeted, "Our country is trash" on the heels of SCOTUS ruling that the affirmative action policies universities had been employing were unconstitutional. She added that "we continue to oppress marginalized groups that we have targeted since the beginning of time," and that "I feel like I'm gonna see a civil war in my lifetime." She also gave the AP a quote saying "it's time to break down a system that has only been about white men."
paras.zh: 这并不是克劳德第一次利用她的平台进行分裂。 2023年，在最高法院裁定大学一直采用的平权行动政策违宪后，她在推特上写道：“我们的国家是垃圾”。她补充说，“我们继续压迫我们从一开始就瞄准的边缘化群体”，“我觉得我有生之年会看到一场内战。”她还向美联社引用了一句话：“是时候打破一个只与白人有关的制度了。”

paras.en: Sophie and Natasha. One sees the potential good in humanity and calls for individuals to rise above the political fray. The other seems to view half the country as irredeemable — and wants the world to know it. Remember, it was Cunningham who, despite her position on separating men and women in sports, emphasized that she had nothing but love for the trans community. And it was Cloud who walked toward and screamed at Enes Kanter Freedom for wearing a shirt defining what a woman is.
paras.zh: 苏菲和娜塔莎。人们看到了人性的潜在好处，并呼吁个人超越政治纷争。另一个人似乎认为半个国家是不可救药的——并希望全世界都知道这一点。请记住，尽管坎宁安在体育运动中主张男女分开，但她强调她对跨性别群体只有热爱。正是克劳德走向埃内斯·坎特·自由并对其尖叫，因为他穿着一件定义了女性的衬衫。

paras.en: Two players. One who's on a team that stands for the national anthem, the other on one that clears the court for it. One doing her part to bring people together in divisive times — another who's clearly relishing the division.
paras.zh: 两名球员。一个代表奏国歌，另一个则代表球场清场。一个人在分裂时期尽自己的一份力量将人们团结在一起，而另一个人显然很享受这种分裂。

articles.title: Herzog to meet Israeli election rivals as decision nears on path to power
articles.author: Jason Burke

paras.en: Israel’s president, Isaac Herzog, was due to meet Benjamin Netanyahu and his chief political rival, Gadi Eisenkot, on Thursday with less than a week left before he decides which of the two men should first try to form a government.
paras.zh: 以色列总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格定于周四会见本杰明·内塔尼亚胡和他的主要政治对手加迪·艾森科特，距离他决定这两个人中的哪一个应该首先尝试组建政府还有不到一周的时间。

paras.en: A bitterly contested election last month, seen by many observers as one of the most consequential for Israel in many decades, ended with neither Netanyahu nor Eisenkot, a former military general and chief of staff, securing a clear pathway to power.
paras.zh: 上个月举行的一场竞争激烈的选举被许多观察家视为几十年来对以色列影响最大的选举之一，但最终内塔尼亚胡和前军事将领兼参谋长艾森科特都没有找到一条明确的权力之路。

paras.en: Netanyahu’s coalition lost its majority, dropping from 68 to 53 seats in the 120-seat Knesset. The Change bloc of Zionist parties led by Eisenkot has 48 seats, leaving parties representing Israeli Palestinians as potential kingmakers with a record 19 seats. The Joint List has 11, while the more conservative, Islamist Ra’am has eight.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡的联盟失去了多数席位，在议会 120 个席位中从 68 个席位降至 53 个席位。艾森科特领导的犹太复国主义政党变革联盟拥有 48 个席位，这使得代表以色列巴勒斯坦人作为潜在国王拥护者的政党获得了创纪录的 19 个席位。联合名单中有 11 个，而更为保守的伊斯兰主义拉姆有 8 个。

paras.en: In Israel’s political system, the otherwise largely ceremonial president decides which candidate has the best initial chance of building a stable coalition to rule.
paras.zh: 在以色列的政治体系中，基本上是仪式性的总统决定哪位候选人最有可能建立稳定的执政联盟。

paras.en: Turnout among Arab Israelis – Palestinians with Israeli citizenship, who constitute 20% of the population – more than doubled to about 80%, transforming the political landscape. Palestinians in the occupied West Bank and Gaza had no vote.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯以色列人（拥有以色列公民身份的巴勒斯坦人，占人口的 20%）的投票率增加了一倍多，达到 80% 左右，改变了政治格局。被占领的约旦河西岸和加沙地带的巴勒斯坦人没有投票权。

paras.en: The leader of Israel’s main Palestinian coalition has admitted to “disagreements with Eisenkot on many issues” but said on Thursday that Palestinian voters wanted change after facing intensified racism, discrimination, crime and exclusion under the current coalition.
paras.zh: 以色列主要巴勒斯坦联盟领导人承认“在许多问题上与艾森科特存在分歧”，但周四表示，巴勒斯坦选民在当前联盟面临加剧的种族主义、歧视、犯罪和排斥后希望做出改变。

paras.en: “We are not choosing between good and better but between what we see as bad and even worse,” Yousef Jabareen said, according to Israeli media.
paras.zh: 据以色列媒体报道，优素福·贾巴林表示：“我们不是在好与更好之间做出选择，而是在我们认为的坏与更糟之间做出选择。”

paras.en: Last month, Jabareen told the Guardian that the first demand of Arab Israeli voters was to get rid of the Netanyahu government, and in particular its most extreme members, Itamar Ben-Gvir, the national security minister, and Bezalel Smotrich, the finance minister.
paras.zh: 上个月，贾巴林告诉《卫报》，阿拉伯以色列选民的首要要求是推翻内塔尼亚胡政府，特别是其最极端的成员，国家安全部长伊塔马尔·本-格维尔和财政部长贝扎莱·斯莫特里奇。

paras.en: Eisenkot has also put conditions on any potential coalition with Arab parties: they have to recognise that Israel is a Jewish state, accept compulsory national service – either civil or military – and denounce Hamas as a terrorist organisation.
paras.zh: 艾森科特还对任何与阿拉伯政党的潜在联盟提出了条件：他们必须承认以色列是一个犹太国家，接受义务兵役——无论是民事还是军事——并谴责哈马斯为恐怖组织。

paras.en: Jabareen and the Joint List have suggested they would support an opposition from the outside with tactical voting in the Knesset. Ra’am has said it would join a new government led by Eisenkot.
paras.zh: 贾巴林和联合名单表示，他们将通过在议会进行战术性投票来支持外部反对派。拉姆表示将加入艾森科特领导的新政府。

paras.en: Herzog, who met delegations from the Palestinian Israeli parties and other small parties, has called on all to help avert another round of elections.
paras.zh: 赫尔佐格会见了巴勒斯坦以色列政党和其他小党派的代表团，呼吁各方帮助避免另一轮选举。

paras.en: “Any reasonable person need only look at the security and diplomatic challenges before us, at the changing region around us, and remember the issues tearing us apart from within, to understand that an immense responsibility rests upon us,” Herzog said.
paras.zh: 赫尔佐格说：“任何有理智的人只需看看我们面前的安全和外交挑战，看看我们周围不断变化的地区，记住那些从内部分裂我们的问题，就能明白我们肩负着巨大的责任。”

paras.en: Netanyahu remains prime minister in a caretaker government until a new coalition is formed or there is another election, which must be held if no candidate succeeds.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在看守政府中仍担任总理，直到新的联盟组建或举行另一次选举，如果没有候选人成功，则必须举行选举。

paras.en: Though the 77-year-old political veteran did better than expected in the vote and his Likud party won the most seats, his nationalist-religious coalition, the most rightwing government in Israel’s history, lost its governing majority.
paras.zh: 尽管这位77岁的政治老手在投票中的表现好于预期，他的利库德集团赢得了最多席位，但他领导的民族主义宗教联盟——以色列历史上最右翼的政府——却失去了执政多数。

paras.en: Netanyahu, at risk of losing power, has seized on an investigation by election officials into possible vote tampering to cast doubt on the results, accusing Israeli Palestinian-led parties of stealing the vote. Critics accuse Netanyahu and his partners of trying to undermine the results, which he denies.
paras.zh: 面临失去权力风险的内塔尼亚胡利用选举官员对可能的投票篡改进行的调查，对选举结果提出质疑，指责以色列巴勒斯坦领导的政党窃取了选票。批评者指责内塔尼亚胡及其伙伴试图破坏选举结果，但内塔尼亚胡对此予以否认。

paras.en: Israel’s Central Election Committee said on Wednesday that the election’s integrity had not been compromised. The head of the committee, the supreme court justice Noam Sohlberg, has called on the country’s elected officials to protect public trust.
paras.zh: 以色列中央选举委员会周三表示，选举的完整性并未受到损害。该委员会主席、最高法院法官诺姆·索尔伯格呼吁该国民选官员保护公众信任。

paras.en: “This is a real danger. One of the foundations of democracy is the peaceful transfer of power,” Sohlberg told Herzog at his residence on Wednesday. He said high voter turnout, including among the Arab minority, was a blessing.
paras.zh: “这是一个真正的危险。民主的基础之一是权力的和平转移，”索尔伯格周三在他的住所告诉赫尔佐格。他说，包括阿拉伯少数族裔在内的高投票率是一件幸事。

paras.en: Netanyahu’s allies on the far right, including Ben-Gvir, have called for the immediate arrest and interrogation of Arab party leaders.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡的极右翼盟友，包括本格维尔，呼吁立即逮捕和审讯阿拉伯政党领导人。

articles.title: Bomb threats disrupt at least 25 flights across Europe, raising hybrid war fears
articles.author: Rory Carroll in Dublin, Gwyn Topham and Jakub Krupa in London

paras.en: Hoax bomb threats have caused at least 25 flights across Europe to be disrupted, with some forced to make emergency landings, as questions mount over an apparently coordinated effort to cause chaos for travellers.
paras.zh: 骗局炸弹威胁已导致欧洲各地至少 25 个航班中断，其中一些航班被迫紧急降落，因为人们对明显协调一致的行动给旅客造成混乱的质疑越来越多。

paras.en: The series of warnings on Thursday affected flights between Italy, Ireland, the UK, Spain, Bulgaria, Romania, Poland, Finland, Austria, Denmark, Belgium, Portugal, France, Greece, Serbia and Czechia.
paras.zh: 周四的一系列警告影响了意大利、爱尔兰、英国、西班牙、保加利亚、罗马尼亚、波兰、芬兰、奥地利、丹麦、比利时、葡萄牙、法国、希腊、塞尔维亚和捷克之间的航班。

paras.en: The threats affected flights by Ryanair, Aer Lingus, Wizz Air, Finnair, easyJet, Aegean Airlines, Iberia, Sky Express, Air Serbia and LOT Polish Airlines. All landed safely. Searches of the planes found nothing suspicious.
paras.zh: 这些威胁影响了瑞安航空、爱尔兰航空、维兹航空、芬兰航空、易捷航空、爱琴海航空、西班牙国家航空、天空快运、塞尔维亚航空和 LOT 波兰航空的航班。全部安全着陆。对飞机的搜查没有发现任何可疑之处。

paras.en: In the UK, Heathrow, London’s principal airport, and Birmingham airport received threats overnight, but it was determined that they were hoaxes with the help of specialist investigators from the Metropolitan police’s aviation police command.
paras.zh: 在英国，伦敦主要机场希思罗机场和伯明翰机场一夜之间就收到了威胁，但在伦敦警察厅航空警察指挥部的专业调查人员的帮助下，确定这些都是骗局。

paras.en: The Met said threats had been made against four aircraft departing from or arriving at Heathrow. A police spokesperson added that, after an assessment, “no security issues [were] identified”.
paras.zh: 大都会表示，四架起飞或抵达希思罗机场的飞机受到了威胁。警方发言人补充说，经过评估，“没有发现安全问题”。

paras.en: The day of hoaxes followed similar threats on Tuesday, when seven planes across Europe were searched or diverted after malicious alerts. On Monday a flight from the UK to Bulgaria was diverted after a threat that was apparently without substance. In total at least 33 flights have been affected this week.
paras.zh: 周二的恶作剧当天也发生了类似的威胁，欧洲各地的七架飞机在收到恶意警报后遭到搜查或改道。周一，一架从英国飞往保加利亚的航班因受到明显毫无实质内容的威胁而改道。本周至少有 33 架航班受到影响。

paras.en: Investigators said on Thursday there remained no evidence that the hoaxes were being orchestrated by a hostile terror group or state actor, such as Russia or Iran, although inquiries across Europe into the incidents continue.
paras.zh: 调查人员周四表示，尽管欧洲各地对这些事件的调查仍在继续，但仍然没有证据表明这些恶作剧是由俄罗斯或伊朗等敌对恐怖组织或国家行为者精心策划的。

paras.en: The global airlines body Iata condemned the disruption and urged authorities to identify the origin of the threats. “Safety is the number one priority for the industry and we take all threats seriously,” said Nick Careen, Iata’s senior vice-president for operations, safety and security, in a statement.
paras.zh: 全球航空公司机构国际航空运输协会（IATA）谴责了这次破坏，并敦促当局查明威胁的根源。国际航空运输协会负责运营、安全和安保的高级副总裁尼克·卡林在一份声明中表示：“安全是该行业的首要任务，我们认真对待所有威胁。”

paras.en: The EU transport commissioner, Apostolos Tzitzikostas, said it was too early to know if the incidents were linked but that any threats against civilians were unacceptable.
paras.zh: 欧盟交通专员阿波斯托洛斯·齐齐科斯塔斯(Apostolos Tzitzikostas)表示，现在判断这些事件是否有关联还为时过早，但任何针对平民的威胁都是不可接受的。

paras.en: Bomb threats emailed to airports in Rome and Sofia were signed “fighters of the Male State”, according to sources at Aeroporti di Roma, which manages the city’s two airports, and a text seen by Agence France-Presse.
paras.zh: 据管理罗马和索非亚机场的罗马机场消息人士称，发送到罗马和索非亚机场的炸弹威胁邮件的署名是“马累国家的战士”，以及法新社看到的一份文字。

paras.en: Male State is a Russian far-right, ultranationalist and misogynistic movement founded in 2016 by Vladislav Pozdnyakov. On his Telegram channel Pozdnyakov, a prominent supporter of the war in Ukraine, did not comment on or claim responsibility for the bomb threats.
paras.zh: “男性国家”是俄罗斯极右翼、极端民族主义和厌恶女性的运动，由弗拉迪斯拉夫·波兹德尼亚科夫 (Vladislav Pozdnyakov) 于 2016 年创立。乌克兰战争的著名支持者波兹德尼亚科夫在他的电报频道上没有评论或声称对炸弹威胁负责。

paras.en: The emails reportedly read: “We, the fighters of the Male State, will make history with our actions today. Your feminist regime will remember this for ever. The explosion will occur in 60 minutes. Today, your skies will turn red.”
paras.zh: 据报道，这些电子邮件写道：“我们，马累国家的战士，将用我们今天的行动创造历史。你们的女权主义政权将永远记住这一点。爆炸将在 60 分钟内发生。今天，你们的天空将变成红色。”

paras.en: A Cork airport spokesperson confirmed to the Guardian that the airport had received an anonymous threat by phone on Thursday morning, causing a flight to be delayed. It was understood to be a Ryanair flight from London Stansted.
paras.zh: 科克机场发言人向《卫报》证实，周四上午，机场收到匿名电话威胁，导致航班延误。据了解，这是从伦敦斯坦斯特德起飞的瑞安航空航班。

paras.en: A separate Ryanair flight from Pescara in Italy to Brussels-Charleroi was inspected after the word “bomb” was discovered scrawled on the walls of its onboard toilet.
paras.zh: 瑞安航空一架从意大利佩斯卡拉飞往布鲁塞尔沙勒罗瓦的另一架航班在机上厕所的墙上发现了“炸弹”字样，随后接受了检查。

paras.en: The affected flights had knock-on effects but were a tiny fraction of the 27,400 flights scheduled in Europe on Thursday, according to the European air traffic control agency, Eurocontrol.
paras.zh: 据欧洲空中交通管制机构欧洲空中安全组织 (Eurocontrol) 称，受影响的航班产生了连锁反应，但仅占周四在欧洲安排的 27,400 架次航班的一小部分。

paras.en: The pilot of an Aer Lingus flight from Dublin to Rome that diverted to Évreux was being questioned by French authorities for initially refusing to land at a military base, according to French media reports.
paras.zh: 据法国媒体报道，爱尔兰航空一架从都柏林飞往罗马的航班后来改道埃夫勒，因最初拒绝在军事基地降落而受到法国当局的询问。

paras.en: The disruption followed cyber-attacks this week against supermarket refrigeration systems.
paras.zh: 这次破坏是在本周针对超市制冷系统的网络攻击之后发生的。

paras.en: A Kremlin spokesperson said on Thursday it was “absurd” to blame Vladimir Putin’s administration for the fridge hacks. “We have such baseless accusations against our country, implicating it in everything,” Dmitry Peskov told reporters.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫发言人周四表示，将冰箱黑客事件归咎于弗拉基米尔·普京政府是“荒谬的”。德米特里·佩斯科夫对记者说：“我们对我们的国家提出毫无根据的指控，一切都与它有关。”

paras.en: In Rome, Guido Crosetto, the Italian defence minister, said: “It seems to me that every day now, from refrigerators to blood supplies in France, to these fake alarms, there’s someone who has an interest in stoking tensions.”
paras.zh: 在罗马，意大利国防部长吉多·克罗塞托(Guido Crosetto)表示：“在我看来，现在每一天，从法国的冰箱到血液供应，再到这些假警报，都有人有意煽动紧张局势。”

paras.en: Asked if he knew who was behind the hoaxes, he said: “It’s called ‘under-threshold warfare’ because it’s below the attribution threshold. It’s done that way on purpose, so no one can pin the blame.”
paras.zh: 当被问及他是否知道谁是恶作剧的幕后黑手时，他说：“这被称为‘阈下战争’，因为它低于归因阈值。这是故意这样做的，所以没有人能归咎于责任。”

paras.en: Many of the affected flights were operated by low-cost carriers but there was little discernible pattern surrounding the incidents.
paras.zh: 许多受影响的航班都是由低成本航空公司运营的，但这些事件几乎没有明显的规律。

paras.en: Aviation experts say fake threats occur daily but that such a number of credible threats, even if malicious hoaxes, appears to point to coordinated action.
paras.zh: 航空专家表示，虚假威胁每天都会发生，但如此多的可信威胁，即使是恶意恶作剧，似乎都表明采取了协调一致的行动。

paras.en: Capt Martin Drake, a former airline pilot and technical adviser to the British Airline Pilots’ Association union, said airlines had security teams who assessed each threat on a traffic-light scale: green to keep going or red to be grounded, with an amber option only for flights yet to take off, allowing tighter checks and searches of the plane before clearing it to fly.
paras.zh: 前航空公司飞行员、英国航空公司飞行员协会工会技术顾问马丁·德雷克上尉表示，航空公司的安全团队会按照红绿灯级别评估每种威胁：绿色表示继续飞行，红色表示停飞，黄色选项仅适用于尚未起飞的航班，以便在允许飞机飞行之前对飞机进行更严格的检查和搜查。

paras.en: “If you want to deliberately disrupt a flight, then you need to do so once it’s airborne,” said Drake. Pilots have a QRH – a quick response handbook – whose instructions will probably include to descend quickly as well as divert to the nearest airport on receipt of a red alert.
paras.zh: 德雷克说：“如果你想故意扰乱航班，那么你就需要在飞机起飞后这样做。”飞行员有一本 QRH（快速反应手册），其中的指示可能包括快速下降以及在收到红色警报时转移到最近的机场。

paras.en: At cruising altitude, “aircraft pressurisation would do a lot of the work of any improvised explosive device”.
paras.zh: 在巡航高度，“飞机增压可以完成任何简易爆炸装置的大量工作”。

paras.en: While getting a large explosive onboard should be ruled out by multiple layers of security and screening, the effects of any detonation would be multiplied for planes at typical cruising altitude of 35,000ft.
paras.zh: 虽然应该通过多层安全和筛查来排除飞机上携带大型爆炸物的可能性，但对于在 35,000 英尺的典型巡航高度的飞机来说，任何爆炸的影响都会成倍增加。

paras.en: Diversions are expensive as well as highly disruptive, but airlines have little choice in the face of any remotely credible threat.
paras.zh: 改道成本高昂且具有高度破坏性，但面对任何可信的威胁，航空公司别无选择。

paras.en: The ready availability of airline operations information on the internet means that any hoaxer now has a level of detail about the schedules, the type of plane and its technical specifications that would have eluded all but insiders decades ago.
paras.zh: 互联网上航空公司运营信息的现成可用意味着任何骗子现在都掌握了有关航班时刻表、飞机类型及其技术规格的详细信息，而几十年前，除了内部人士之外，其他人都无法了解这些信息。

paras.en: Rhys Jones, an analyst at Osprey Flight Solutions, an aviation intelligence firm, said the confidence of airlines in European airport security should not mean any change to normal protocols after the hoaxes, but “one of the natural responses will be to see double-downed security, media coverage and public concern about travelling”.
paras.zh: 航空情报公司Osprey Flight Solutions的分析师里斯·琼斯(Rhys Jones)表示，航空公司对欧洲机场安全的信心不应意味着恶作剧发生后正常协议会发生任何变化，但“自然的反应之一将是看到安全措施的双重下降、媒体报道和公众对旅行的担忧”。

paras.en: He said the threats seemed linked but “a reasonably chaotic campaign with no particular region targeted”, and while they could weaken future security responses through the normalisation of threats, simply creating disruption could be regarded as a success by those carrying out the hoaxes.
paras.zh: 他表示，这些威胁似乎是相互关联的，但“是一场相当混乱的活动，没有针对特定区域”，虽然它们可能通过威胁正常化来削弱未来的安全反应，但仅仅制造破坏就可以被视为那些实施恶作剧的人的成功。

paras.en: Additional reporting by Pjotr Sauer in Amsterdam and Angela Giuffrida in Rome
paras.zh: Pjotr​​ Sauer 在阿姆斯特丹和 Angela Giuffrida 在罗马的补充报道

articles.title: Paraguay’s president quits after millions of people’s savings frozen in bank crisis
articles.author: Tiago Rogero South America correspondent

paras.en: Paraguay’s rightwing president, Santiago Peña, resigned on Thursday after a political and financial crisis collapsed the South American country’s banking system in recent days.
paras.zh: 巴拉圭右翼总统圣地亚哥·佩纳周四辞职，此前几天政治和金融危机导致南美国家银行系统崩溃。

paras.en: At the centre of the crisis is Ueno Bank, which in just a few years under Peña went from an obscure digital bank to one of the country’s largest lenders, claiming to have about 60% of Paraguay’s adult population as customers.
paras.zh: 危机的中心是上野银行，在佩纳领导下的短短几年内，该银行从一家默默无闻的数字银行发展成为该国最大的银行之一，声称拥有巴拉圭约 60% 的成年人口作为客户。

paras.en: Last Monday, the central bank ordered Ueno into resolution over insolvency, freezing the deposits of 3 million customers, leaving hundreds of thousands of families without access to money for food and basic daily expenses. Bank executives were arrested, and people took to the streets in massive protests.
paras.zh: 上周一，央行命令上野就破产问题进行解决，冻结了 300 万客户的存款，导致数十万家庭无法获得食物和基本日常开支。银行高管被捕，人们走上街头进行大规模抗议。

paras.en: In power since August 2023 and with a term running until 2028, the 47-year-old economist was already facing impeachment proceedings that had broad support.
paras.zh: 这位 47 岁的经济学家自 2023 年 8 月开始执政，任期至 2028 年，但他已经面临得到广泛支持的弹劾程序。

paras.en: “Dear compatriots, today I address you at one of the most difficult moments of my life. With my heart set on Paraguay and with the conviction that our republic must always come before any person or circumstance, I have decided to submit my resignation as president of the republic,” said Peña in a video.
paras.zh: 佩尼亚在视频中表示：“亲爱的同胞们，今天，我在我一生中最困难的时刻之一向你们发表讲话。我的心全在巴拉圭，并坚信我们的共和国必须始终优先于任何人或情况，因此我决定辞去共和国总统职务。”

paras.en: Ueno Bank began as a finance company in the 1970s and, in 2021, was bought by Grupo Vázquez, one of Paraguay’s largest business and industrial conglomerates. At the end of 2023, it received authorisation from the central bank, already under Peña’s administration, to operate as a digital bank.
paras.zh: 上野银行 (Ueno Bank) 最初是一家金融公司，成立于 2021 年，并于 2021 年被巴拉圭最大的商业和工业集团之一 Grupo Vázquez 收购。 2023 年底，它获得了佩尼亚管理下的中央银行的授权，可以作为数字银行运营。

paras.en: The bank rapidly expanded its operations, attracting customers with generous cash-back offers on groceries and sponsoring Paraguay’s national football team. On Wednesday, the players released a letter “demanding” a “forceful response” from the government and the justice system.
paras.zh: 该银行迅速扩大业务，通过慷慨的杂货现金返还优惠吸引客户，并赞助巴拉圭国家足球队。周三，球员们发表了一封信，“要求”政府和司法系统做出“强有力的回应”。

paras.en: The bank came to manage between $800m and $850m in deposits from state and pension entities, including retirement funds, prompting criticism over conflicts of interest because of Peña’s previous shareholding ties to Ueno Holding.
paras.zh: 该银行开始管理来自国家和养老金实体（包括退休基金）的 8 亿至 8.5 亿美元存款，由于佩纳之前与上野控股的持股关系，引发了有关利益冲突的批评。

paras.en: Peña said that, as an economist, he had merely made an “investment”, but that he had already disposed of all his shares. When the local press pointed to possible improper favouritism in directing state and pension funds to the bank, he called it a “false media campaign” aimed at weakening his government.
paras.zh: 佩纳表示，作为一名经济学家，他只是进行了一次“投资”，但他已经出售了所有股份。当当地媒体指出国家和养老基金向该银行提供可能存在不当偏袒时，他称这是一场旨在削弱政府的“虚假媒体运动”。

paras.en: On Wednesday, opposition lawmakers and even members of Peña’s Colorado party filed an impeachment motion holding the president responsible for the collapse. He had been a shareholder in the group that ran the bank until early last year and, in recent months, had reportedly been ignoring warnings from the central bank and the media about its operations.
paras.zh: 周三，反对派议员甚至佩纳所在的科罗拉多党成员提出弹劾动议，要求总统对此次垮台负责。直到去年初，他一直是该银行运营集团的股东，据报道，最近几个月，他一直无视央行和媒体对其运营的警告。

paras.en: Political pressure intensified on Thursday morning when the ex-president Horacio Cartes, his former ally, posted a message endorsing the impeachment.
paras.zh: 周四上午，当他的前盟友、前总统奥拉西奥·卡特斯发布支持弹劾的消息时，政治压力加剧。

paras.en: “We will not stand on the side of the theft of public, private and pensioners’ funds. We must think of the people and of the values we uphold in the Colorado party. We support the impeachment of the president of the republic, Santiago Peña, in order to restore the institutional order of the republic,” he wrote.
paras.zh: “我们不会站在盗窃公共、私人和养老金领取者资金的一边。我们必须考虑到人民以及我们在科罗拉多党中所坚持的价值观。我们支持弹劾共和国总统圣地亚哥·佩纳，以恢复共和国的制度秩序，”他写道。

paras.en: Other lawmakers followed suit and began debating impeachment when Peña released a video announcing his resignation.
paras.zh: 当佩纳发布宣布辞职的视频时，其他议员也纷纷效仿，开始讨论弹劾问题。

paras.en: “I do so thinking of the stability of our country, social peace and the need to preserve our democratic institutions,” said the now former president.
paras.zh: 这位现任前总统说：“我这样做是考虑到我们国家的稳定、社会和平以及维护我们民主制度的必要性。”

paras.en: “I also want to apologise to the people if at any point I failed them … But today my priority is only one thing: the peace of mind of Paraguayans who trusted their savings to our financial system … My greatest wish is that the return of those funds is guaranteed,” he added.
paras.zh: “如果我在任何时候让人民失望，我也想向他们道歉……但今天我的首要任务只有一件事：让巴拉圭人安心，他们将自己的储蓄托付给我们的金融体系……我最大的愿望是保证这些资金的归还，”他补充道。

paras.en: Opposition senator Rafael Filizzola called the case “the biggest fraud carried out from political power in the democratic era … This is a bank created from political power, to use public money for private businesses linked to political power, with the president of the republic at the head of it,” he told 1020 AM radio.
paras.zh: 反对党参议员拉斐尔·菲利佐拉 (Rafael Filizzola) 向 1020 AM 广播电台表示，此案是“民主时代利用政治权力实施的最大欺诈案……这是一家利用政治权力创建的银行，将公共资金用于与政治权力相关的私营企业，并以共和国总统为首”。

paras.en: Peña, a former finance minister who promised to rebuild a “great Paraguay”, was a key ally of the US president, Donald Trump, in the region – one of the few Latin American presidents to attend Trump’s second inauguration. US officials, including the secretary of state, Marco Rubio, repeatedly praised him as a “strategic partner”, and Peña recently flew to Washington to discuss critical minerals and economic cooperation. Neither Rubio nor Trump has yet commented on Peña’s resignation.
paras.zh: 佩纳曾任财政部长，曾承诺重建“伟大的巴拉圭”，他是美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在该地区的重要盟友，也是少数参加特朗普第二次就职典礼的拉丁美洲总统之一。包括国务卿马可·卢比奥在内的美国官员多次称赞他是“战略伙伴”，佩纳最近飞往华盛顿讨论重要的矿产和经济合作。卢比奥和特朗普尚未对佩纳的辞职发表评论。

paras.en: Vice-President Pedro Alliana automatically assumes the presidency to complete the constitutional term until August 2028.
paras.zh: 副总统佩德罗·阿利亚纳自动就任总统，完成宪法任期至 2028 年 8 月。

paras.en: About an hour after Peña’s announcement, the lower house unanimously approved the impeachment motion, which now goes to the senate. If approved, even after his resignation, he would lose his senate seat and, with it, parliamentary immunity, leaving him to face any criminal proceedings in the ordinary courts.
paras.zh: 佩纳宣布这一消息后大约一个小时，下议院一致通过了弹劾动议，该动议现已提交参议院。如果获得批准，即使在他辞职后，他也将失去参议院席位以及议会豁免权，从而使他面临普通法院的任何刑事诉讼。

articles.title: Eight killed in series of shootings in western Turkey

paras.en: Eight people have been killed and one seriously injured in a series of shootings in western Turkey.
paras.zh: 土耳其西部发生一系列枪击事件，造成八人死亡、一人重伤。

paras.en: The attacks took place in the Afyonkarahisar province on Thursday, with victims found in several locations in three separate vehicles, according to local reports.
paras.zh: 据当地报道，袭击于周四在阿菲永卡拉希萨尔省发生，在多个地点发现了三辆不同车辆中的受害者。

paras.en: The suspect fled, triggering a manhunt, and authorities later said he had been arrested in EskiÅehir province.
paras.zh: 嫌疑人逃跑，引发了追捕，当局后来表示他已在埃斯基埃希尔省被捕。

paras.en: CCTV footage published in Turkish media showed a man in a black jacket, white trousers and glasses clutching a long weapon as he stood by a red minivan.
paras.zh: 土耳其媒体发布的闭路电视录像显示，一名身穿黑色夹克、白色裤子、戴着眼镜的男子站在一辆红色小型货车旁，手里拿着一把长武器。

paras.en: Turkey's state-run Anadolu Agency reported that three people were killed near Ayazini village and three others near Kiyir village. In Yukaritandir, two women were found injured and later died in hospital.
paras.zh: 土耳其国营阿纳多卢通讯社报道称，阿亚齐尼村附近有三人被杀，基耶尔村附近还有三人被杀。在尤卡里坦迪尔，两名妇女被发现受伤，后来在医院死亡。

paras.en: Two teachers were reportedly among the dead.
paras.zh: 据报道，死者中有两名教师。

paras.en: Local media said roads leading to the affected villages were closed by police, while officers launched a large-scale operation to find the suspect.
paras.zh: 当地媒体称，通往受影响村庄的道路已被警方封闭，同时警方展开大规模行动寻找嫌疑人。

paras.en: The newspaper Milliyet reported that a vehicle allegedly taken by the attacker had been later found stuck in mud - the suspect having abandoned it before fleeing on foot.
paras.zh: 据《国民报》报道，据称袭击者劫持的一辆汽车后来被发现陷在泥里——嫌疑人在步行逃离之前将其遗弃。

paras.en: In a statement posted on social media, the Afyonkarahisar Governorate said "all relevant institutions of our state have been working in coordination since the very first moment and are meticulously carrying out the necessary work".
paras.zh: 阿菲永卡拉希萨尔省在社交媒体上发布的一份声明中表示，“我们州所有相关机构从一开始就一直在协调工作，并正在认真开展必要的工作”。

articles.title: Who could be behind hoax bomb threats to European air travel?

paras.en: The warnings came in thick and fast, targeting one airline or airport after another.
paras.zh: 警告密集而迅速地针对一家又一家航空公司或机场。

paras.en: In nearly all cases - London's Heathrow airport being a notable exception - they were taken to be credible enough to divert the aircraft in question, or even in Italy's case, to scramble fighter jets to escort it.
paras.zh: 几乎在所有情况下——伦敦希思罗机场是一个明显的例外——他们都被认为有足够的可信度来改变相关飞机的航线，甚至在意大利的情况下，他们也会紧急出动战斗机为其护航。

paras.en: They all turned out to be false, which does not, of course, mean that the next ones will not be real.
paras.zh: 它们都被证明是假的，当然，这并不意味着下一个不会是真的。

paras.en: It is hardly surprising that the simultaneous, co-ordinated nature of these airline hoaxes, coupled with other malicious actions across Europe, are causing some people to point the finger of suspicion at Russia.
paras.zh: 毫不奇怪，这些航空公司骗局同时发生、相互协调，再加上欧洲各地的其他恶意行为，导致一些人将怀疑的矛头指向俄罗斯。

paras.en: Following a series of cyber-attacks and mysterious drone sightings over sensitive sites earlier this year, in the past few days we have seen the remote hacking of supermarket freezers, as well as a blood bank, a suspicious incident on Poland's border with Russia, and in August a drone attack Germany's Leipzig Halle airport which its interior minister publicly blamed on Moscow.
paras.zh: 继今年早些时候在敏感地点发生一系列网络攻击和神秘无人机目击事件后，过去几天我们看到超市冰柜和血库遭到远程黑客攻击，波兰与俄罗斯边境发生可疑事件，8 月德国莱比锡哈雷机场遭遇无人机袭击，德国内政部长公开指责莫斯科。

paras.en: There are many who argue, based purely on circumstantial evidence, that this must surely be yet another example of "hybrid", "grey zone" or "sub-threshold" warfare - actions that damage a nation's infrastructure or society but which tend to be anonymous, deniable and which fall short of triggering Nato's Article 5 and thereby mobilising a response by the West.
paras.zh: 许多人纯粹根据间接证据认为，这肯定是“混合”、“灰色地带”或“亚阈值”战争的又一个例子——这些行为损害一个国家的基础设施或社会，但往往是匿名的、可否认的，并且无法触发北约第五条，从而动员西方做出反应。

paras.en: Moscow is certainly furious with Nato for supporting Ukraine and, in doing so, frustrating the Kremlin's plans to swallow up that country and effectively terminate its independence.
paras.zh: 莫斯科当然对北约支持乌克兰感到愤怒，并以此挫败克里姆林宫吞并该国并有效终止其独立的计划。

paras.en: Russian bloggers have also suggested that, if Ukraine's drones are currently making Russia's airports unsafe, and Western sanctions are blocking Russian airlines from European airspace, then why shouldn't Western nations feel the same pain?
paras.zh: 俄罗斯博主还表示，如果乌克兰的无人机目前使俄罗斯机场变得不安全，而西方制裁正在阻止俄罗斯航空公司进入欧洲领空，那么西方国家为什么不应该感受到同样的痛苦呢？

paras.en: But as of Thursday evening no hard evidence had emerged linking the airline hoaxes to Russia, Iran or any proxy groups controlled by them.
paras.zh: 但截至周四晚上，还没有确凿的证据表明这些航空公司骗局与俄罗斯、伊朗或他们控制的任何代理组织有关。

paras.en: There is the email threat sent on Thursday morning to airport authorities in Rome, purporting to be from "Fighters of the Male State".
paras.zh: 周四早上，罗马机场当局收到了一封电子邮件威胁，声称来自“马累国家战士”。

paras.en: That name likely refers to the Russian group Muzhskoi Legion or "Male Legion", an ultra-right group with such extreme views it was banned by a Moscow court in 2021.
paras.zh: 这个名字可能指的是俄罗斯组织 Muzhskoi Legion 或“男性军团”，这是一个观点极端的极右组织，于 2021 年被莫斯科法院禁止。

paras.en: Yet, it retained tens of thousands of online followers on Telegram as it cheered on the full-scale Russian invasion of Ukraine in the following year.
paras.zh: 然而，它在 Telegram 上保留了数万名在线粉丝，为次年俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰而欢呼。

paras.en: But the email sent to Rome, even if genuine - and who is to say it is not another group hiding behind that name? - is unlikely to provide the leads that police and airport authorities need to pin down who is generating these hoaxes and why.
paras.zh: 但发送到罗马的电子邮件，即使是真实的，谁能说这不是另一个隐藏在这个名字后面的组织呢？ - 不太可能提供警方和机场当局所需的线索来查明是谁制造了这些恶作剧以及原因。

paras.en: For national police forces, airport authorities and transport ministries trying to work out who is behind these hoaxes and how best to mitigate their effect when they happen again, the task is not to go with who they think might be the most likely culprits but instead to follow the cold, hard leads - if they can find them.
paras.zh: 对于国家警察部队、机场当局和交通部来说，他们试图查明这些恶作剧的幕后黑手，以及当这些恶作剧再次发生时如何最好地减轻其影响，他们的任务不是找出他们认为最有可能的罪魁祸首，而是追随冰冷、确凿的线索——如果他们能找到他们的话。

articles.title: California governor commutes death sentences for all 548 people on death row

paras.en: California Governor Gavin Newsom has commuted the death sentences of all 548 people on death row in the state, changing them instead with life in prison.
paras.zh: 加州州长加文·纽瑟姆 (Gavin Newsom) 对该州所有 548 名死囚减刑，改为终身监禁。

paras.en: "We can now let these offenders die in obscurity while we forever remember and honour the victims," he said in a letter.
paras.zh: 他在一封信中说：“我们现在可以让这些罪犯默默无闻地死去，同时我们永远记住并纪念受害者。”

paras.en: The decision to spare death row inmates is largely symbolic in a state that has not executed a prisoner since 2006, though experts say it could save millions of dollars in court costs each year. Only 13 inmates have been killed since voters reinstated the death penalty in 1978.
paras.zh: 对于一个自 2006 年以来就没有处决过囚犯的州来说，赦免死囚的决定在很大程度上具有象征意义，不过专家表示，这每年可以节省数百万美元的法庭费用。自 1978 年选民恢复死刑以来，只有 13 名囚犯被杀害。

paras.en: The decision comes as Newsom, the Democratic leader of the most populous US state, has been discussed as a possible 2028 contender for president.
paras.zh: 这一决定出台之际，美国人口最多州的民主党领袖纽瑟姆被视为 2028 年总统大选的可能竞争者。

paras.en: Newsom, who is term limited, is winding down his final months in office. Fellow Democrat Xavier Becerra is projected to take over after the midterm elections on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 纽森的任期有限，他的任期即将结束。民主党同僚泽维尔·贝塞拉预计将在周二中期选举后接任。

paras.en: Newsom explained in his letter that he is exercising his constitutional clemency authority to commute the sentences to life without the possibility of parole.
paras.zh: 纽瑟姆在信中解释说，他正在行使宪法赦免权，将刑期减为终身监禁，且不得假释。

paras.en: "After nearly 30 years in public office, I have come to understand the limits of what government can justly accomplish," Newsom said. "I take this action because I firmly believe that state-sanctioned killing is incompatible with California's values, undermines the foundations of our legal system and diminishes each of us".
paras.zh: 纽瑟姆说：“在担任公职近 30 年之后，我开始明白政府公正地完成任务的局限性。” “我采取这一行动是因为我坚信，国家批准的杀戮与加州的价值观不相容，破坏了我们法律体系的基础，并削弱了我们每个人的能力”。

paras.en: California has historically had the largest population of death row inmates. Newsom had previously ordered a halt to the death penalty in the state in 2019.
paras.zh: 加州历来是死囚人数最多的州。纽瑟姆此前曾于 2019 年下令该州停止死刑。

paras.en: Newsom, describing his decision as a difficult but "righteous action", said that although many Californians feel that those who commit brutal crimes deserve to die, he has concluded that "the state cannot morally kill them".
paras.zh: 纽瑟姆形容他的决定是一项艰难但“正义的行动”，他表示，尽管许多加州人认为那些犯下残酷罪行的人应该死，但他得出的结论是“国家不能在道义上杀死他们”。

paras.en: He said that by every measure, California's system for administering the death penalty "is a failure", and that it has not and cannot be fairly applied, resulting in the conviction of innocent people.
paras.zh: 他表示，从各个方面来看，加州的死刑执行制度“都是失败的”，它没有也不可能得到公平的执行，导致无辜者被定罪。

paras.en: Life without the possibility of parole is the most severe punishment he can lawfully impose and that the state can ethically enforce, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，不得假释的终身监禁是他可以合法施加的最严厉的惩罚，也是国家可以道德执行的。

paras.en: He acknowledged that his clemency action will anger and hurt some Californians and said that it will "always weigh heavily on me".
paras.zh: 他承认他的宽大处理行动会激怒并伤害一些加州人，并表示这将“永远给我带来沉重的压力”。

paras.en: "As Governor, I alone bear responsibility for this decision and its impact, just as I alone would bear responsibility for each execution," he wrote.
paras.zh: 他写道：“作为州长，我独自对这一决定及其影响承担责任，就像我独自对每次处决承担责任一样。”

paras.en: "For this reason I am compelled to follow my conscience and, as authorised by our Constitution, take this action for the welfare of the State of California," he concluded the letter.
paras.zh: “出于这个原因，我不得不遵循我的良心，并根据我们的宪法授权，为了加利福尼亚州的福祉采取这一行动，”他在信中总结道。

paras.en: Because individual states have the power to prosecute crimes and order executions, much of the power lies with state governor.
paras.zh: 由于各州有权起诉犯罪并下令处决，因此大部分权力属于州长。

paras.en: The decision comes after the high-profile botched execution of a woman in Tennessee last month and while executions have been on the rise in the US.
paras.zh: 这一决定是在上个月田纳西州一名妇女被高调拙劣处决之后做出的，而美国的处决数量一直在增加。

paras.en: On the federal level, President Donald Trump, a long-time supporter of the death penalty, has described capital punishment as "an essential tool for deterring and punishing those who would commit the most heinous crimes and acts of lethal violence against American citizens".
paras.zh: 在联邦层面，长期支持死刑的唐纳德·特朗普总统将死刑描述为“威慑和惩罚那些对美国公民犯下最令人发指的罪行和致命暴力行为的重要工具”。

paras.en: In 2020, during his first term, he ended a nearly two-decade moratorium on the federal death penalty, by ordering 13 executions over a six month period.
paras.zh: 2020 年，在他的第一个任期内，他下令在六个月内处决 13 人，结束了联邦近两年暂停执行死刑的状态。

paras.en: While the moratorium returned under President Biden, on the first day of Trump's second term in 2025, he signed an executive order that re-instated the death penalty.
paras.zh: 虽然拜登总统重新暂停执行死刑，但在特朗普 2025 年第二任期的第一天，他签署了一项恢复死刑的行政命令。

paras.en: No federal executions have been carried out since he signed it, however. In the US, both the federal government and local states authorities can order executions.
paras.zh: 然而，自他签署该协议以来，联邦尚未执行任何处决。在美国，联邦政府和地方政府都可以下令执行死刑。

articles.title: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian

paras.en: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian

SK Wellman, a company specializing in the production of brake and frictions components for off-highway, has a lively DNA. A historical reality in Orzinuovi (Bs), where the plant is still located, over the years it has undergone transformations and changes that have contributed to making it what it is today: an evolved company, able to grow in loyalty to the local Italian territory and to innovate its sector with creativity and flexibility worldwide. Today, as part of the CentroMotion Group and its Carlisle Brake & Friction division, SK Wellman is a leader in its segment, recognized and chosen by major brands in earthmoving, agricultural and construction machinery. Engineer Alessandro Gamba, Global Director of Friction Engineering, tells us about the ongoing growth.

They are the ones who make the Brescia-based company an authentic and tenacious company, to the point of being able to export not only their products successfully, but also their skills and design skills to the other plants of the Carlisle Brake & Friction division. articles.title: Length of rental slightly up in Q3, shop scheduling backlogs down
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Enterprise Mobility reports that overall Length of Rental (LOR) for collision-related rentals in Q3 2026 was 15.5 days, up 0.4 days from Q2 and 0.1 days from Q3 2025.
“This modest rise is notable when comparing Q3 2025’s results to Q3 2024, when overall LOR declined 0.9 days; Q3 2026’s results are the first Q3-over-Q3 increase since 2022,” the report states.

“Apart from the early months of the pandemic in 2020, that was the highest percentage of shops reporting such an open schedule in the nearly 10 years since the quarterly “Who Pays” surveys began asking about scheduling backlog,” Yoswick said in the LOR report.
He added that work in progress (WIP) fell to another new low in Q3 2026, reaching 49% in September, according to CRASH Network’s “Collision Industry Business Perspectives” survey.
Ryan Mandell, Mitchell International’s vice president of strategy and market intelligence, added that the percentage of parts repaired continued upward in Q3, reaching 17.8% from 16.4% in Q3 2025.
Q3 drivable LOR was 14.6 days, a 0.2-day increase from Q3 2025. Alaska and Rhode Island had the joint-highest LOR at 18.9 days each, followed by Massachusetts at 16.8 days.
North Dakota had the lowest drivable LOR at 9.8 days, followed by Hawaii (11.2 days) and the District of Columbia (11.4 days).
Iowa recorded the largest increase, with drivable LOR up 1.7 days year over year to 12.9 days. Georgia (15.6 days) had the largest decrease, down 0.9 days.
Greg Horn, Chief Industry Relations Officer at PartsTrader, said drivable LOR “aligns closely with parts delivery days.”
Non-drivable LOR didn’t change compared to Q3 2025, remaining at 21.2 days.

Alaska had the highest non-drivable LOR at 30 days, followed by West Virginia at 26.3 days and Wyoming at 24.4 days. West Virginia (21.2 days) recorded its largest decrease, down 3.1 days from Q3 2025.

Total loss claim LOR was 14.2 days, a 0.3-day increase above Q3 2025. West Virginia had the highest total loss LOR at 18.1 days, followed by New Hampshire at 17.4 days and Rhode Island at 17.2 days. South Dakota had the lowest total loss LOR at 11.3 days.

“Total Loss frequency rose again to 21.0%, up from 20.3% in Q3 2025,” said Mandell in the report. “With more borderline vehicles ending up as write-offs, this contributes to some of the reduction in repairable claims volume the industry has been experiencing.”

According to JD Power’s 2026 U.S. Auto Claims Satisfaction Study, overall customer satisfaction decreases by 12 points (on a 1,000-point scale) due to total loss determinations, and increases by 4 points when damages are repairable.
Overall, the report found that 26% of auto insurance claims were classified as total losses in 2026, up from just 16% four years ago.
In the Q3 LOR report, Mandell adds that average first-party deductibles are declining, down to $809 in Q3 from $844 in Q3 2025.

“This may be an indicator that we are seeing more consumers switch insurance carriers as more competitive rates enter the ecosystem,” Mandell said. “This carrier switching is a catalyst for consumers to improve their coverage as they are able to attain a more favorable premium and thereby reduce their deductible or add back first-party coverages. Both of which are signs that we may see gradual increases in claims volumes in the near future.”
The Q3 Quarterly Insurance Signals Intelligence Report from JD Power and TransUnion shows auto insurance carrier switching increased even though year-over-year (YoY) shopping was flat.
The latest report shows shopping reached 13.2% and switching 5.1%, both up 0.6 percentage points from Q2.

A recent LexisNexis Risk Solutions whitepaper details survey findings on auto insurance shopping trends, stating that 72% of consumers who shopped for auto insurance are open to switching carriers. Of those, 17% said they were definitely seeking a new auto insurance company.

articles.title: SCRS booth invites SEMA attendees to compete for ‘best welder’ and ‘best refinisher’
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: SEMA Show attendees are once again asked to compete in a virtual reality welding and refinishing competition to win prizes for their favorite automotive trade school at the Society of Collision Repair Specialists (SCRS) booth this week.

From Tuesday through Friday, visitors at the SCRS booth can take part in a fully immersive welding and refinishing competition powered by Skillveri’s virtual and mixed-reality training technology. The booth is located in the Upper South Hall, Booth #31147.
The competition will sort out the “best of the best” daily from 9:30–11:30 a.m. and 1–4:30 p.m. Winners will be announced via SCRS’s Facebook and LinkedIn pages Friday afternoon.

No pre-registration is needed, and it is open to students, instructors, and repair professionals. Participants can visit the SCRS booth during competition hours to compete in either the welding category, refinishing category, or both.
Attendees will compete for the titles of “Best Welder” and “Best Refinisher.” Finalists will receive a Full Series Pass to the 2027 SCRS Repairer Driven Education program at the SEMA Show.

Each winner will also select a U.S.-based automotive trade school to receive an equipment and training package made possible by Skillveri, Southern California Collision Equipment, Milwaukee Tool, and CAR-O-LINER.

- First Place Welding and Refinishing Finalists: Their selected school will receive a complete Skillveri virtual and mixed-reality training system, including a lifetime software license, VR headset, specialized welding or spray painting equipment, laptop, and supporting hardware.
- Second Place Welding Finalist: Their selected school will receive a Goliath Carts Weld Test Cart and Bench Mount Combo for welding.
- Second Place Refinish Finalists: Their selected school will receive a Goliath Carts Painters Toolbox.

- Third Place Finalists: Their selected schools will receive an extensive Milwaukee Tool equipment package featuring M12 and M18 FUEL cordless power tools, impact wrenches, ratchets, sanders, grinders, lighting, and specialty automotive repair equipment. The collection also includes extensive socket, wrench, and hand tool sets, along with a modular PACKOUT storage and organization system.
- Third Place Tie: CAR-O-LINER has provided a WEL32 MIG-MAG welding machine. If no third-place tie occurs, the welding machine will be added to the first-place welding award.
SCRS also recently announced that members now have flexible access to the Skillveri Chroma through an exclusive rental program.

The member benefit lets SCRS collision repair businesses evaluate new hires, run short-term training workshops, and build technician skills without the cost, mess, or material waste of live paint, an SCRS press release states.
Next door to the SCRS booth, Spanesi is also giving away $40,000 in prizes at Booth #31173.

Collision repair professionals visiting Spanesi Booth Nov. 3–6 can explore equipment and participate in an interactive experience focused on improving repair workflows and productivity, a Spanesi press release states.

“Spanesi Collision Course transforms a traditional booth visit into a hands-on experience where attendees can explore equipment, discover practical ways to improve repair processes in their own shops, and unlock prizes along the way,” according to the release.
Attendees scan a QR code on the show floor or at the booth to register. They then explore stations throughout the booth featuring measuring, structural repair, refinishing, and more.
“As participants visit stations, they’ll unlock a spin on a prize wheel featuring tools, industry-related gift cards, Spanesi merch, and other prizes,” the release states.

Participants who complete all stations qualify for six prize drawings, and one winner will receive a Touch V6 Portable measuring system valued at more than $40,000.
